tgt: uttarasya mantrasyādinā pūrvasya mantrasyāntolakṣyate, tallakṣaṇaṃ uttarādiḥ pūrvānta iti / siddhe lakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet, atrocyate| yadi hyayaṃ lakṣaṇagrahaṇaṃ na kuryāduttarasya mantrasyādiḥ pūrvasya mantrasyāntaḥ syāt, evaṃ pūrvasya mantrasyāntasya uttarasya mantrasya cādeḥ saṃsargaḥ kriyeta, evaṃ mā bhūdityata āha lakṣaṇamiti / 3 / iha vṛtapratimantraṇādīni karmāṇyupadekṣyante ekaṃ karttāram adhikṛtya, aviśeṣacoditāśca traya udgātāraḥ / yatvityāhurvācānyānṛtvijo vṛṇate kasmādudgātārovṛtā ārtvijyaṃ kurvantīti / tatredaṃ saṃśete aviśeṣacoditānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāptau kasyemāni bhavanti, ata āha ācāryaḥ |

src: ekaśrutividhānān mantrān karmāṇi codgātaiva kuryād anādeśe
tgt: ekavacanaśrutyā ye vidhīyante, ta ekaśrutividhānāḥ mahanmevoca iti kariṣyan pratimantrayetetyevamādyā mantrāḥ / karmāṇi ca pṛthaksāvitrīpādairmadhuparkasya pibedityevamādīni udgātaiva kuryādanādeśa iti, ādeśādanyatrānādeśe / ādeśaḥ, prastotā havirdhānaṃ gacchet madhyandine huta ādityagrahe pratiharttā bhavati / atha vā ekaśrutividhānāddhetoḥ udgātraivoktaḥ ekasya śrutau vidhānaṃ udgātā sāmavedeneti / athaivaśabdaḥ kimarthamiti cet, avadhāraṇārthaḥ / sāmānyatvādudgātṛśabdasya yasyaivānanyaśabdasaṃyogaḥ sa eva mukhyaḥ / anādeśagrahaṇasya prayojanamuktaṃ prathamasūtra eva / 4 / utamuttarādiḥ pūrvantalakṣaṇamiti, etallakṣaṇaṃ mahadādīnāṃ yajuṣāṃ utkrāntirasīti paryantānāṃ yeṣu punar idaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ na sambhavati, tām ucchrayatīty evamādivat, teṣāṃ kaḥ prayogaḥ ityatrāha |

yeṣāṃ mantrāṇām anto nādiśyate tān eva yajuḥ pratīyāt teṣu yāvadeva yajati samarthantāvad eva prayoktavyamiti / ye 'rthavādā madhye paṭhitās teṣām uddhāra iti / 5 / uktaṃ mantravidhiś cādigrahaṇeneti, tatroktaṃ mahadādiṣu yajuḥṣu mantraśabdosya varttata iti / atha ṛksāmnāṃ ko vidhirityatrāha |

samāmnāye yā ṛk tasyā ṛcaḥ ādigrahaṇena vidhirbhavati / avadhūya pavitramudagdaśamavāṅnābhi vitanuyuḥ pavitraṃ ta iti / sāmnaśceti ca śabdaḥ, sāmnaścādigrahaṇena vidhirbhavati, adhvaryupreṣitastyagnāyiriti gāyedityādivat / ādineti siddhe grahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet, ucyate / ādinā ca grahaṇena cetyevamarthaṃ grahaṇaṃ agniṣṭayatītyavabhṛthasāma itivat / 6 / iti paribhāṣā / uktaṃ karmaṇyudgātaiva kuryādanādeśe, tatrodgātetyukte kiṃ lakṣaṇaṃ punarudgātāraṃ kuryādityucyate / tadudgātṛlakṣaṇaṃ vivakṣurācāryaḥ sādhāraṇatvādṛtvigguṇanāṃ sarvartvijo'dhikṛtya lakṣaṇamārabhate |

src: yājyaś ca prathamais tribhir guṇair vyākhyātaḥ
tgt: ārṣeyaḥ anūcānaḥ sādhucaraṇa iti / atha vā yājyaśca evaṃ lakṣaṇaḥ yādṛglakṣaṇā ṛtvijaḥ / prathamairvā tribhirguṇairvyākhyātaḥ / luptavibhāṣaṃ sūtraṃ / guṇagrahaṇaṃ kṣatriyavaiśyayoryathāsambhavaṃ guṇā grāhyāḥ

src: somapravākam akariṣyan namaḥ somāya rājña ity uktvā pratyācakṣīta
tgt: sāmprataṃ vidhirvivakṣitaḥ, somaṃ prabrūte, somapravākaḥ, tamakariṣyan karma namaḥ somāya rājña ityetadyajurūktvā pratyākhyānaṃ kuryāt kiñcideva vyākṣepaṃ kṛtvā aparuṣaṃ pratyācakṣīta / atha kariṣyata eva, tāvadvidhau vaktavye kasmādakariṣyataḥ pūrvamucyate pratyākhyānamātrasya vaktavyatvādakariṣyataḥ pūrvamuktaṃ, kariṣyato hi vṛtapratimantraṇādiḥ samidādhānāhavanīyopasthānānto vidhirvaktavyaḥ sa ucyate / 8 / akariṣyato vidhiruktaḥ atha kariṣyatovidhiṃ vivakṣurāha |

src: mahan me voca iti kariṣyan pratimantrayeta
tgt: mahanme voca ityanena yajuṣā kariṣyan pratimantraṇaṃ kuryāt

src: tan na jahyād aprokte 'pi kariṣyāmīti viditvā
tgt: tat vṛtapratimantraṇaṃ yajuḥ na jahyāt notsṛjet aprokte 'pi somapravākeṇeti kariṣyāmīti vijñāya / kosya viṣayaḥ sādyaktāḥ / 11 / atha vṛtapratimantraṇaṃ kṛtvā anantaraṃ somapravāke kiṃ pratipattavyam ityatrāha |

āvasanti tamityāvasathaḥ somaṃ prabrūte somapravākaḥ, tasmai somapravākāya tādarthye caturtho / lavaṇamannaṃ lavaṇena sampṛktamannaṃ lavaṇamannantat dadhnā saha hārayet bhojayet, evaṃ sūtrārthaḥ / āvasathaśca somapravākāya karttavyaḥ / tatraiva cāsya bhojananneyamiti

somapravākāyānnaṃ hārayitvāthānantaraṃ prahiṇuyāt prastotṛsubrahmaṇyau purastāt karmabhyaḥ, prahiṇuyāt preṣayedityarthaḥ / prastotā ca subrahmaṇyaśca prastotā subrahmaṇyo pūrvaṃ karmaṇa ārambhāt atha vā tādarthye caturthī yāni purastāt karmāṇi tārkṣyasāmādīni tadarthaṃ / 13 / uktaṃ prahiṇuyāt prastotṛsubrahmaṇyāviti / tayoḥ kamarthaṃ prāgāmanaṃ / karmāṇi ca devayajane kriyate / ata ācāryo devayajanalakṣaṇaṃ vivakṣurāha |

prāgudakpravaṇaṃ devajayanaṃ / āpaḥ prācya udocyo vā yatra gacchanti / athavā prāgudīcīdiśaṃ yatrāpaḥ pravarttante tat prāgudakpravaṇaṃ cātvālasāriṇyo yatrāpaḥ syurityarthaḥ / devayajanaṃ devā asminnijyanta iti devayajanaṃ / lomaśaṃ, pratilomaśaṃ tṛṇauṣadhibahulamityarthaḥ / avṛkṣannāsmin vṛkṣāḥ santyavṛkṣaṃ / samaṃ, yatra naviṣamābhūmistatsamaṃ / evaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ devayajanaṃ syāt / 14 / kiñca |

taditi pūrvanirdeśaḥ, tāsāmabhāvaḥ, bhavanaṃ bhāvaḥ, na bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ, apāmabhāve mahāvṛkṣādayaḥ syuḥ / mahāṃścāsau vṛkṣaśca mahāvṛkṣaḥ ānmahataḥ samānādhikaraṇajātīyayorityākāraḥ / apare varṇayanti udumbara iti / prājāpatya udumbaraḥ prajāpatirvāva mahāniti pūrva eva tu sādhīyān / mahataḥ samānādhikaraṇa iti / udapānaḥ kūpaḥ / deśāntaragāmī panthā mahāpathaḥ

evaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ caiva syāt, na cāsya devayajanasya sthalataraṃ samīpe syāt prātiśāyanikastaraḥ pratyayo devayajanamapi na sthale bhavatītyetaddarśayati / sthalataraḥ parvataḥ asyeti sarveṣu kalpeṣu syāt anantarasya vidhirmābhūditi
na cāsya sthalataramadūre syādityuktaṃ / kiñca devayajanapramāṇaṃ cāsya pūrve pradeśe sthitaṃ na syāt

uktamaviśeṣeṇa devayajanalakṣaṇaṃ / athābhicaraṇīyeṣu viśeṣavivakṣurāha / viparyasyābhicaraṇīyeṣviti / yadidaṃ devayajanalakṣaṇamuktaṃ etadabhicaraṇīyeṣu viparyastaṃ bhavati / viparyāsaḥ prātilomyaṃ / kiṃ sarvameva viparyastaṃ netyucyate / kintarhi, sthalādanyaddevayajanamātrācca| viparyāse'pi sati naiva sthalataramadūre syāddevayajanamātrañca purastānnaiva syāt
uta prahiṇuyātprastotṛsubrahmaṇyo purastāt karmabhya iti / atha tasya gamanakālaḥ ka iti / atrocyate / ātmanā gacchet kraye upavasathye punaḥ svayaṃ vrajedanāhūtopi

src: udaṅṅeva tu gṛhebhyaḥ prathamaṃ devo devam etv iti
tgt: atha tasya gamanakriyā ucyate / udaṅṅeva tu gṛhebhyaḥ prathamaṃ niṣkrāmet / devo devametvityanena yajuṣā / athaiva śabdaḥ kimarthaṃ ucyate / anyatopi gantavye udaṅṅeva tāvat prathamaṃ prasthānaṃ kuryāt / atha tuśabdaḥ kimarthaṃ ucyate / anyato dvārepyevaṃ
dūramadhvanogatvālpevaśiṣṭe vihāya dauskṛtyamityetat yajurjapet / vihāya dauṣkṛtyaṃ vrajāmītyasyādhyāhāramapare varṇayanti / apare yāvadgrahaṇaṃ kasmādavacanāt
devayajanagāmī yaḥ panthā tamāpadya ananyagāminaṃ badānāmāsītyetat yajurjapet

src: uttaraṃ vedyantam ākramya dakṣiṇam īkṣamāṇaḥ pitaro bhūr iti
tgt: yasyopavasathye'hni āgamanaṃ bhavati sa devayajanamahāvederuttaramantamākramya dakṣiṇamantamīkṣamāṇaḥ pitaro bhūrityetadyajurjapet / yasya punaḥ kraye'hni āgamanaṃ bhavati sa patnīsaṃśālāyāṃ vedimākramate mahāvederabhāvāt
yajuṣāmantaraye 'nvāhārandhānajapyomanyate / antarayatyāgaḥ, utsargaḥ / anvāharaṇamanvāhāraḥ anutsarga ityarthaḥ / kaḥ punar viṣayaḥ / sānnipātiko vidhiḥ / tatrānujapaḥ alopārthaḥ

upekṣaṇaṃ varjanam akaraṇam ity arthaḥ / evaṃ śāṇḍilyo manyate / kasmāt nimittāpāyāt / apara āha / pitaro bhūr iti kṛtsnaṃ yajuḥ antaritaṃ samāmnāye / trayo ha nu vai pitaraḥ avamā ṛrvā kāvyā iti / tasyānvāhārandhānaṃjapyo manyate / kasmādalopāt / upekṣaṇaṃ varjanaṃ śāṇḍilyaḥ kasmādapāṭhāt

pṛthak nānetyarthaḥ / sāvitrīpādaiḥ savitā devatā yasyāḥ seyaṃ sāvitrī tasyāḥ pādaiḥ pibet / madhunā pṛktandadhipayaḥkṛtānnaṃ vā madhuparkaḥ / dadhani payasi vātha cākṛtānne madhu dadhyānmadhuparkametadāhuḥ / dadhimadhuśalileṣu saktavaḥ pṛthageveti vihitāstrayastu manthāḥ / tasya madhuparkasya pibet asyeti avayavalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī / kathaṃ pibedyathā śeṣaḥ syāditi / nanu sāvitrīpādairiti siddhe kiṃ pṛthak grahaṇamiti / ucyate / uktaṃ, savitṛdevatā sāvitrīti / evaṃ sarvāsāṃ savitṛdevatānāṃ prasaṅgaḥ prāptaḥ / ata ācāryaḥ pṛthakgrahaṇaṃ karoti / yasya ṛksamāmnāye pṛthagāmnānantayeti / nanu yadyevamarthaṃ na tasmān mukhyāṃ adya no vedetyetāṃ sāvitrīmutsṛjya gauṇīṃ gṛhṇīyāt / tanna, dvayameva mukhyā / kathaṃ mukhyeti cet / ucyate / athopasīdatyabhidhīhi bhoḥ sāvitroṃ me bhavānanubravītviti / asminnetasyā evānuvacanaṃ / tasyā uttarā ṛksamāmnāyābhivyakteśca sāvitrī caturthī bhavatītyetasyā eva śrutau vidhānaṃ / tathā śākhāntarīyāyāmathāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ śrutau etāmeva pratijānate / tasmāt pṛthakgrahaṇaṃ nānārthatvādevamuktaṃ

src: tatraitad āharanti viṣṭaraṃ pādaprakṣālanam arghyam ācamanīyaṃ madhuparkam iti
tgt: tatra tasmin madhuparkavidhau etadānayanti / viṣṭarādyāharaṇakarma kartavvaniyamārthaṃ bahuvacanaṃ / darbhāsanaṃ viṣṭaraḥ / pādaprakṣālanārthaṃ udakaṃ pādaprakṣālanaṃ / arghārtham udakamarghyaṃ / ācamanārtham udakam ācamanīyaṃ / madhuparka uktalakṣaṇaḥ / atha tatra grahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet / ucyate, madhumanthodamanthayor madhuparkakalpārthaṃ / te ca vakṣyante / tatra tatraitadāharanti viṣṭarādi
tasya madhuparkasya pibet / kathaṃ

src: idadannamayaṃ rasa imā gāvaḥ sahaśriyeti tu purastād ekaikasya
tgt: sāvitrīpādasyeti śeṣaḥ / tuśabdo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ

src: vāg bahu bahu me bhūyād iti prathamasyopariṣṭāt prāṇo vai vāco bhūyān bahur me bhūyo bhūyād iti dvitīyasya mano vāva sarvaṃ sarvaṃ me bhūyād iti tṛtīyasya
tgt: sāvitrīpādasyopariṣṭāditi varttate / prathamadvitīyatṛtīyagrahaṇaṃ caturthaniṣedhārthaṃ / tūṣṇīṃ caturthamiti prāpte
sarve bhakṣamantrāḥ svāhākārāntāḥ / svāhākārāntā iti bahuvacanāt siddheḥ kimarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇamiti cet ucyate / madhumanthādīnāmapi bhakṣamantrāḥ svāhākārāntāḥ syurityevamarthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ

src: raso 'si vānaspatyo rasaṃ mayi dhehīti madhumanthasya pibed iti gautamo vānaspatya iti pravacanaṃ
tgt: rasosi vānaspatya iti / anena mantreṇa madhumanthasya pibediti gautama ācārya āha / yaccoktaṃ viṣṭarādīni dravyāṇyekaikaśastristrirvedayeranniti, tatra madhumanthasyāvedane prāpte / vānaspatya iti pravacanamiti / vānaspatyo vānaspatya ityāvedanantriḥ

src: tathā dadhimanthodamanthayoḥ payasyopayasya iti tu rasādeśaḥ
tgt: yathā madhumanthasya tathā dadhimanthodamanthayoḥ pibet / tena prakāreṇetyarthaḥ / ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ / payasyopayasya iti tu rasādeśaḥ / vānaspatya ityetasya sthāne syātāmityarthaḥ / raso'si payasya rasosyopayasyaḥ, yathāsaṅkhyaṃ

src: ete naiva pravacane kālindaḥ sārasvata iti vā
tgt: ete eva pūrvokapravacane dadyāt / payasyopayasya iti / kālindaḥ sārasvata iti vā, yāthāsaṅkhyena
uktaṃ madhuparkasyetyavayavalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī kriyate / tatra pānamuktaṃ / atha śeṣe kā pratipattiriti / ucyate / śeṣaṃ brāhmaṇaya dadyāt putrādeḥ
śūdravarjaṃ / ucchiṣṭayogye putraśivyābhāve'dbhiḥ saṃprokṣya kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ
uktaṃ ācāntodakāya gauriti nāpitastrirbrūyāt / evaṃ gavi proktāyāṃ kuruteti brūyāt
kuruteti brūyādevaṃ vā

udgātṛkarmoktaṃ / atha sarveṣāṃ sādhāraṇamucyate / sarveṣāmudgātṛṇāṃ yajñopavītañca udakācamanañca ete ca nitye karma kurvatāṃ evaṃ yajñopavītī bhavatyevamācāntodako bhavatīti / yajñopavītañca udakapūrṇañca kamaṇḍalu / ācamanti tasmādityācamanaṃ / yajñopavītanityatve brahmacaryaṃ jñāpayati / atha sarvagrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ / ucyate / subrahmaṇyaṃ caturthānāṃ brahmapañcamānāṃ yajamānaṣaṣṭhānāṃ sambandhastadarthaṃ grahaṇaṃ
na vyavāyaḥ avyavāyaḥ, na vyāvṛttiḥ avyāvṛttiḥ, antarāgamanaṃ vyavāyaḥ, anabhimukhatā vyāvṛttiḥ / kenāvyavāyo'vyāvṛttiśca yajñāṅgaiḥ karmopayatāmiti varttate
prāṅmukhakaraṇamādeśādanyatra syāt, ādeśaḥ pratyaṅmukhastiṣṭhaṃśchirasi gāyatraṅgāyediti / caśabdaḥ samuccayārthaḥ, avyavāyo'vyāvṛttiśca yajñāṅgairanādeśa iti

src: krīte rājani subrahmaṇya uttareṇa somavahanaṃ gatvāntareṇeṣe śamīśākhāṃ palāśaśākhāṃ vā sapalāśāṃ pāṇau kṛtvāvatiṣṭheta
tgt: uktaṃ prahiṇuyāt prastotṛsubrahmaṇyai purastātkarmabhya iti / tatra subrahmaṇyaṃ karma vivakṣuridaṃ sūtramārabhate, krīte rājani subrahmaṇya iti / atha kasmāt karmabhedaḥ kriyate, prastotrīyaṃ tāvadvaktavyaṃ pūrvvaṃ tārkṣyasāmādīnāmityatrāha kṛtākṛtatvāt tārkṣyasāmādīnāṃ kramabheda iti / krīte rājani krīte some, subrahmaṇya iti kartṛnirdeśaḥ uttareṇa somavahanaṃ gatvā uttareṇeti diṅniyamaḥ, gatveti kriyopadeśaḥ / antareṇeṣe somavahaneṣayorantarāle śamīśākhāṃ palāśaśākhāṃ vā sapalāśāṃ dakṣiṇena pāṇinā gṛhītvāvatiṣṭheta
saṃpreṣaṇaṃ saṃpreṣaḥ tam ākāṅkṣet tāvatpratīkṣeta yāvat saṃpreṣaṇamiti sarvatra grahaṇaṃ sarvāsu subrahmaṇyāsu na kevalaṃ śākaśvyāmiti

raśmī abhīśū pragrahāvityarthaḥ dhārayan savyena pāṇinā śākhayā dakṣiṇena pāṇinā gṛhītayā prasthāpayet gāvau somavahanayuktau dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvam, dakṣiṇasyāṃ dhuri yo yuktasta pūrvaṃ paścāduttaramityarthaḥ

src: subrahmaṇyom iti trir āhvayet prāci vartamāne
tgt: prāṅmukhe varttamāne subrahmaṇyomiti praṇavaṃ trirbrūyāt, varttatirgatyarthaḥ
pratyaṅmukhe varttamāne ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ praṇavaṃ brūyāditi varttate

src: pūrveṇa patnīśālāṃ vimukte chadiṣi śākhām avaguhya tām evaiṣām anūtkramya yathārthaṃ syāt
tgt: patnīśālāyāḥ pūrvapradeśe vimukte arddhavimukte sati chadiṣi cchādanakaṭe śākhām avaguhya avalambya tāmevaiṣāmanūtkramya avatīryya tato yathārthaṃ syāditi karmaṇaḥ samāptiṃ darśayati
dakṣiṇasyāṃ dhuri yo yukto'navān taṃ subrahmaṇyāya dadyāt yajamānaḥ sāmarthyāt

ubhāvaṣyanaḍvāhau deyāviti śāṭyāyanake śrutiḥ karmasaṃyogāt ubhābhyāṃ hi karma kṛtaṃ hetūpādānaṃ kriyate karmayogāditi yasya yena karmasaṃyogaḥ sa taddravyaṃ labhatityarthaḥ / yasmin karmaṇi yaddravyaṃ yasya sannihitaṃ bhavet / tattasyaiva pradātavyaṃ hoturgotrapaṭo yathā

src: ātithyāyāṃ saṃsthitāyāṃ dakṣiṇasya dvārabādoḥ parastāt tiṣṭhann antarvedideśe 'nvārabdhe yajamāne patnyāṃ ca subrahmaṇyom iti trir uktvā nigadaṃ brūyād indrāgaccha hariva āgaccha medhātither meṣavṛṣaṇaśvasya mene gaurāvaskandinn ahalyāyai jāra kauśika brāhmaṇa gautama bruvāṇaitāvad ahe sutyām iti yāvad ahe syāt
tgt: uktā śākaṭī subrahmaṇyā subrahmaṇyomiti trirāhvayet prāci vartamāne ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ pratīcīti praṇavamātrakriyoktā idānīṃ tasyāḥ kāladeśakriyāvidhayo vivakṣitāḥ, tān vivakṣurācārya idaṃ sūtramārabhate, ātithyāyāṃ saṃsthitāyāmiti / ātithyā iṣṭiḥ tasyāṃ saṃsthitāyāṃ samāptāyāmityarthaḥ dakṣiṇasya dvārabāhoḥ patnīśālāyāḥ pūrve pradeśe tiṣṭhan / kathaṃ gamyate patnīśālāyā dvārasyeti ucyate, sambandhādātithyāyāṃ saṃsthitāyāmiti pūrveṇa patnīśālāyāṃ tiṣṭhannityūrddhvatā vidhīyate / antarvedideśe prakṛtaṃ vedikaraṇaṃ bhavatyato deśa ityāha / anvārabdhe yajamāne patnyāñca, anvārambhaṅaṃ sparśanam, saptamī kriyate yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇamiti samāsaḥ kramārthaḥ / subrahmaṇyomiti triḥ praṇavamuktvā nigadaṃ brūyāt / indrāgacchetyetadādinigadagrahaṇaṃ saṃvyavahārārtham vakṣyatyagniṣṭutvāgneyo nigada iti / etāvadahe sutyāmiti yāvadahe syāditi etāvadityatra sutyā nirdeśyā yāvadbhirahobhiḥ sutyā, tāvadbhiḥ parigaṇanāṃ kṛtvā nirdeśaḥ kāryyaḥ

yasminnahani sutyā bhavati tasminnahany adyeti brūyāt, samānāhanīti kimarthamadyeti sutyāmiti siddheḥ, ucyate, kadāpyekasminnahani kṛtsnaṃ karma kriyate, tasminnapi adya sutyetyevaṃ brūyāt, ko'sya viṣayaḥ / sādyaktāḥ
sutyādeśānantarametadbrūyāt ityevaṃ gautama ācāryya āha
evaṃ dhānañjaya ācāryo manyate
eke ācāryyaḥ pūrvaṃ devāhvānānmanyante
avasyādityarthaḥ, virāmo'vasānam
etayośca padayorviramet
āgneyyāṃ subrahmaṇyāyāṃ etau ca virāmau ṣaṇṇe jāre ceti
viramediti vartate pṛthaṅnānetyarthaḥ, yajate śabdeṣu ceti ukte kiṃ pṛthaggrahaṇamiti cet ucyate, pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahaśabdānāṃ ca samāmo mābhūditi
anena prakāreṇa triḥ kriyā subrahmaṇyāyāḥ
āhūyeti vidhigṛhyate, evaṃ trirāhūya yajamānaṃ vācayati
patnī ca yajamānaśca patnīyajamānau tāvupavahavaṃ kāmamāṇau subrahmaṇyophvayasvetyevaṃ brūyātāṃ upahvānamupahavaḥ
subrahmaṇyo yācita upahavaṃ dadyāt, kaḥ punarupahavaḥ upahūta ityupahavaḥ ayamupahavaprakāraḥ
ṛjyarthaḥ
bahuvacanasāmarthyāt tatsiddheḥ sarvagrahaṇaṃ nirarthakamiti cet tat kathaṃ pratīṣṭiṣu syāditi upasadgrahaṇādiṣṭidvaye upasatpratyayo mābhūditi

src: yāś cordhvam upasadbhya utkare tu tatra tiṣṭhan
tgt: yāścorddhvamupasadadbhyaścādekṣyanta subrahmaṇyāstāsāmapyeṣa eva vidhiḥ ayantu viśeṣaḥ, utkare tu tatra tiṣṭhanniti, tiṣṭhanniti vaktavye tatra grahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet ucyate, mābhūt samīpasaptamī pratyaya iti ārūḍhe notkare vaktavyā / apara āha utkare cāha tatra tiṣṭhanniti hi brāhmaṇaṃ tasmādutkare tiṣṭhan subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇyāmāhvayatīti
evaṃ caitā utkare bhavanti kiñca prāk sutyādeśānnāmagrāho bhavati etāvadahe sutyāmiti prāgasmādvacanāt

src: agnīṣomīyavapāyāṃ hutāyām parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣu prātaranuvākopakramavelāyām asau yajata iti pratyekaṃ gṛhṇīyād yajamānanāmadheyāny amuṣya putraḥ pautro napteti pūrveṣām
tgt: agnīṣomīyasya paśorvapāyāṃ hutāyāṃ vasatīvarī pariharaṇe kṛte prātaranuvākasya ārambhaṇavelāyāṃ yajamānanāmadheyāni gṛhṇīyāt pratyekam ekamekaṃ prati pratyekam asāviti sarvvanāmnā yajamānasya nāmadheyāni yajamānanāmadheyānīti bahuvacanaṃ kriyate tatsambandhena sarvāṇyetāni pitṛprabhṛtīni yajamānanāmadheyāni / apara āha nakṣatrāśca yaṃ nityaṃ tṛtīyaṃ yattadguhyameva bhavati / sarvanāmnaḥ sthāne pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahānāṃ nāmadheyāni gṛhṇīyāt amuṣya putraḥ pautro napteti yathāsaṃkhyam / yathāmuṣya putraḥ pautro naptetyeteṣāṃ pūrvatve siddhe pūrveṣāmiti kimarthamārabhyate, ucyate, ekaśeṣavidhiprajñāpanārthaṃ, kathamekaśedho gṛhyata iti pūrveṣāṃ ca pūrvāsāṃ ca

athānantaramavareṣāṃ nāmāni gṛhṇīyāt avare putrapautraprapautrāḥ kathametadgamyate teṣāmapi trayāṇāmeveti athaśabdasāmarthyāt yathājyeṣṭham yo jyeṣṭhaḥ yathājyeṣṭham utpattikramataḥ kimaviśeṣeṇa na jīveyuḥ

janiṣyamāṇānāmiti siddhe uteti kimarthamārabhyate, ucyate, pṛthagyajate śabdeṣu ca viramedityuktam tadihāpi prāptaṃ tannivṛttyartham ucyate samāsena pitṛpitāmahaprapitāmahaśabdaṃ kṛtvā yajata iti brūyāt

yāgnīṣomīyavapā homānantarakālā subrahmaṇyā sā sādyaḥkteṣu luptā lopaḥ kriyate, atha sāmarthyādeva lope prāpte nimittāpāye naimittikasyāpyapāya iti sūtraṃ kimarthamārabhyate, atrocyate, tisraḥ sanniyogaśiṣṭāḥ sanāmagrāhāḥ tāsāṃ sanniyogaśiṣṭānāṃ satīnāṃ pūrvasyāḥ lope uttarayorapi lopo gamyate / sanniyogaśiṣṭānāmanyatamāpāye'pāya iti, apara āha pratinidhau mābhūditi, sādyaḥkteṣvagnīṣomīyasya paśoḥ sthāne agnīṣomīyaṃ puroḍāśaṃ nirvapatīti, athoddeśanirdeśau kimarthamiti cet, atrocyate, sūtrakārasyāyamabhiprāyaḥ saiva luptā / anyatra nimittāpāye'pi naimittikāni bhavantīti / yathā santatiṣvaprastāvāsvapi kuśāvidhānamiti

subrahmaṇyāyāḥ sārvakratuko vidhiruktaḥ, sāmprataṃ viśeṣo vivakṣitastaṃ vivakṣurācārya āha, agniṣṭutsvāgneyo nigada iti / agniṣṭutsu yajñeṣu āgneyo nigado bhavati agnirdevatā asyetyāgneyaḥ, nigadaśca uktalakṣaṇaḥ agniṣṭutsvāgneyeti vaktavye nigada iti kathaṃ nigadasyaiva pratyāmnānaṃ syānnetarasyeti

src: tatra gautamīyam agna āgaccha rohitāyāṃ bṛhadbhāno dhūmaketo jātavedo vicarṣaṇa āṅgirasa brāhmaṇāṅgirasa bruvāṇeti prāk sutyādeśāt
tgt: tatra tasminnityarthaḥ / gautamasyedaṃ gautamīyam / agna āgacchetyetadādirnigadaḥ / prāk sutyādeśāt etāvadahe sutyāmiti prāgasmāt
devānāṃ sthāne agnaya iti brūyāt

src: atha dhānañjapyo 'gna āgaccha rohitava āgaccha bharadvājasyājasahasaḥ sūno vārāvaskandinn uṣaso jāretyāṅgirasaprabhṛti samānam
tgt: athaśabda ānantarye gautamīyo vidhiruktaḥ, āgneyī ca subrahmaṇyoktā / tatrāyaṃ dhānañjapyokto viśeṣaḥ agna āgaccha rohitava ityetadādiḥ prāk sutyādeśāditi vartate, kiñca

src: indraṃ śakreti brūyād viśva iti devān anirukteṣu
tgt: āgneyī subrahmaṇyoktā / sāmprataṃ anirukta ucyate, śakrāgaccheti viśve brahmāṇa ityevaṃ brūyāt, anirukteṣu upahavyādiṣu / āniruktyaṃ devatānāmadheyaṃ pārokṣyam

evam eva subrahmaṇyā syāt, aniruktaṃ prātaḥsavanaṃ yasya so'niruktaprātaḥsavanaḥ aniruktaprātaḥsavanaścāniruktaprātaḥsavanacāniruktaprātaḥsavanau tayoraniruktaprātaḥsavanayoḥ kathaṃ punargamyate, yathāyaṃ bahuvrīhiḥ samāsaḥ / atha punarayaṃ tatpuruṣaḥ kalpeteti / yadi hyayaṃ bahuvrīhirabhaviṣyat muktasaṃśayameva sūtramabhaviṣyat / aniruktāpūrvavājapeyeṣviti / evaṃ kriyamāṇe evaṃ sūtram abhaviṣyat / samāse ca saṃśayo nābhaviṣyat / yena punarayaṃ pṛthaksūtramārabhyate, aniruktaprātaḥsavanayośceti jñāpayati tatpuruṣaḥ samāsa iti aniruktañca tat prātaḥsavanaṃ cāniruktaprātaḥsavanamiti / tenāpūrvavājapeyayoḥ prātaranuvākopakramaṇakālaiva subrahmaṇyā niruktā syāditi ucyate, na ṛtusambandha evāyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ taducyate muktasaṃśayaṃ sūtramabhaviṣyat evaṃ cet aniruktāpūrvavājapeyeṣviti evaṃ kriyamāṇe sūtra ityatra brūmaḥ, yadyevaṃ sūtramabhaviṣyat, vājapeyavicārāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ prasaṅgo'bhaviṣyadevaṃ mābhūdityata āha, aniruktaprātaḥsavanayośceti

abhiṣecanīyaśca daśapeyaśca abhiṣecanīyadaśapeyau tāvantareṇa yāḥ subrahmaṇyāḥ tāḥ sarvāḥ sanāmagrāhāḥ antarāntareṇa yukta iti dvitīyā bhavati / sadāgrahaṇaṃ matrādyapekṣyam, apare bruvate nāmagrahaṇamātramevāstviti na nigadaḥ

dvirātraprabhṛtiṣvahargaṇeṣu ahnaḥ ādau cānte cāhvayet / atha kimarthamidamārabhyate, vidyamāne āhvānanimitte pratyahaṃ vastīvarīpariharaṇe prātaranuvāke ca / ucyate, vakṣyatyayam ekāṣṭakādīkṣiṇa upasarginaste tūṣṇīmekatriṃśamaharāsīran savanavidhena vā paśunā yajeranniti, yatrāpi kathaṃ syāditi
yā ahnaḥ ante subrahmaṇyā sottarārthā, uttarārthamahargaṇeṣvaharādyantayorāhvayediti / atrātirātrānte prāptā tatpratisedhārthamārabhyate, uttarārthā harantikīti

agnīṣomīyādi yatkarma ahīneṣu tasmin yāḥ subrahmaṇyāḥ tāḥ sarvāḥ sanāmagrāhāḥ syuḥ / nanu agnīṣomīyaprabhṛtayaḥ sanāmagrāhā eva bhavanti, tat kimidam agnīṣomīyaprabhṛtītyārabhyate, ucyate, vakṣyatyayaṃ sarvāḥ sanāmagrāhā iti / yadyayamagnīṣomīyaprabhṛtīti na brūyāt, tadā śākaṭyā ārabhya sarvāḥ sanāmagrāhāḥ syuḥ, sarvā iti vacanāt, na hi tadasti yadvacanānna bhavati / vacanasyātibhāro nāsti vacanamupalabdhuṃ śakyate / athāhīnagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet, aikāhiko vidhiruktaḥ / sātriko vacyate, dīkṣānupūrveṇa dīkṣitānāṃ satreṣu nāmagrāha ityata ārabhya tadevamubhayatrokte viśeṣa ucyamānaḥ pratyākhyāyāhīnādanyatra na syāt / tathā ca sūtre uktam, ekāhāhīnasatrāṇīti caturthī somajātirnāsti / ata eva siddhe'hīnagrahaṇaṃ na kartavyam, kriyamāṇe kāraṇaṃ vaktavyam / ucyate, kartavyamahīnagrahaṇam, akriyamāṇe mukhyāhīnaśabdo gṛhyate ye'hīnakāṇḍe paṭhitāsta eva gṛhyeran mukhyatvāt gauṇamukhyayormukhye sampratyaya iti kṛtvā so'yamācāryo'hīnagrahaṇaṃ karoti / ye'pyahīnakāṇḍe na paripaṭhitāḥ / yathā varuṇapraghāsadvidivasākamedhatryahavyuṣṭirdvirātra iti / dvādaśāhīnaścāhīnabhūtaḥ katham eteṣu sarveṣu eṣa vidhiḥ syādityato'rthamahīnagrahaṇam

src: viśvarūpāś ced gāyet jyotīṃṣy api gāyet
tgt: yadi viśvarūpā gāyet tataḥ jyotīṃṣyapi gāyet, nanu kimarthaṃ punarayaṃ yadyarthaḥ kriyate cediti yadā viśvarūpāṇāṃ gānaṃ yatnena pratiṣṭhāpitamiti ucyate, ayaṃ hyācāryo vacyati etaṃ parikramaṃ sarvakratuṣu vidyāditi, tad viśvarūpāṇaṃ gānaṃ sarvakratuṣu prāpnoti so 'yamācāryyaḥ jyotiṣṭomādanyatra viśvarūpāṇaṃ gānaṃ jñāpayati kathaṃ etat viśvarūpāṇaṃ gānaṃ jyotiṣṭoma eva pravarttate nānyatreti nanu vakṣyatyācāryo na cānyatra viśvarūpāt jyotiṣṭomāditi satyametat asya tu punarvacanasya tatraiva prayojanaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ kaḥ punarjyotirganasya kālo gānavidhiśceti

src: parihite prātaranuvāke yo naptrīyaṃ nāma sūktaṃ purā tasmāddhotāram āramayitvāgrayaṇasya vānuhiṃkāraṃ pavitraṃ dhārayan nāstāvaṃ vā prāpya stomayogād agnir jyotir jyotir agnir indro jyotir jyotir indraḥ sūryo jyotir jyotiḥ sūrya ity eteṣu padeṣu tris trir ekaikam abhyāsaṃ manasā gāyatraṃ gāyet
tgt: parihite samāpte prātaranuvāke paridhānīyāyāṃ śastāyāmityarthaḥ aponaptrīyaṃ nāma śastaṃ tasmātpūrvaṃ purā viramyatāṃ tāvadityuktvā āgrayaṇasya vānuhiṅkāraṃ āgrayaṇo grahaḥ tasya gṛhītasya hiṃkārasya paścāt āgrayaṇaṃ gṛhannadhvaryurhiṃkaroti pavitraṃ dhārayan pavitraṃ vigṛhṇanti hastakāryyameva tad yajñasya kriyata iti āstāvaṃ vā prāpya purā bahiṣpavamānasya stomayogāt etatkālatrayamupadiṣṭaṃ jyotirgānasya vikalpena agnirjyotirjyotiragnirityeteṣu yathāsūtriteṣu padeṣu ekaikasmin pade tristrirgāyatraṃ gāyet abhyasyābhyasya abhyāsam

src: uttarāddhavirdhānāt dhruvasthālīṃ harantaḥ paścimenodgātṝn hṛtvā tenaiva pratihareyuḥ
tgt: grahagrahaṇādhikāro varttate, gṛhīteṣu sarveṣu graheṣu dhruvo gṛhyate tatrodgātṛsambandhaṃ kañcidvivakṣurāha, uttarāddhavirddhānāditi havirddhānasaṃjñake dve anasī dakṣiṇaṃ uttarañca tatrottarāddhavirddhānāditi apādānalakṣaṇā pañcamī havirasminnidhīyata iti havirddhānam dhruvo nāma grahaḥ sthālyāṃ gṛhyate tāṃ dhruvasthālīṃ harantaḥ udgātṛṇāṃ paścimena pradeśena hṛtvā gṛhīte some tenaiva punarnayeyuḥ avyavāyārthaṃ nityaṃ parakartṛkeṣu bahuvacanaṃ nainānapareṇa hareyurapi hyakuśalā adhvaryavo bhavantīti
havirdhānāt niṣkrāmantam adhvaryuṃ prastotā santanuyāt uttarīyaikadeśe gṛhṇīyāt avichedārtham
taṃ prastotāraṃ udgātā santanuyāt
santanuyāditi varttate
taṃ pratiharttāraṃ brahmā santanuyāt
santanuyāditi varttate vicchede hi prāyaścittaśravaṇātsarve santatā bhavanti
sāmpratameteṣāmājyahomo vakṣyate taiśca somaḥ pūyamānaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ ata āha na rājānamālabhyānupaspṛśyāpa ājyamālabheranniti
tathājyam ālabhyānupaspṛśyāpaḥ somaṃ nālabheran sarvaśabdaḥ ṛte 'pyājyālambhāt anupaspṛśyāpo naiva somamālabheran

src: adhvaryuṇā hute pravṛttahomau juhuyur gatyānupūrvyeṇa bekurānāmāsi sūryometi
tgt: adhvaryuṇā hute pravṛttahomau juhuyuḥ pravṛttahomāviti saṃjñā gatyānupūrvyeṇāpi prastotā prathamo 'tisarpet tata udgātā tataḥ pratihartteti gatyānupūrvye bekurānāmāsīti prathamāṃ sūryometi dvitīyāṃ atha gatyānupūrvyeti kimidaṃ yāvatā ihāpyānupūryamuktam evaṃ adhvaryuṃ nikrāmantaṃ prastotā santanuyāttamudgātodgātāraṃ pratihartteti home 'pyetadevānupūryaṃ grahīṣyate vyatikramahetvasambhavāt atrocyate, gatyārambheṇa anyo'pi yo homaḥ tatrāpi gatyānupūrvyameva syāt yathā āgnidhrīye dve āhutī juhuyuriti

src: saṃsutasome tv adhikām udgātā juhuyāt saṃveśāyopaveśāyeti yathāsavanaṃ chandāṃsy ādiśan
tgt: yadi somau saṃsutau syātāmityevamadhikṛtyāha, susamiddhe hotavyamagnirvai sarvā devatāḥ sarvā eva devatāḥ paśyan juhoti saṃveśāyopaveśāyeti chandodevatyāstisra āhutayaśca ucyante tāsāṃ kālo vivakṣitaḥ hotā ca ata āha, saṃsutasome tu pravṛttahomau hutvā adhikāmāhutimudgātā juhuyāt saṃveśāyopaveśāyeti yathāsavanaṃ chandāṃsyādiśan yatra yasmin savane yathāsavanam tuśabdaḥ chandoviśeṣaṇārthaḥ adhikagrahaṇaṃ pravṛttahomayoḥ pratyāmnāyo mābhūditi

src: ṛcaṃ sāmeti svāhākārāntayā tṛtīyāṃ sarvatra sa eveti śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: ṛcaṃ sometyetayarcā svāhākārāntayā tṛtīyāmāhutiṃ juhuyāt udgātā sarvatra saṃsutasome ca sa evodgātā juhuyāt netarau tṛtīyāmāhu̍tim

mahāgiriḥ mahān parvataḥ mahānadī mahatī nadī rathāhaḥ rathasyāhnāgamaḥ vāyurdevatāviśeṣaḥ etairvyavāye asaṃsavaḥ saṃsavo na bhavati pūrvapaścimavātairvāyuvyavāyo gṛhyate anyathā sarvadā sambhavāt vyavāyaśabdaḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate
pṛthagjanapade tu punaḥ punaravyavāye'pi mahāgiryādibhiḥ saṃsavo na bhavati pṛthagjanapadaḥ pañcālāḥ kuravaḥ matsyā iti
avidviṣāṇamātrādevāsaṃsava ityeke ācāryā manyante

src: hutvā japeyur brahmāhaṃ gāyatrīṃ vācaṃ prāṇaṃ prajāpatiṃ prapadye 'śmānam ākhaṇaṃ paryūha iti
tgt: yadā sarvairhutaṃ bhavati atha brahmāhaṃ gāyatrīṃ vācamityetadyajurjapeyuḥ
yathādhvaryurāvartteta tathaiva āvartteran avyavāyo'vyāvṛttī nādriyeransarpanta ityārabhyate, uttarayorapi savanayorevameva syāditi

src: savyaiḥ pāṇibhiḥ pṛthag dakṣiṇā tṛṇāni nirasyeyur yo 'dya saumya iti
tgt: kiñcidgatvā savyairvāmaiḥ pāṇibhistaiḥ pṛthaṅnānā dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi tṛṇāni nirasyeyuḥ nirāśaḥ prakṣepaḥ yo'dya saumya ityanena yajuṣā

src: cātvāladeśaṃ prāpyādhvaryāv upaviṣṭe tasmāt pratyag upaviśeyur yo ma ātmeti
tgt: cātvālasannikṛṣṭo deśaḥ taṃ prāpyādhvaryāvupaviṣṭe tasmādadhvaryoḥ paścime deśe upaviśeyuryoma ātmetyetadādinā yajuṣā
prastotā pratyaṅmukha upaviśet
prastotaryupaviṣṭe anantaramudgātā udaṅmukha upaviśet

src: paścimenodgātāraṃ gatvā dakṣiṇapūrvam aṣṭamadeśam īkṣamāṇaḥ pratihartā
tgt: udgātāramupaviṣṭaṃ paścimena gatvā pratihartā dakṣiṇapūrvamaṣṭamadigbhāgamīkṣamāṇaḥ upaviśet

src: savyādharān upasthān kṛtvā dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ sandhimokṣamāṇāḥ samāni mukhāni dhārayantaḥ
tgt: savyān vāmānupasthān ūrūn adharān kṛtvā dyauśca pṛthivī ca dyāvāpṛthivyau tayoḥ dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ sandhimīkṣamāṇaḥ samāni mukhāni dhārayantaḥ manaḥsamādhyartham

yo'yaṃ vidhiruktaḥ pratyaṅmukhaḥ prastotetyata ārabhya samāni mukhāni dhārayanta iti yāvat naiṣa bahiṣpavamānamadhikṛtyoktaḥ ataḥ sarvastrotreṣu bhavati kuta etat yasmādvakṣyatyetatsarvaṃ kuryāduttarayoḥ pavamānayoriti ata āhevaṃ sarvastotreṣvāsīranniti, nanu yadyevaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ na kāryaṁ evaṃ stotreṣvāsīranniti siddheḥ uccate, vakṣyati hi evaṃ parikramaṃ sarvakratuṣu vidyāditi pāṭhāntare caiṣa jyotiḥ sarve kāmā iti evaṃ jyotiṣaṃ darśayati evaṃ parikramaṃ sarvakratuṣu vidyāditi jyotiṣaṃ sarvakratuṣu vidhyantaraṃ darśayati vakṣyati ca tadanantaraṃ ṣoḍaśī sāmnā stoṣyamāṇa iti trisaṃsthe'pi jyotiṣṭome prakṛtibhūte ṣoḍaśī nāsti atra ṣoḍaśinyeṣa vidhirna prāpnoti aprākṛtatvāt vikṛtaḥ ṣoḍaśī tathā mānasādiṣu naimittikeṣu ca na prāpnoti ata āha sarvastotreṣvāsīranniti
udgātṝṇāṃ paścime pradeśe avarārddhyā upagāḥ syuḥ avarārddhyaśabdaḥ nikṛṣṭavacanaḥ trayāṇāmapyadho na bhavantītyarthaḥ
eke caturavarārdyānmanyante na tasyopadeśaḥ digbhirevodgāyantīti atha parārddhyāḥ kiyanta upagātāra iti ṣaṭ parārddhyā iti

src: ta etenākṣareṇopagāyeyur ho iti mandrasvareṇa santataṃ sahavācyeṣv āramantaḥ
tgt: yadi tryavarārddhyā yadi caturavarārddhyā yadi ṣaṭparārddhyāḥ ta etenākṣareṇopagāyeyurho iti mandrasvareṇa santatam avichinnaṃ yānyudgātṝṇāṃ sahavācyāni teṣu virameyurupagātāraḥ sahavācyāni nidhanāni atha upagāyeyurho iti siddheḥ etenākṣareṇeti kimarthamārabhyate ucyate, sūtrāntaramārabhate api copagātṝṇaṃ bhaktimudgātāra eva kuryuriti etasmin kalpe'pyetenaivākṣareṇeti
tasmāt mandrāt vyantareṇotkṛṣṭenodgātāraḥ stuyuḥ svare svare saptayavāntarāṇītyantaraparimāṇaṃ tasmāt tryantareṇa stuyuḥ
upagātṛsvaratulyena vā prātaḥsavane stuyuḥ mandreṇetyarthaḥ
mandrād ekāntareṇa vā stuyuḥ

src: prastaraṃ pratigṛhya prastotā brahma stoṣyāmaḥ praśāstar ity udgātre prayacchet
tgt: uktamevaṃ sarvastotreṣvāsīranniti anantaramadhvaryuḥ prastaraṃ prastotre prayacchati somaḥ pavata ityanena yajuṣā tataḥ paraṃ adhvaryoḥ sakāśāt pratigṛhya prastotā brahman stoṣyāmaḥ praśāstarityanena yajuṣā udgātre prayachet prastaramiti karmaṇi dvitīyā pratigṛhyeti dīyamānaṃ gṛhītvā prastoteti kartṛnirdeśaḥ prayachediti kriyopadeśaḥ prastaro darbhamuṣṭiḥ uktam adhvaryuḥ prastaraṃ haratīti tasmādadhvaryuṇā prastara īṣadiva vidhūyo vidhūtamiva hi tṛṇampaśava upāvarttanta iti

src: tena dakṣiṇāṃ jaṅghām upahatya yuñjyāt stomam agnes tejaseti
tgt: etena prastareṇa udgātā dakṣiṇāṃ jaṅghāṃ spṛṣṭvā yuñjyāt stomamagnestejaseti etadādinā yajuṣā prastaramāsādyogāyeddhaviṣo'skandāya yajamānaṃ tu svargalokādavagṛhṇātītyuktvāha aṣṭhīvato'paspṛśatodgeyantenāsya haviraskannaṃ bhavati na yajamānaṃ svargalokādavagṛhṇātītyataḥ sūtrakāraḥ tena dakṣiṇāṃ jaṅghāmupahatyetyāha
yuktvā stomamanantaram annaṃ kariṣyāmītyetadādi yajurjapet
tūṣṇīṃ amantrakamityarthaḥ sarve udgātāraḥ tūṣṇīñcātvālamudapātraṃ cāvekṣeran|| 4 ||
sāmāsi pratimābhāhītyanena yajuṣā ādityamavekṣeranniti varttate
yajuṣā vā ādityamavekṣeran tūṣṇīṃ veti vikalpayati

atrocyate, sakṛditi kimarthamārabhyate, yadā tāvaduktaṃ navabhiḥ stuvanti hiṅkāro daśamo daśākṣarā virāḍiti ucyate ayaṃ hi trivṛtstomakaṃ bahiṣpavamānamadhikṛtya vidhirārabhyate virāṭ sampadarthaṃ yatra punaḥ stomavṛddhiḥ syāt anekasāmānekadaivataṃ vā bahiṣpavamānaṃ syāt tatra hiṅkāraṃ prati saṃśayaḥ syāt kiñca pratisāma pratidaivataṃ vā syāditi, ato'yamācāryo yatnamārabhate sakṛddhiṃkṛtya bahiṣpavamānena stuvīranniti / atha bahiṣpavamānagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet atrocyate, vakṣyatyayaṃ etatsarvaṃ kuryāduttarayoḥ pavamānayoriti tatrāpi sakṛdeva hiṅkāraḥ prāpnoti naitat tatra hyayaṃ vakṣyati sāmne sāmne hiṃkuryuriti atrocyate, na hyekavidhau pratyāmnāyo gamyate vikalpaḥ pratīyate ato'yamācāryo yatnamārabhate bahiṣpavamāneneti
ahiṃkṛtā prathamā stotrīyā sthādbahiṣpavamāne tasyāḥ saṃvyavahārikīyaṃ saṃjñā retasyeti vakṣyati hi retasyaikatrikasya bahiṣpavamānamiti
retasyā yāḥ parāḥ stotrīyāḥ tāsu hiṅkāraḥ syāditi
rathantaravarṇo yasyā seyaṃ rathantaravarṇā sā cottamā bahiṣpavamānasya syāt avisṛṣṭahiṅkārā ca syāt hiṅkāro na visṛjyate ākāro visargaḥ

src: tasyā ūrdhvaṃ prastāvāc catvāry akṣarāṇy abhiṣṭobhet
tgt: tasyā rathantaravarṇāyā ūrddhvaṃ prastāvāccatvāryakṣarāṇi rathantaravadabhiṣṭobhet
annamakaramityetadādi yajurjapedudgātā ekaśrutividhānāt
śyeno'sītyetadādi yajuḥ prastare'dhikaraṇe yajamānaṃ vācayet ālabdhaprastaraṃ anutvārabhe iti liṅgāt
taṃ yajamānaṃ sarvastotreṣu stutvopahvayeran sarvagrahaṇaṃ na kevalaṃ bahiṣpavamāne upahava uktalakṣaṇaḥ

src: saṃ varcasetīkṣakān sahakāriṇaś ca prekṣamāṇo japet
tgt: saṃ varcasetyetadādi yajuḥ ye tatrekṣakāḥ ye cāsya sahakāriṇaḥ tān prekṣamāṇo japet
namo gandharvāyetyetadādi yajurādityamīkṣamāṇo japet

antarhitaścedādityaḥ syāt deśenaivāvekṣet ko'sya viṣayaḥ sadasi bahiṣpavamānena stuvanti tatprakaraṇe kimarthamiti cet ucyate, anyatrāpi deśenaiva subhūrasītyādityamupatiṣṭheran udvayantamasasyarīti ca etadarthaṃ darśayati

vakṣyatyayaṃ yathāsavanamupaviśya prastotā havirddhānaṃ gacchenmadhyandine hutaṃ ādityagrahe pratiharttā bhava iti yo'yaṃ havirddhānaṃ gacchet sa eva kuryāduttarayoḥ pavamānayoḥ viṣṇoḥ śira ityata ārabhya sarvagrahaṇaṃ niravaśeṣavāci evamatiprasakte bravīti

src: pravarās tu nivartante cātvālāvekṣaṇaprabhṛti ca prāgghiṃkārāt
tgt: agniḥ prastotāhaṃ mānuṣa ityetadādayaḥ pravarā nivarttante tūṣṇīṃ cātvālamudapātraṃ cāvekṣeranniti etadādi yatkarma tat sarvaṃ prāgghiṅkārānnivarttate

praveśanañca sammārjanañca praveśanasammārjane iṣa urja iti praveśanaṃ vasavastveti sammārjanantayoḥ praveśanasammārjanayoḥ antarāle yatkarma tṛtīyasavane tacca sarvannivarttate caśabdāt pūrvasūtroktañca

src: kumbhaṃ tu tatra saṃmṛjyād uttare havirdhāne yaḥ pūrvo droṇakalaśāvṛtā
tgt: tatra tṛtīyasavane kumbhasya sammārjanaṃ kuryāt na droṇakalaśasya tuśabdo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ uttare havirddhānasaṃjñake'nasi yaḥ pūrvasthāpitaḥ taṃ sammṛjyāt na paścimaṃ droṇakalaśāvṛtā yo droṇakalaśamamārjanavidhiḥ tena sammārjanavidhinā āvṛtparikramo vidhiriti samānārthaḥ

src: taṃ pūtabhṛd ity ācakṣate taṃ pūtabhṛd ity ācakṣate
tgt: taṃ kumbhaṃ yo'sau pūrvaḥ taṃ pūtabhṛdityevamācakṣate ete pūtabhṛdāhavanīyayorapyadhikāraṃ manyanta iti

src: vihāraṃ dhānañjapyo 'gnes tejasā bṛhaspatis tveti prātaḥsavana indriyasyendriyeṇa bṛhaspatis tveti mādhyandine sūryasyeti tṛtīyasavane
tgt: asminneva stomayojane mantre yāḥ samastāstisro devatā āmnātāstāsāmanusavanaṃ vikṛtāṃ kriyāṃ dhānañjapyo manyate taducyate, agnestejasā bṛhaspatistvā yunaktviti prātaḥsavane indrasyendriyeṇa bṛhaspatistvā yunaktviti mādhyandine sūryasya varcasā bṛhaspatistvā yunaktviti tṛtīyasavane
sarvairebhirekaikaṃ stomayojanaṃ yathāmnāyaṃ śāṇḍilyo manyate, yathāmnāyagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet ucyate, vihāraḥ prakṛtaḥ tanmābhūditi
sāmārthaṃ sāmārthaṃ hiṃkuryuḥ uktaṃ sakṛddhiṃkṛtya bahiṣpavamānena stuvīranniti tatra sakṛddhiṅkāraḥ iha punaḥ pratisāma hiṅkāraḥ syāt
vṛṣako'si svaro'sītyetadādiyajuṣī yajamānavācane syātāṃ nānāsavanayoḥ krameṇa śyeno'sītyetasya sthāne

src: stutvā bahiṣpavamānena prastarād ubhayataś caturaṅgulaṃ parichidya tṛṇaṃ cātvāle pravidhyed yadi stutaṃ yadi vādya suṣṭutam arvākstutaṃ yadi vātiṣṭutaṃ yat tayor anyena divam āruhememam anyena jayema lokam iti
tgt: uttarayoḥ pavamānayorātideśiko vidhiruktaḥ sāmprataṃ yadanantaraṃ prakṛtaṃ karma taducyate, stutvā bahiṣpavamānena anantaraṃ prastarāttṛṇaṃ gṛhītvā tadubhayataḥ parichidya tṛṇaṃ catuṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ taccātvāle pravidhyet prakṣipet prakṣepaḥ pravyādhaḥ yadi stutamityetadādinā mantreṇa ekaśrutividhānādudgātā aṅgulichedanasaṃśaye yena karma kṛtaṃ tasya parimāṇam

src: tatraivodapātraṃ ninayeyuḥ samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomi svāṃ yonim abhigacchatāriṣṭās tanvo bhūyāḥ sma māparā secino dhanam iti
tgt: tasminneva cātvāle udapātranninayeyuḥ yattat udapātraṃ tasmin karmaṇyaṅgabhūtaṃ tadeva cātvāle ninayeyuḥ samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomītyetadādinā yajuṣā
tadudapātraṃ ninīya anantaraṃ bahirvedyudaṅmukhā ayuñji padāni utkrāmeyuḥ gaccheyuḥ prāgdaśabhyaḥ tri pañca sapta nava vā

āvrajya āgnīdhrīyantasmin bahiṣpavamānaḥ adhīyīran nanu kimidaṃ bahiṣpavamānarco'dhīyīranniti āvrajyāgnīdhrīyamupariṣṭājjapa iti vācye ucyate, stotradharmaḥ pravṛttaḥ pratyaṅmukhaḥ prastotodaṅmukha udgātā dakṣiṇapūrvamaṣṭamadeśamīkṣamāṇaḥ pratihartteti so'yamācāryaḥ punarārabhate bahiṣpavamānarca iti kathaṃ ya eva purastājjapasya dharmaḥ sa eva dharmaḥ syāditi prāṅmukhaiḥ kriyeti

src: anuvyācāriṣīn mām iti yam iti śaṅketa tasmā āgnīdhrīya āhutīvajraṃ prahared yajñaśaṃ ca ta upa ca te namaś ca te satyo 'si satyasaṃskṛtas tasya te ya ūnaṃ yo 'kṛtaṃ yo 'tiriktam adarśat tasya prāṇenāpyāyasva svāheti
tgt: pratipakṣatayā anuvyāhāriṣīt kṣapaṇavādaṃ kṛtavān ayaṃ pūrvamiti udgāyatāmiti śaṃketa punarapyabhivyāharediti tasmai tadarthaṃ āgnīdhrīye āhutivajraṃ praharet yajñaśañcatityetadādinā yajuṣā āhutivajraḥ abhicārārthī āhutiḥ anuvyāhārapraśamanārthaṃ anuvyāhāro nāma abhidrohābhisaṃhitaḥ praśnaḥ

yaduktaṃ tasmā āgnīdhrīya nāhutivajraṃ praharediti tanna kuryāt kasmāt yataḥ ya enamanuvyāharati sa ārttimārchatīti śruteḥ akriyamāṇe'pyetasmin ya enamanuvyāharati sa ārttimārchatyeva tasmānna vyabhicareteti iti dhānañjapyasya matam

bahiṣpavamānasya kṛtsno vidhiruktaḥ sāmpratamahīnasatreṣu deśaviśeṣo vivakṣitaḥ sa ucyate, ahīnabahiṣpavamānairiti ahīnasya bahiṣpavamānāni ahīnabahiṣpavamānāni tairahīnabahiṣpavamānaiḥ sadasī stuvīran deśena deśaḥ pratyāmnāyate prathamāhno'nyatra prathame 'hani cātvāladeśe stutvā śeṣeṣu sadasi stuvīran nanu bahiṣpavamānairiti bahuvacanasāmarthyādahīnavidhau siddhe kasmādahīnagrahaṇaṃ kriyate yāvatā ekāheṣu bahutvāsambhavāt satreṣu ca viśeṣavacanādādyantayośca satreṣviti ataḥ pratyākhyāyāhīnāt na cānyā caturthī yajñajātirasti yasyāmidaṃ vidhānaṃ kalpeta tasmādahīnagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ kriyamāṇe ca prayojanaṃ vaktavyam ucyate yaducyate'hīnagrahaṇaṃ na karttavyamiti karttavyamiti brūmaḥ kasmāt śeṣavidhiprasiddhaye dvādaśāhe'hīnabhūte ekāhamiśreṣu cāhīneṣu varuṇapraghāsadvidivasākamedhatrirātravyuṣṭidvirātreṣu akriyamāne'hīnagrahaṇe saṃśayaḥ syāt so'yamācāryyo muktasaṃśayaṃ sūtramārabhate, ahīnabahiṣpavamānairiti atha prathamādahno'nyatreti ahargrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ kasmāt prathamādanyatreti siddhe na caikasminnahanyanekabahiṣpavamānaṃ nāsti ucyate, karttavyamahargrahaṇaṃ kasmāt akriyamāṇe prathame'hani naimittikabahiṣpavamānāvṛttau sadasi stavanaṃ syāt bahiṣpavamānānantare somāpahāre somadāhe vā ābhyāsikasaṃskāre sati haviṣaḥ stutyarthatvāt pavamānānāṃ saṃskārāvṛttau pavamānābhyāsavṛttiḥ prāpnoti pavamānābhyāsavṛttiśceti vacanāt havisrutiḥ pavamāne iti ca tasmādahargrahaṇe kriyamāṇe nāsti doṣaḥ
ādyantayośca ye ahanī satreṣu tābhyāmanyatra sadasi stavanaṃ satreṣu samādhyartham
sadasi bahiṣpavamānakriyāyāmayaṃ viśeṣaḥ prāgdhiṣṇyeṣvagnīnāṃ viharaṇāt tṛṇaprakṣepaṇādi karma niṣkramya samāpnuyuḥ caturaṅgulaṃ parichidya tṛṇaṃ cātvāle pravidhyedityata ārabhya ā upariṣṭājjapāt
vaidatrirātre satraṃ nyāyaṃ gautama ācāryo manyate ubhayato'tirātratvāt
ahīneṣu yo nyāyastaṃ dhānañjapyo manyate ahīnatvāt

mandraḥ svarastaṃ śritvā prātaḥsavane stuvīran uttaramuttaraṃ śritvā uttarayoḥ pavamānayoḥ stuvīran mandre saptayavāntarāṇi bhavanti ataḥ śritvetyuktam anyathā hi mandreṇa prātaḥsavanaṃ stuvīranniti syāt
madhyena svareṇa vā ubhayoruttarayoḥ savanayoḥ stuvīran
etasmin kāle ityarthaḥ stutvā bahiṣpavamānena ṛtvijāmbhojanakāla upadiśyate etasmin kāle bhuñjīrannāntarābhojanaṃ syāt ādadhibhakṣaṇāt

src: anusavanaṃ tu satreṣu savanamukhīyān bhakṣayitvā sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu
tgt: anusavanantu satreṣu bhojanaṃ savanaśabdo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ kaṃ viśinaṣṭi kālaṃ savanamukhīyān bhakṣayitveti savanamukhīyānāṃ bhakṣaṇamuktaṃ bhavati nahyabhakṣayitvā sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu tato bhuñjīran nanu sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu ityukte savanamukhīyānāṃ bhakṣaṇamuktambhavati nahyabhakṣiteṣu savanamukhīyeṣu nārāśaṃsānāṃ sādanamasti tasmātsavanamukhīyān bhakṣayitvetyatiricyate naitat kutaḥ vakṣyatyayaṃ dvitīyāḥ savaneṣu nārāśaṃsāḥ pūrvayośca tṛtīyāviti tatra saṃśayaḥ syāt kiṃ pūrveṣu nārāśaṃseṣu sanneṣu uttarottareṣviti tadvivecanārthamārabhyate ye savanamukhīyānantaraṃ nārāśaṃsāsteṣu mantreṣviti
savanīyasya paśorvapāyāṃ hutāyāmanantaraṃ dhiṣṇyānupatiṣṭheran taddhiṣṇyopasthānaṃ vakṣyate

src: cātvāle tu mārjanaṃ pūrvaṃ satreṣv idam āpaḥ pravahatāvadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yadyarcābhidudrohānṛtaṃ yac ca śepe abhīruṇam āpo mā tasmād enaso duritāt pāntu viśvato nir mā muñcāmi śapathān nir mā varuṇād uta nir mā yamasya paḍviśāt sarvasmād eva kilbiṣāt sumitriyāna āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyās tasmai santu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃca vayaṃ dviṣma iti
tgt: cātvāle tu mārjanaṃ pūrvasatreṣu dhiṣṇyopasthānādbhavati mārjanaṃ mantrapūtābhiradbhirabhyukṣaṇaṃ idamāpa ityetadādinā mantreṇa prakṛtamadhunocyate

src: samrāḍ asīty āhavanīyam upasthāyodañco gatvāstāvacātvālaśāmitrānudaṅmukhāḥ stuto nabhosaṃmṛṣṭa iti
tgt: samrāḍasītyanena mantreṇa āhavanīyamupasthāya udaṅmukhā gatvā āstāvacātvālaśāmitrān āstāvaśca cātvālañca śāmitraśca āstāvacātvālaśāmitrāḥ tānupatiṣṭheran udaṅmukhāḥ udaṅmukhā iti prāṅmukhakaraṇaṃ pratyāmnāyate stuto nabhosaṃmṛṣṭa iti etadādibhirmantraiḥ yathāsaṃkhyena

vibhurasītyanena mantreṇa āgnīdhrīyasyopasthānaṃ kuryuḥ nanu āhavanīyamupasthāyeti prakṛtamupasthānaṃ kasmāducyate upatiṣṭheranniti ucyate udaṅmukhā iti prakṛtaṃ tanmābhūt ataḥ upatiṣṭherannityucyate kathaṃ āgnīdhrīyaṃ gatvā prāmukhā upatiṣṭheranniti

tamāgnīdhrīyamuttareṇa sañcaraḥ sarvatra enapāyoge dvitīyā sarvatreti na kevalaṃ dhiṣṇyopasthāne tamiti nirddeśaḥ kriyate keṣāñcit pariśrite bhavati keṣāñcidbahirbhavati yadi pariśrite yadi bahistasyaivottareṇa sañcaraḥ

src: dakṣiṇenottarayoḥ savanayor yadā havirdhānam āhavanīyaṃ ca pṛṣṭhahomāya
tgt: dakṣiṇenāgnīdhrīyasya sañcaraḥ uttarayoḥ savanayoryasmin kāle havirddhānagamanaṃ bhavati āhavanīyagrahaṇādanyo'pi pṛṣṭhāśrito homaḥ āhavanīya eva syāt yathā vairājamiti

src: pūrvasyāṃ sadasā dvāri pratyamukhās tiṣṭhanto vahnir iti hotur dhiṣṇyam
tgt: pūrvasya dvāri kasya sadasaḥ tiṣṭhanto bahirityetadādinā yajuṣāhoturdhiṣṇyamupatiṣṭheran
dhiṣṇyamupatiṣṭheran

src: tutha uśigandhārir avasyur iti brāhmaṇāchaṃsiprabhṛtīnām udañcaḥ
tgt: tutha ityetadādibhiryajurbhiḥ brāhmaṇāchaṃsipotṛneṣṭrachāvākānāṃ udañco dhiṣyāḥ tānupatiṣṭheran
tasminneva pradeśe tiṣṭhantaḥ śundhyurityetadādinā yajuṣā mārjālīyamupatiṣṭheran
ṛtadhāmetyanenaudumbarīmupatiṣṭheran
samudra ityanena yajuṣā brahmaṇaḥ sadanamupatiṣṭheran tatraiva tiṣṭhanta ityetadanuvarttata eva

uttareṇa sadasaḥ gatvā vederantaḥ antarvedi antarityavyayaṃ na bahirvedītyetaduktaṃ bhavati pratyaṅmukhāstiṣṭhantaḥ ahiriti prajahitamupatiṣṭheran pātnīśālo'gniḥ keṣāñcidgārhapatyādatipraṇayano bhavati keṣāñcidāhavanīyāt yasmādatipraṇayano bhavati sa gārhapatyaḥ yo'nyaḥ sa prajahitaḥ
aja ityanena mantreṇa gārhapatyamupatiṣṭheran
sagarā ityetadādinā yajuṣā dakṣiṇāgnerāyatanamupatiṣṭheran
kavya ityetadādinā yajuṣā mahāvederdakṣiṇamantamupatiṣṭharan
etasminneva deśe tiṣṭhantaḥ sarvānāhavanīyādīn dhiṣṇyān samanvīkṣamāṇaḥ pātamityetad yajurjapeyuḥ

src: ekaikam upasthāyaitad brūyur iti śāṇḍilyo bahuśabdān ekavat kurvantaḥ
tgt: āhavanīyādārabhya ekaikaṃ dhiṣṇyamupasthāyaitad yajurjapeyuriti śāṇḍilya ācāryyo manyate tasmin yajuṣi yān bahuśabdāntānekavatsanayantaḥ prayogastu pāhi māgneraudreṇānīkena pipṛhi mā namaste'stu mā mā hiṃsīrityevamādi

src: raurukīṇi cet kuryur ādityaṃ prathamam upatiṣṭherann adhvanām iti
tgt: raurukīye pravacane yāni dhiṣṇyopasthānayajūṃṣyāmnātāni yaditāni kuryuḥ tataḥ prāgāhavanīyopasthānādādityantāvadupatiṣṭheran adhvanāmadhvapata ityanena mantreṇa

src: āhavanīyam upasthāya tam evāpi jo 'si jāyamāna ity api jo 'si navajāta iti vā yam agnim anupracaranti tam abhipretya
tgt: āhavanīyaṃ pūrvoktena vidhinā upasthāya tamevopatiṣṭheran apijo'si jāyamāna iti apijo'si navajāta iti vā etayoranyatareṇa yamagninnirmathya āhavanīye praharanti tamagnimābhimukhyena pretya samīpe gatvā upatiṣṭheran

src: yadā cātvālam athotkaran tumulo 'sy ākranda kṛtveti
tgt: yadā yasmin kāle cātvālamupatiṣṭheran athānantaramutkaramupatiṣṭheran tumulo'syākranda kṛtvetyanena mantreṇa

src: yadā śāmitram atha yatrovadhyaṃ nikhananty ūvadhyagoho 'si pārthiva iti
tgt: yasmin kāle śāmitramupatiṣṭheran athānantaraṃ yasmin deśe paśoḥ ūvadhyannikhananti taṃ deśamupatiṣṭheran ūvadhyagoho'si pārthiva ityanena yajuṣā

src: yadāgnīdhrīyam atha yatrācchāvāka āsīno hotary upahavam icchaty upahavyo 'si namasya ity upahavyo 'si tanūpā iti vā
tgt: yasmin kāle āgnīdhrīyamupatiṣṭheran athānantaraṃ yatra yasmin deśe acchāvāka āsīnaḥ hotari upahavamicchati taṃ deśamupatiṣṭheran upahavyo'si namasya iti upahavyo'si tanūpā iti vā etayoranyatareṇa vā

src: yadā brahmaṇaḥ sadanam atha sadasyasya sadasyo 'si 'malimluca iti
tgt: yasmin kāle brahmaṇaḥ sadanamupatiṣṭheran anantaraṃ sadasyasya sadamamupatiṣṭheran sadasyo'si malimluca ityanena mantreṇa sīdantyasminniti sadanam

src: yadā dakṣiṇaṃ vedyantam atha prājāpatyam asīti patnīśālām aindram asīti sado vaiṣṇavam asīti havirdhānam aindrāgnam asīty āgnīdhrīyaṃ vaiśvadevam asīti vā
tgt: yasmin kāle dakṣiṇaṃ vedyantamupatiṣṭheran tato'nantaraṃ patnīśālādīnyāgnīdhrīyāntāni āgārāṇyupatiṣṭheran yathādiṣṭairmantraiḥ, nanu āgnīdhrīyasya pūrvamevopasthānaṃ kṛtaṃ tat kimidaṃ punarādiśyata iti atrocyate, tadāgnīdhrīyasya kṛtam imāni tu patnīśālādīnāṃ pariśritānāmupasthānāni prakṛtāni tasmādāgnīdhrīyaparicitasyedamupasthānamiti

src: atha tathaiva samastena sarve stha somyāsaḥ sarve somaṃ pibata sarve somasya pītim ānaśadhve pātam eti samānaṃ param
tgt: atha asmāt karmaṇo'nantaraṃ yathāpūrvaṃ samastopasthānaṃ kṛtaṃ tathaiva tena prakāreṇa sarvānsamanvīkṣamāṇaḥ sarve stha somyāsa ityetadyajurjapitvā anantaraṃ pātametyetadādi pūrvoktaṃ japeyuḥ

src: ṛtasya dvārau stha ity aparau dvārabāhū saṃmṛjya mā mā saṃtāptam iti praviśeyuḥ
tgt: dvayorvvidhānayorantareṇa dhiṣṇyānupasthāya anantaraṃ ṛtasya dvārau stha ityanena mantreṇa sadasaḥ aparau paścimau dvārabāhū saṃmṛjya mā mā santāptamityanena yajuṣā sadasi praviśeyuḥ sammārjanaṃ śodhanam

src: dakṣiṇenaudumbarīṃ gatvā tasyā uttarata upaviśeyur namaḥ sakhibhyaḥ iti
tgt: dakṣiṇena pradeśenaudumbaryā gatvā tasyā uttare pradeśe upaviśeṣuḥ namaḥ sakhibhya ityanena yajuṣā tasyā iti nirdeśo mābhūt sadasa uttarata iti
etasyāṃ velāyāṃ dhiṣṇyopasthānānantarāyāṃ pūrveṇa pradeśena prastotāraṃ pratiharttā gacchet apare bruvate etasyāmityetasyāmaudumbaryām ayameva nityaḥ sañcara iti

etasyāmiti kākākṣinyāyenobhayatra sambadhyate etasyāṃ velāyāmasmin kāle samupahayeran, nanu etasyāṃ velāyāmiti kimarthamārabhyate atha samupahvayerannityānantarye siddhe ucyate, anyadapyasti pūrveṇa prastotāraṃ pratihartuḥ gamanaṃ na tasmin samupahvayeran dhiṣṇyopasthānānantaraṃ praveśanakāla eva samupahvayeram
yajamānā upahvayadhvamityevopahvānamiti sarve yajamānāḥ satreṣu samupahvayeran
satrādanyatra mithaḥ dvau dvau samupahvayeran
satrādanyatra sarve trayo'pi udgātāro yajamānamupahvayeran udgātāra upahvayadhvamiti prārthitāḥ santa upahūta ityanujñāṃ kuryurityarthaḥ

src: dvārabāhusaṃmārjanaprabhṛty etat sarvaṃ kuryur yadā dhiṣṇyān upatiṣṭheran
tgt: ṛtasya dvārā stha ityetasmādārabhya etat sarvaṃ kuryuḥ yāvad yajamānasamupahvānamiti yasmin kāle dhiṣṇyānupatiṣṭheran, nanu etat sarvamiti kimarthaṃ dvārabāhusammārjanaprabhṛtīti siddhe ucyate, uktaṃ yadā dhiṣṇyānupatiṣṭheranniti vakṣyati ca atha dhiṣṇyānupatiṣṭherannityetasmin prakaraṇe anupasthānaṃ śāṇḍilya iti taddhiṣṇyopasthānānantaraṃ karma anupasthānena prāpnoti so'yamācāryo niyamārthamārabhate etat sarvaṃ kuryāditi kathaṃ anupasthāne'pi syāditi

src: yājamānabrahmatve ced udgātā kuryād āgnīdhrīyam upasthāya pūrveṇa parikrāmet
tgt: yajamānasya karma yājamānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ karma brahmatvaṃ te yājamānabrahmatve yadyudgātā mūlyena kuryāt tadāgnīdhrīyamupasthāya tasya pūrveṇa gacchet kiṃ viṣayaṃ punaridaṃ karmodgātuḥ ucyate āpatkalpe
sādasān dhiṣṇyān upasthāya sadasi bhavāḥ sādasāḥ tānupasthāya tasminneva deśe'vasthita īkṣamāṇaḥ pātnīśālān dhiṣṇyānupatiṣṭhet patnīśalāyāṃ bhavāḥ pātnīśālāḥ
itarathā itarau praṣṭī pūrvoktena vidhinā dhiṣṇyān upatiṣṭheyātām

src: ṛtasya dvārau stha iti pūrveṇa dvārabāhū saṃmṛjya dakṣiṇasya purastād udaṅmukha upaviśed iti dhānañjapyaḥ
tgt: sādasān pānīśālāṃśca dhiṇyānupasthāya anantaramṛtasya dvārau stha ityanena yajuṣā pūrvau dvārabāhū sadasaḥ saṃmṛjya dakṣiṇasya dvārabāhoḥ pūrve pradeśe udaṅmukha upaviśedityevaṃ dhānañjapyaḥ ācārya āha
paścime pradeśe dakṣiṇasya dvārabāhoḥ pratyaṅmukha upaviśedityevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācārya āha
praveśanopaveśanārthīye yajuṣī pūrvamevokte mā mā santāpta namaḥ sakhibhya iti ca
yājamānamuktaṃ sāmprataṃ brahmatvaṃ vivakṣitaṃ taducyate, ṛtvikpathena gatvā samastopasthānādārabhya sarvān samanvīkṣamāṇāḥ pātametyetasmāt sarvaṃ samānam

src: dakṣiṇārdhe tu sadasaḥ pūrvam upaveśanaṃ prastotuḥ pratyupaveśanaṃ brahmopaveśanena nirastaḥ parāvasur iti dakṣiṇātṛṇṇaṃ nirasyed ā vasoḥ sadane sīdāmīty upaviśet
tgt: ayantu viśeṣaḥ prāgaugātrādupaveśanāt dakṣiṇe pradeśe sadasa upaveśanaṃ prastoturupaveśanaṃ prati tacca brahmopaveśanena, nanu kimidaṃ brahmopaveśaneneti yadā vakṣyatyevopaveśanam ucyate, vakṣyatyayaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prakaraṇe pratipattau dhiṣṇyānupasthāyoktaṃ sadasyupaveśanamiti nirastaḥ parāvasurityanena yajuṣā dakṣiṇātṛṇṇannirasyet āvasoḥ sadane sīdāmītyanena upaviśet

src: bhūr bhuvaḥ svar bṛhaspatir brahmāhaṃ mānuṣa ity uktvaudumbarīṃ gatvopaviśet
tgt: upaviśyānantaram etadyajurjapet anantaramaudumbarīṃ gatvā pūrvoktena yajuṣopaviśet
tamupaviṣṭamanantaraṃ prastotṛpratiharttārāvupaviśetāṃ pūrvoktenaiva yajuṣā
yadi yājamānabrahmatve udgātā kuryāt tadā yājamānaṃ brahmatvamaudgātramityanenānupūrveṇa sarvaṃ yathāsanaṃ upaveśanādi kuryāt
yadi glāyed audumbaryāmevāsīnaḥ sarvaṃ kuryāt glāniraśaktiḥ

src: sadasya evam eva dhiṣṇyān upatiṣṭhan brahmāṇam anupraviśed brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaṃ vā
tgt: sadasya evameva yadidamudgātṛṛṇāṃ dhiṣṇyopasthānamuktantamanenaiva prakāreṇa kurvan brahmāṇamanupraviśet

src: tenāsya samupahavaḥ syād bhakṣaś ca samānaḥ
tgt: yadi brahmaṇā yadi vā brāhmaṇachaṃsinā yasyānūpraviṣṭaḥ tena saha sadasyasya samupahavaḥ syāt na kevalaṃ samupahavo bhakṣaśca tenaiva tulyaḥ syāt
yadi bībhatseyātāṃ nānā camasā syātāṃ bībhatsā nāma ghṛṇā syātāmiti etāveva camasau nānā syātām anyeṣāṃ tu satyāmapi bībhatsāyāṃ naiva nānā camasaḥ syāt
savanasaṃsthāsu sarpaṇeṣu sarpatsu ṛtvigyajamāneṣu na sadasyaḥ śūnyaṃ sadaḥ kuryāt
tasya sadasyasya dadhibhakṣāntaṃ karma bhavati norddhvam

sa dadhibhakṣato nivartteta satreṣu sadasyasya kathaṃ punaretadgamyate yathā dadhibhakṣato nivarttate sadasyasya na sadasya eveti ucyate sadasyo hi satrotpādaka eva āvarttavāḥ sadasyā iti, nanūktamaśuṣomāntamahaḥsatreṣviti satreṣu dadhibhakṣaprāptireva nāsti aśuṣomāntatvādahnām atrocyate, savidhirudgātṛṛṇamukto na sadasyasya sadasyasya hi aviśeṣepoktaṃ dadhibhakṣāntaṃ karma ekāhāhīnasatreṣu so'viśeṣavacanaprāpto dadhibhakṣaḥ satreṣu viśeṣavacanena sa nivartteta satreṣviti

src: visaṃsthite savane pūrvayā dvārāntareṇa hotur dhiṣṇyaṃ maitrāvaruṇasya ca saṃcaraḥ
tgt: visaṃsthite arddhasamāpte savane antareṇa hoturdhiṣṇyasya maitrāvaruṇadhiṣṇyañca gatvā pūrvayā dvārā sadoniṣkramaṇakarmārthameṣa sañcaraḥ
tadyathā gataṃ evaṃ sadasi sañcaraḥ siddho bhavati nānyatprayojanamasti asya sūtrasyārambhe

src: camasaṃ pratigṛhya prastotā dakṣiṇa ūrāv ādhāya dakṣiṇena pāṇināpidhāyāsīta
tgt: dhiṣṇyopasthānamuktam anantaraṃ savanamukhīyāṃścamasānāharanti ata ucyate, camasaṃ pratigṛhyeti camantyasminniti camasaḥ taṃcamasaṃdīyamānaṃ pratigṛhya dakṣiṇa ūrāvādhāya dakṣiṇena pāṇināpidhāyāsīta apidhānamācchādanam
upahūyamānāyāmiḍāyāntañcamasaṃ iḍāhvānasamīpe dhārayedanupaghnan aspṛśan / eṣa upahvānadharmaḥ prāgyājamānāt agnirma ityādi

src: vaṣaṭkartur anubhakṣaṃ sarvatra bhakṣayeyur mitha upahūya
tgt: vaṣaṭkarttari bhakṣite'smiṃścamase tato bhakṣayeyuḥ svaṃ camasaṃ mithaḥ anyonyamupahvaya, nanu vaṣaṭkartrā camasaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tato'nubhakṣayediti tadayuktaṃ kutaḥ anviti kālāpekṣā na bhakṣaṇaprāptiḥ mitha upahūya ityetasmācca yasya bhakṣaṇaprāptiḥ sa evopahavaṃ yācanīyaḥ anujñārthatvāt upahvānasya sarvagrahaṇānna kevalaṃ savamamukhīyānāṃ sarveṣāñcamasānāṃ eṣa bhakṣaṇadharmaḥ
camasaṃ bhakṣayet asau camasaḥ prastotrā prathamaṃ pratipannaḥ ato'syaivānantaraṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ prāpnoti ataḥ āhodgātā prathama iti kathaṃ bhakṣayedityucyate

src: dakṣiṇam anu bāhuṃ daṇḍaṃ kṛtvā śyena ity avekṣyendav iti dvir alpaṃ bhakṣayed yathāsavanaṃ chandāṃsy ādiśan
tgt: dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumanu camamasya daṇḍaṃ kṛtvā śyena ityanena yajuṣā avekṣya somam indavityanena dvirbhakṣayedalpaṃ kriyābhyāse sakṛnmantraḥ yadyasminsavane chando yathāsavanaṃ gāyatrachandasa iti prātaḥsavane triṣṭupcchandasa iti mādhyandine jagatīcchandasa iti tṛtīyasavane evamādiśan

src: ūrdhva iti mukhyān prāṇān abhimṛśeta soma rārandhīti hṛdayaṃ soma gīrbhir iti nābhim
tgt: ūrddhva ityanena yajuṣā mukhyān prāṇānabhimṛśeta mukhe bhavā mukhyāḥ prāṇā indriyāṇi, soma rārandhītyanena yajuṣā hṛdayaṃ soma gīrbhirityanena nābhim abhimṛśeteti varttate
evameva itarau prastotṛpratiharttārau kuryātāṃ
atha tayoḥ kaḥ krama ityucyate, pratiharttā paścāt

taṃ camasaṃ sa pratiharttā āpyāyayet abhimṛśya āpyāyasvetyanena mantreṇa ayātayāmārtham atha sagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet ucyate, vakṣyati subrahmaṇyacaturthā udgātṛcamasaṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ ṣaṭ cānya iti tairapi bhakṣite sa evāpyāyayet pratiharttā
sarve vā āpyāyayeyuḥ āpyāyasvetyetayā gāyatryā athaitayā gāyatryeti kimarthamiti cet ucyate, saṃvyavahārārthaṃ vakṣyati gāyatrīṃ dvirbrūyuriti gāyatryaivānusavanamāpyāyanamiti ca

src: tāṃ tṛtīyasavane dvir brūyuḥ saṃ te payāṃsīti mādhyandine
tgt: tāṃ gāyatrīṃ tṛtīyasavane somāpyāyane dvirbrūyuḥ sante payāṃsityetayarcā mādhyandine āpyāyanaṃ chandaḥsampadartham
gāyatryaivāpyāyasvetyetayā sakṛduktayā anusavanamāpyāyanamiti śāṇḍilya āha

src: dvitīyāḥ savaneṣu nārāśaṃsāḥ pūrvayoś ca tṛtīyau
tgt: dvitīyāścamasāḥ savaneṣu triṣvapi nārāśaṃsasaṃjñāḥ pūrvayoḥ savanayoḥ prathamadvitīyayostṛtīyau ca

src: teṣām anavekṣya bhakṣaṇam avamair iti prātaḥsavana aurvair iti mādhyandine kāvyair iti tṛtīyasavane
tgt: teṣāṃ nārāśaṃsānāmanavekṣya bhakṣaṇaṃ yadetacye(?)na ityavekṣaṇaṃ etatteṣāṃ na syāt avamairityetadādibhirvihṛtairanusavanaṃ bhakṣayeyuryathākramam
pitṛbhirbhakṣitasyetyetadādi sarvatrānusaṃharet sarveṣu savaneṣu sarvagrahaṇaṃ anyeṣvapi mantreṣu pitṛśabdamanusaṃharet avamaiste pitṛbhirityetadādi

yadetadūrddhva iti mukhyān prāṇānabhimṛśetetyetadādi pratyabhimarśanam etat nārāśaṃse kuryānna vā apare varṇayanti pitṛbhiriti sarvatrānusaṃharet ityasya pitṛśabdasyānusaṃharet pratyabhimarśane yathākāmī indraśabdasya sthāne pitṛśabdaṃ vā kuryāt yathāmnātamevābhimarśanaṃ kuryāt sarvaprāptisatatvārthatvādindrasya

src: prathamadvitīyau pūrvayoḥ savanayor āpyāyayet prathamaṃ tṛtīyasavane
tgt: prathamadvitīyau camasau pūrvayoḥ savanayoḥ prātaḥsavanamādhyandinayoḥ āpyāyayet prathamañcamasaṃ tṛtīyasavane āpyāyayet

src: āvarttiṣu tṛṇe pratigṛhya prastotā prayacched yathā prastaram
tgt: āvarttistotreṣu tṛṇe pratigṛhya prastotādgātre prayacchet yathā prastaraṃ yena prakāreṇa prastaradānaṃ brahman stoṣyāmaḥ praśāstariti prastotṛgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet yathā prastaramityanenaiva siddhe yadā prastarasya prastotaiva sampradātā atrocyate yadāpyanyadupākaraṇadravyaṃ tatrāpi prastotaiva prayacchet yathā vairūpopākaraṇe vyajanamaraṇī vairāje mahānāmnīṣvavakāmiśrā āpaḥ mahāvrate vāṇaḥ ityetadādi
anāhriyamāṇyostṛṇayormantrannotsṛjet yadā tṛṇābhyāmupakaraṇam

src: tathaiva jaṅghām upahatya yuñjyāt stomaṃ dīkṣāyai tapaso manaso vāca iti nānā dhānañjapyo yatrānantarāṇi catvāri
tgt: tathaiva tenaiva prakāreṇetyarthaḥ yathaiva prastareṇa bahiṣpavamāne uktaṃ jaṅghāmupahatya yuñjyāt stomaṃ dīkṣāyai varṇenetyetadādibhiḥ nānā pṛthagityarthaḥ yatra yasminnanantarāṇi catvāri stotrāṇi evaṃ dhānañjapya ācārya āha
yadetat prajāpatistveti sarveṣāmanantaramāmnātam etat pratyekamanuṣajyate dīkṣāyai varṇena prajāpatistvā yunaktu evaṃ sarveṣu

alpīyaḥsu stotreṣu uttaramuttaraṃ stomayojanaṃ lupyeta yathāgniṣṭome trīyuttarāṇi luptāni, atha kimarthamidaṃ sūtraṃ ārabhyate yadā nimittāpāye naimittikasyāpyapāyo bhaviṣyatyeva ucyate, sanniyogaśiṣṭānyetāni stomayojanāni yatrānantarāṇi catvārīti tatrākārtsnyena saṃśayaḥ syāt, athālpīyaḥsu kimarthamiti cet ucyate prakāradarśanārthaṃ katham anyatrāpi bahuṣvakṛtsneṣu lopaprāptau uttaramuttaraṃ lupyeta yathā vairāje'gnimanthane āha, abhyātmaṃ prajananaṃ kṛtvā triḥpradakṣiṇamabhimanthedgāyatraṃ chando'nu prajāyasva traiṣṭubhaṃ jāgatamānuṣṭubhaṃ vairājamiti gautama ityuktvāha caturbhiriti dhānañjapyastribhiriti śāṇḍilya iti tathā mahāvratāsaṅghārohaṇaṃ chandobhiruktvāha vairājapañcamairiti gautamaścaturbhiriti dhānañjapyastribhiriti śāṇḍilya iti atrāpyuttaramuttaraṃ lupyetālpīyaḥsviti
prathamena mantreṇa vājapeyasāmnaḥ stomaṃ yuñjyāt ṣoḍaśisāmnaḥ prathamena stomayojanaṃ kṛtam ihānārthāddvitīyasya prāptiḥ tanmābhūdityata āha prathameneti
prathamaprabhṛtīni rātrau stomayojanāni bhavanti ṣoḍaśimatyatirātre dvitīyaprabhṛtīni rātrau prāpnuvanti tatpratiṣedhārthamāha prathamaprabhṛtīni rātrāviti
tathaivātiriktastotreṣu prathamaprabhṛtītyeva sandheranantaratvāttatrāpi dvitīyaprabhṛtiprāptau tathetyuktam
sarvairdīkṣāyai varṇenetyetadādibhirekaikasmin stotre yathāmnātaiḥ stomayojanaṃ syāt yathāpāṭhamityarthaḥ yathāmnāyagrahaṇaṃ vihṛtairmābhūditi
āvarttistotreṣu yo nyāyaḥ stomayojanādīnāṃ sa sandhau syāt kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ parāktvātsandheḥ

upavasathye'hani caturdaśyāṃ samānānaṃ na kuryuḥ kva punaḥ samāmnānaṃ prāptamupavasathye'hani niṣidhyata iti ucyate, stotragatasya sāmnaḥ pāñcavidhye bhaktiṣvācāryāṇāṃ anekadhā pratipattiḥ tadyathādāvekaḥ kalponāṅgīkriyate tadā stotrakāle bhaktīḥ prati anyo'nyena vipratipattiḥ syāt sa cānyāyaḥ tadevaṃ mābhūdityata adāvevodgātuḥ kalpo ya iṣṭaḥ sa sampratipattavyaḥ ato'rthaṃ samāmnānamādāveva karttavyaṃ syāt tasyopavasathye'hani pratiṣedhaḥ

src: prastotā tu kuśāḥ kārayed yajñiyasya vṛkṣasya khadirasya dīrghasatreṣv eke prādeśamātrīḥ kuśāḥ pṛṣṭhāstvaktaḥ samāmajjato 'ṅguṣṭhaparvapṛthumātrīḥ prajñātāgrāḥ kārayitvā gandhaiḥ pralipya sarpiṣā satreṣv eke vaiṣṭutena vasanena pariveṣṭya kṣaumaśāṇakārpāśānāṃ kenacid upary audumbaryā vāsayet
tgt: karmasūtramuktaṃ upavasathye'hani na samāmaneranniti kintu prastotā tu kuśāḥ kārayet tuśabdo viśeṣaṇārthaḥ upavasathya evāhani prastotā kuśāḥ kārayet, kārayedityanyaṃ kuśānāṃ karttāraṃ jñāyati, yajñiyasya vṛkṣasya yajñamarhatīti yajñiyaḥ yajñiyasya vṛkṣasyetyavayavalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī khadirasya dīrghasatreṣveke eke ācāryā manyante dīrghasatreṣu khādiryaḥ kuśāḥ syuriti kiṃ kāraṇaṃ dāruprādhānyāt prādeśamātrīḥ prādeśapramāṇaḥ kārayet kuśapṛṣṭhāstvaktaḥ ākṛtirucyate tvacaṃ prati kuśapṛṣṭhāḥ syuḥ samāmajjataḥ majjāṃ prati samāḥ syuḥ aṅguṣṭhaparvapṛthumātrīḥ pṛthutvenāṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāḥ syuḥ prajñātāgrāḥ kārayitvā prajñātāni agrāṇi yathā bhavanti tathā kārayet nanu kārayitveti kimarthaṃ yadā prastotā tu kuśāḥ kārayediti prakṛta eva karaṇe ucyate praṇāśe kuśānāṃ bhaṅge vā punaranyāḥ kārayitvā prayuñjīta nānyat prāyaścittamasti gandhaiḥ pralipya kuśāḥ sarpiṣā satreṣveke eke ācāryāḥ satreṣu sarpiṣā pralepaṃ manyante vaiṣṭutena vasanena pariveśya viṣṭatīṣu yojitaṃ vaiṣṭutaṃ tena vāsasā sarvato veṣṭayitvā kṣaumaśāṇakārpāśānāṃ kenacit kṣumāyāḥ vikāraḥ kṣaumaṃ śaṇasya vikāraḥ śāṇaṃ kārpāśānāṃ vikāraḥ kārpāśam eteṣāṃ vāsasāmekena veṣṭayitvā audumbaryāḥ sādasyāḥ śālāyā upaviṣṭādvāsayet

src: tāṃ śvobhūte kuśair ūrdhvāgrair veṣṭayitvaivaṃjātīyenaiva vasanena pradakṣiṇam ūrdhvadaśena pariveṣṭy spṛṣṭo 'napaśrita udgāyet
tgt: tāmaudumbarīṃ śva eva śvobhūta ityevaṃ bruvate tasmin bhūte stotrakāle kuśairurddhvāgrairveṣṭayitvaivaṃjātīyenaiva vasanena yajjātīyaṃ vaiṣṭutaṃ pradakṣiṇamūrddhvadaśena pariveṣṭya pradakṣiṇamiti niyamaḥ kriyate na prasavyam ūrddhvadaśena nādhodaśena pariveṣṭya sarvato veṣṭayitvā spṛṣṭaḥ anapaśrita udgāyet vakṣyati kāraṇaṃ dhiṣṇyo'yaṃ bhavati na dhiṣṇyamāsādayediti
dhṛṣṭaṃ pragalbhaṃ svalpamityarthaḥ apaśrayeta ityeke tāvatā apaśrayaṇārthā iyaṃ bhavatībhiḥ sa eva tadūrjiśrita iti

src: stoṣyamāṇānāṃ madhye vaiṣṭutaṃ vasanaṃ prāksamāsaṃ vodaksamāsaṃ vā uparidaśam āstīrya prastotā kuśā vidadhyāt prastāvānteṣu
tgt: stoṣyamāṇānāmiti pratyupasthitaṃ kālaṃ jñāpayati stoṣyamāṇānāṃ stotrakartṝṇāṃ madhye viṣṭutiprayojanaṃ vasanaṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā prāksamāsaṃ vā deśāntapāśāntayoḥ saṃśleṣaḥ samāsaḥ taṃ samāmaṃ prāṅmukham udaṅmukhaṃ vā kṛtvā uparidaśamāstīryya prastotā kuśānāṃ vinyāsaṃ kuryyāt prastāvānteṣu
anekaprastāveṣu sāmasu mahādivākīrttyelāndamahānāmnādiṣu sāmasu ādye prastāve kuśāḥ prāsthāpayet

src: udagagraṃ prathamaṃ viṣṭāvaṃ prāksaṃsthaṃ pratyag vā
tgt: udagagrābhiḥ kuśābhiḥ prathamaṃ viṣṭāvaṃ vidadhyāt prāgapavargaṃ pratyagapavargaṃ vā

src: taṃ paścimena madhyadeśenodaksaṃsthaṃ prāgagraṃ pratyag vā
tgt: tasya prathamasya viṣṭāvasya paścime pradeśe dvitīyaṃ viṣṭāvaṃ vidadhyāt udaksaṃsthaṃ prāgagraṃ pratyagagraṃ vā

src: taṃ paścimenodagraṃ pratyaksaṃstham evaṃvidhāḥ paryāyā uttarottarāḥ
tgt: tasya dvitīyasya viṣṭāvasya paścime pradeśe tṛtīyaṃ viṣṭāvaṃ vidadhyāt evamekaḥ paryāyo bhavati tasya prathamasya paryāyasya uttare pradeśe dvitīyaḥ tasyāpyuttare tṛtīyaḥ, nanu kimidaṃ bahuvacanam evaṃvidhāḥ paryāyā uttarottarā iti yāvat yāvatā ukta ekaḥ paryāyaḥ anyau dvau vidheyau ucyate, bahuvacanaṃ catuṣṭomārthaṃ vakṣyati catuṣṭomayoścatuṣparyāyā iti sandhau ca pañcadaśādiṣu stomeṣu nānāparyāyaviṣṭāvāḥ syuḥ
paryāyāṃśca viṣṭāvāṃśca sandadhyāt saṃhatān kuryāt saṃlagnān kuryāt

paryāyasyādau hiṃkṛtya stuvīran nanu tat kimidamārabhyate yadā pratiparyāyaṃ hiṃkāra āmnāta eva brāhmaṇena tisṛbhyo hiṃkarotītyevamādi, ucyate kṛtaparyāyeṣu stomeṣu tadāmnātam akṛtaparyāyeṣu catuṣparyāyādiṣu ca saṃśayaḥ syādyadyevannārabhyeta

stotrasya uttamāṃ stotrīyāṃ prastutya prastāvaṃ dattvā prastotā eṣeti bruvan śaṃsitāramīkṣate kālaprajñāpanārthaṃ hotṛṛṇām uttamaṃ pratihāraṃ pratyāhvayantīti śruteḥ tatprajñāpanārthaṃ tadyathaiṣottarameveti
stutasya stutamasītyetad yajuḥ yajamānavācanamāvarttistotreṣu

src: savanasaṃsthāsu praśāstrokto yathetam aparayā dvārā niṣkramya paścimenāgnīdhrīyaṃ bahirvedi mūtraṃ kuryuḥ
tgt: savanasaṃsthāsu savanamamāptiṣvityarthaḥ praśāstrā sarpatetyuktaḥ yathetaṃ yathāgataṃ dakṣiṇenaudumbaryā gatvā aparayā dvārā niṣkramya paścimayā paścimenāgnīdhrīyaṃ bahirvedi mūtraṃ kuryuḥ vederbahiḥ mūtraṃ kuryuḥ yadi mūtritāḥ syuḥ na niyamaḥ avadhirupadiśyate mūtroccārayoḥ atha kimarthaṃ bahirvedīti kutaḥ saṃśayaḥ yathāntarvedimūtroccārayoḥ kriyā syāditi ucyate, bahirvedigrahaṇaṃ deśaprakarṣārthaṃ na vedeḥ samopadeśe prakṛṣṭe syāditi atha bahuvacanaṃ kimarthaṃ savanasaṃsthāsviti yadā prātaḥsavanamādhyandinayoreva savanayoḥ sarpaṇaṃ bhavati tṛtīyasavanasamāptau niḥsarpaṇaṃ tat kimidaṃ bahuvacanamiti ucyate, etadarthaṃ bahuvacanaṃ kriyate savanasamāptau saṃsthāsu ceti kathaṃ saṃsthāsamāptau ca sarpaṇaṃ syāditi yathā atirātre agniṣṭomānte sarpaṇam ukthyeṣu taccastreṣu ca samāpteṣu sarpaṇaṃ syāt ṣoḍaśini stute anuśaste sarpaṇam aptorvyāptyapyevameva
udakam arhatīty udakyāḥ yāvadakṛtaśaucāḥ syustāvadvāgyamanaṃ kuryuḥ ā upasparśanāt

yadetaduktaṃ paścimenāgnīdhrīyamiti etasya saṃjñeyaṃ mṛgatīrthamiti mārgatāmetattīrthaṃ yadyarthino bhavanti nirgamane anye bruvate mṛgatīrthamiti uktam āgrāmyān paśūn labhante āraṇyān sṛjantīti tadāraṇyānāṃ paśūnāmanenotsarjanamiti
tena mṛgatīrthena niṣkramya śamyāprāsātparatā na gaccheyuḥ

src: yo bhūyo jigamiṣed āpnānena sa gacchet
tgt: śamyāparāsāt parato yaḥ prakṛṣṭataraṃ deśaṃ gantumicchet āpnānena tīrthena niṣkramya sa gacchet

src: atha dhiṣṇyān upatiṣṭheran samastenottarayoḥ savanayor iti gautamaśāṇḍilyāyanau
tgt: uktaṃ savanasaṃsthāsu praśāstroktā yathetamaparayā dvārā niṣkramya paścimenāgnīdhrīyaṃ bahirvedi mūtraṃ kuryuriti tadyadi tāvanniṣkramaṇānantaraṃ mūtroccāre kurvanti tataḥ kṛtaśaucā ācāntodakāḥ yadidamādekṣyate tat kuryuḥ atha mūtroccāre naiva kuryuḥ tadā yathoktena vidhinā niṣkramyāthānantaraṃ dhiṣṇyānupatiṣṭheran samastena uktaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhantaḥ sarvānsamanvīkṣamāṇaḥ pātameti etat samastopasthānam anenottarayoḥ savanayorupatiṣṭheran evaṃ gautamaśāṇḍilyāyanāvācāryāvāhatuḥ
āhavanīyopasthānādārabhya pratyekaṃ sarveṇa dhiṣyupasthānavidhinā upatiṣṭherann iti dhānañjapya ācārya āha
na upasthānamanupasthānaṃ etasminneva kāle śāṇḍilya ācāryo'nupasthānaṃ manyate

src: evam eva niṣkramya pṛthak stotrebhyaḥ samastenopatiṣṭheran yāny ūrdhvamm ukthebhyaḥ
tgt: evameva niṣkramya yathāsavanasaṃsthāsu ityuktam pṛthak stotrebhyaḥ pṛthaṅgānetyarthaḥ tadarthaṃ samastenopatiṣṭheran yānyūrddhvamukthebhyaḥ katamāni punastāni pṛthakstotrāṇi yadarthamidamucyate yathā ṣoḍaśyarthe vājapeyasāmārthe voktameva sarpaṇaṃ saṃsthāsviti vakṣyati ca paryāyebhyastu rātreriti ucyate, yathā ṣoḍaśyarthe tathātiriktastotreṣu ca stotrāya stotrāya sandhyarthe sarpaṇaṃ syāditi
rātrau tu paryāyādau sarpaṇaṃ syāditi na pṛthak stotrebhyaḥ etadarthaṃ tuśabdaḥ

src: yathāsanam upaviśya prastotā havirdhānaṃ gacchen madhyandine
tgt: dhiṣṇyopasthānānantaraṃ dvārabāhusaṃmārjanaprabhṛti sarvaṃ kṛtvā yadasya svamāsanaṃ tasmin yajuṣopaviśya prastotā havirddhānaṃ gacchenmadhyandine karmārthamuktam etat sarvaṃ kuryāduttarayoḥ pavamānayoriti
hute ādityagrahe pratiharttā havirddhānaṃ gacchet ārbhave karmārtham
ubhayoḥ pavamānayoruttarayoḥ havirddhānaṃ gaccheyuḥ satreṣu sarva udgātāro yajamānatvāt

src: pavamānayor uttarayor dhiṣṇyaviharaṇe mārjīlīyaṃ harantaḥ paścimena yajamānaṃ hṛtvā tenaiva pratihareyuḥ
tgt: pavamānayoruttarayormadhyandinārbhavayordhiṣṇyeṣvagnivihāre mārjālīyamagniṃ carantaḥ paścimena yajamānasya hṛtvā tenaiva punarnayeyuḥ avyavāyārtham udgātṛṛṇāmanena karmaṇa kaḥ sambandha iti cet ucyate uktaṃ yājamānabrahmatve cedudgātā kuryāditi tatra sambandhaḥ

src: madhyandinena stutvā satreṣu dadhigharmasya bhakṣayeyuḥ samupahūya dadhikrāvṇa iti
tgt: mādhyandinena pavamānena stutvā satreṣu dadhigharmasya ekadeśaṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ sarve samupahūya na mithaḥ dadhikrāvṇa ityetayarcā

tasyā ṛcaḥ daśame'hani sātrike uttamaṃ padaṃ abhyasyeyuḥ punarbrūyuḥ anuṣṭuppārokṣārtham atha tasyā iti kimarthaṃ prakṛtaiva sā ucyate daśame'hani tārttīyasavanike dadhibhakṣe tasyā ṛcaḥ uttamābhyāsaḥ syāt hetusamatvāt tanmābhūditi

src: pūrveṇa patnīśālām antareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ sadaś ca dakṣiṇā nayeyus tīrthena
tgt: pūrveṇa patnīśālāṃ gamayitvā āgnīdhrīyasadasorantareṇa dakṣiṇā nayeyuḥ āpnānena tīrthena

sarvāsāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ devasya tvetyetadādi mantraḥ purastājjapaḥ syāt natu sarvāsāmiti kimarthaṃ dakṣiṇānāmiti bahuvacanāt siddheḥ ucyate, uktaṃ pūrveṇa patnīśālāmantareṇānāgnīdhrīyaṃ sadaśca dakṣiṇā nayeyustīrtheneti, anucyamāne etasminnanena dakṣiṇāpathena nayanaṃ yāsāntāsāmevaiṣa purastāt syāt nānyāsāmiti tanmābhūdityata ārabhyate sarvāsāmiti kathaṃ yāśca na nīyante sarvāsāmeva purastājjapaḥ syāditi yathā nimittaṃ dhānyapalyam udīcīmudgātre mukhyebhyo grāmavarāndadatītyetadādi
varuṇastvetyetadādi yajurjapitvā yathādevataṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt yathā dakṣiṇāyā devatāṃ nānoddiśya yathā varuṇāyāśvamiti
pratigṛhṇīyāditi varttate yā yasya jātistāmādiśya yathāvayave mṛgamiti
aprāṇacca yadravyaṃ yacca yathājāti pratigṛhṇīyāt na prāṇiti tadaprāṇam anindriyamityarthaḥ

puṃvanmithunāni gṛhṇīyāt yathā aśvaścāśvī cāśvau puruṣaśca puruṣī ca puruṣau anyatrājābhyaḥ ajāṃstu mithunadharmeṇa na pratigṛhṇīyāt nānādevatātvāt anyaivājāyā devatā anyaivājasya agnaye'jam agniṣomābhyāmajāmiti
sāvitrāderdakṣiṇāpratigrahamantrasya tenāmṛtatvamaśīya ka idaṃ kasmā adādityupariṣṭājjapaḥ

src: tatrohāpādīni tvā devi dakṣiṇe 'da iti ca yat tat syāt tena dātra idam āviśaitat ta iti ca bhuñjatīti ca bhūyāddhiṃsīr iti ca
tgt: tatra tasmin dakṣiṇāpratigrahaṇe ūhāpādīni ūhamāpadyante ūhāpādīni ūhitavyaṃ vyaktivacanaiḥ kā vyaktiḥ strīpuṃnapuṃsakādivacanamekatvaditvabahutvāni nanu adhikṛte mantre tatreti kimartham ucyate, ūhanityatādarśanārthaṃ tatra tasmin mantre sati ūhametānyāpadyante tvāṃ devi dakṣiṇe ada iti ca yat tat syāt tena dātre idaṃ viśa etatte iti ca bhuñjatīti ca bhūyāt hiṃsīriti ca ūho vakṣyate devasya tvā devasya vāṃ devasya vaḥ, varuṇastvā nayatu devi dakṣiṇe, varuṇo vāṃ nayatu devo dakṣiṇe varuṇo vo nayatu devyo dakṣiṇaḥ varuṇāyāśvaṃ varuṇāyāśvau varuṇāyāśvān varuṇāyāśve varuṇāyāśvaḥ, tenāmṛtatvamaśīya tābhyāmamṛtatvamaśīya tairamṛtatvamaśīya tayāmṛtatvamaśīya tābhyāmamṛtatvamaśīya tābhiramṛtatvamaśīya, vayaḥśabdasya bhūyācchabdena saha sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ tadyadyapyayaṃ ūhapadeṣu na parisaṃkhyātaḥ tathāpyūhayitavyaḥ bhūyācchandena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt vayodātre bhūyāt vayasī dātre bhūyāstāṃ vayāṃsi dātre bhūyāsuḥ vayodātṛbhyāṃ bhūyāt vayasī dātṛbhyāṃ bhūyāstāṃ vayāṃsi dātṛbhyāṃ bhūyāsuḥ vayodātṛbhyo bhūyāt vayasī dātṛbhyo bhūyāstāṃ vayāṃsi dātṛbhyo bhūyāsuḥ, ka idaṃ kasmā adāt ka ime kasmā adāt ka imāni kasmā adāt ka imaṃ kasmā adāt ka imau kasmā adāt ka imān kasmā adāt ka imāṃ kasmā adāt ka ime kasmā adāt ka imāḥ kasmā adāt, samudramāviśet samudramāviśetāṃ samudramāviśan dvivacanabahuvacanayorlaṅ ādeśāt sūtravidhānāt, kāmaitatte kāmaite te kāmaitāni te kāmaiṣa te kāmaitau te kāmaite te kāmaiṣā te kāmaite te kāmaitāste, kāmāya bhuñjatī bhuñjatyo bhuñjatyaḥ mā mā hiṃsīḥ mā mā hiṃsiṭam mā mā hiṃsiṣṭa

src: aśvarathaṃ ced dadyāt pūrveṇāgnīdhrīyam avasthāpya purastājjapaṃ japitvā darbhamuṣṭināśvamukhāni saṃmṛjyād dvābhyāṃ dvābhyām aśvanāmābhyām ekaikasyāśvo 'sīty etatprabhṛtibhir udaksaṃstham iti dhānañjapyaḥ
tgt: yadyaśvarathaṃ dadyād yajamānaḥ tamaśvarathamudgātā āgnīdhrīyasya pūrve pradeśe samīpe sthāpayitvā purastājjapañjapitvā purastājjapa uktaḥ devasya tveti darbhamuṣṭināśvamukhānāṃ saṃmārjanaṃ kuryāt dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmaśvanāmabhyāṃ ekaikasyāśvasya aśvo'sītyetatprabhṛtibhiraśvanāmabhiḥ udaksaṃsthandakṣiṇopakramam evaṃ dhānañjapya ācārya āha
dhuri yuktau dhuryau aśvau tau prathamaṃ saṃskuryādityaparaṃ vidhānam
dakṣiṇasyāndhuri yoyuktastaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃskuryāt paścāduttaramiti
yathā dhuryau tenaiva krameṇa praṣṭī saṃskuryāt pārśvavarttinau praṣṭī
sarvāṇyaśvanāmāni aṣṭāvapi ekaikasminnaśve prayuñjīta dakṣiṇādārabhyānantaryeṇa udaksaṃsthamiti śāṇḍilya ācārya āha
sarvairaṣṭābhiraśvanāmabhirekāśvasya dakṣiṇasya mukhaṃ saṃmṛjyāt tūṣṇīmitarāṇi saṃmṛjyāt udaksaṃsthameva ityaparaṃ vidhānam

src: etāny evāśvāśvatareṣv aśvatarīṣu ca yathārtham ūhet
tgt: etānyevāśvanāmāni aśvāsu aśvatareṣu ca aśvatarīṣu ca yathārthamūhet yadyaśvābhiryuktaḥ syāt aśvatarairvā aśvatarībhirvā tatra tatra yathāsambhavamūhet ūha ucyate aśvāsi antyāsi mayyasi hayāsi vājinyasi saptinyasi vṛṣṇyasi arvatyasi iti aśvataro'si śeṣāṇyaśvavat aśvataryasi śeṣāṇyaśvāvat

src: tribhiś ced ardhāny ekasminn ardhāni dvayor dvaidhaṃ dvayoḥ
tgt: tribhiścedyukto bhavati arddhānyekasmin prayuñjīta arddhāni dvyoḥ dve dve nāmanī pūrvoktenaiva krameṇa dvaidhandvayoḥ yadi dvābhyāṃ yukto bhavati tadā dvidhā nāmāni vibhajya yuñjīta pūrvoktenaiva krameṇa
ādityānāmityetadyajuḥ rathaśira ālabhya japet śiraḥpravṛttīrathakārebhyo jñeyā

src: yad rathyaṃ syād vāyor iti carmaṇyaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt
tgt: rathasyedaṃ rathyaṃ yatkiñcidrathāṅgaṃ carmaṇyaṃ carmaṇā nirvṛttaṃ carmaṇyaṃ tadvāyoṣṭvetyanena yajuṣā pratigṛhṇīyāt
yadasthimayaṃ rathyaṃ tannakṣatrāṇāmityanena yajuṣā pratigṛhṇīyāt
sūryasyetyanena yajuṣā kārṣṇāyamaṃ yatsyāt rathyaṃ tāmrarajatakāṃsyarītikādibhyo lohebhyo nirvṛttaṃ tat pratigṛhṇīyāt

anenaiva mantreṇa pratigṛhṇīyāt yadrathyaṃ vakṣyati hiraṇyamiti jātarūpaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāditi mantrāmnānasāmarthyādetasmin krameṇa dravyadevatopadeśaḥ kṛtaḥ pratigrahavidhistu prakaraṇe eva vakṣyate sāmprataṃ rathaśira ālabhyānantaram

src: dakṣiṇena rathaṃ gatvā rathantaram asīti dakṣiṇaṃ cakram ālabhet
tgt: dakṣiṇena rathasya gatvā rathantaramasītyanena yajuṣā dakṣiṇaṃ cakramālabhet
vāmadevyamasītyanena yajuṣā adhiṣṭhānamālabhet rathamāruhya rathī yat sthānamadhitiṣṭhati tadadhiṣṭhānam
bṛhadamītyanena yajuṣottaraṃ cakramālabhet
aṅkānyaṅkū ity anena yajuṣā cakrayoḥ saṃmārjanaṃ kuryāt eveti pravṛttāvadhāraṇaṃ kriyate
vaiśvānara ityanena yajuṣā dakṣiṇena pādena prathamamārohet
ubhābhyāmāruhya gidaiṣata ityetad yajurjapet
kṛśetyanena yajuṣā yau rathasya savye pārśve'śvau tayoraśmīnāyacchet āyatan kuryāt raśmīniti bahuvacanamubhayato raśmayo bhavantyaśvānām
dāsetyanena yajuṣā dakṣiṇayoraśvayoraśmīnavagṛhṇīyāt avagrahaṇamātraṃ nātyantaṃ gacchet

src: avaruhya sakṛd vāruṇam uktvā yathādevatam ādiśyopariṣṭājjapaṃ japed iti gautamaḥ
tgt: avatīrya rathāt sakṛdvāruṇaṃ yajuruktvā yathādevatamādiśya uktaṃ vāyoriti carmaṇyaṃ pratigṛhṇīyādityetadādi dravyāmāmaśvānāṃ rathasya gautama ācārya āha

src: saṃmārjanaprabhṛty etat sarvaṃ kṛtvā vimucya nānā purastājjapopariṣṭājjapau vāruṇam aśvebhyo rathāya ceti dhānañcapyaḥ
tgt: saṃmārjanaprabhṛtyavarohaṇāntaṃ etat sarvaṃ kṛtvā vimucyāśvau nānā ekaikasmin dravye purastājjapopariṣṭājjapo bhavetāṃ vāruṇantu yajuḥ aśvārthameva syādrathārthañceti evaṃ dhānañjapya ācārya āha

src: glāyec ced yathāsanaṃ va tat sarvaṃ japet
tgt: yady etat karma notsahedyathādeśaṃ kartuṃ tadā audumbaryāmevopaviṣṭa etat sarvaṃ japet

src: pṛṣṭhyaṃ ced dadyāt prāg vāruṇād aśvanāmāni japet
tgt: yadi pṛṣṭhyamaśvandadyād yajamānaḥ pṛṣṭhena vahatīti pṛṣṭhyaḥ, tadā purastājjapaṃ japitvā prāgvāruṇāt mantrādaśvanāmāni japet
prāgiti prakṛtam
tathā adānteṣvaśveṣu yathā pṛṣṭhyaḥ tena prakāreṇetyarthaḥ

src: yad rathyaṃ syāt tena tat pratigṛhṇīyāt
tgt: rathyamiva rathyaṃ carmaṇyādi yaddravyaṃ rathena tulyaṃ tena tat pratigṛhṇīyāt
annasyānnapatirityetadyajuḥ prāgvāruṇat mantrādaveḥ pratigrahe japet, nanu tat kimidaṃ prāgvāruṇāditi yadā prāgeva vāruṇāt mantrādayaṃ mantraḥ paṭhitaḥ ucyate vikalpārthaṃ vakṣyati purastājjapādeti
vāruṇādvā prāk puratastājjapādvā japet
gnāstvā kṛtaṃ nityetadyajuḥ vāsasaḥ pratigrahe prāgvāruṇāt syāt purastājjapādvā
tadā gnāstvā kṛtanniti yajuḥ utkṣipet atāntave vasane yanna tantubhyonirvṛttaṃ tadatāntavaṃ navatādi carmaṇyaṃ kucitrādi

src: hiraṇyam alpīyo bhogād āgacched audumbaryām āśleṣayet
tgt: hiraṇyamalpīyaḥ yasya bhogo nāsti tadaudumbaryāmāśleṣayet
agnīdhrīye vā taddhiraṇyaṃ juhuyāt na bhogāya kalpet
ekasmin kratau vrīhiyavān samastān pratigṛhṇīyāt na vyastān na pṛthagityarthaḥ, apare bruvate ekakratāviti jyotiṣṭome etat tadyadāhurekāyajña ityetasmāt
yathā vrīhiyavān tathā tilamāṣān tena prakāreṇetyarthaḥ pratigṛhṇīyāditi varttate
yāsāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ devatā anādiṣṭāstāḥ prājāpatyena mantreṇa gṛhṇīyāt prajāpataye gardabhamityetadādivat

yā ayajñe dakṣiṇāḥ tāsu pratigrahaṇamantro nivarttate ityevaṃ dhānañjapya ācāryo manyate kaḥ punarayajñādhikāra iti ucyate yajñasya udgātre kaściddhiraṇyādikaṃ dadāti yathā hiraṇyamalpīyo bhogādāgacchedādumbaryāmāśleṣayediti yajñasya ṛtvijo deva iti ca kanyāpradānādi tatra tūṣṇīṃ pratigṛhṇīyāditi
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarityanena pratigṛhṇīyāt evaṃ gautama ācārya āha
omityevaṃ vā pratigṛhṇīyāt evaṃ manyate gautamaḥ

src: pūrvaṃ nārāśaṃsaṃ bhakṣayitvāhavanīye prastotā pṛṣṭhahomaṃ juhuyād yat pṛṣṭhaṃ syāt tad ādiśyādaḥ pibatu somyaṃ madhv āyur dadhad yajñapatāv avihrutam imaṃ yajñam abhisaṃvasānāhotrās tṛpyantu sumanasyamānāḥ svāheti pūrvam
tgt: dakṣiṇāpratigrahavidhānamuktaṃ sāmpratamanantaraṃ pṛṣṭhyasyopākaraṇaṃ tatsambaddhaṃ prastotṛkarmocate dvau nārāśaṃsau mādhyandine tayoḥ pūrvaṃ bhakṣayitvā āhavanīye'gnau prastotā pṛṣṭhahomaṃ juhuyāt tasminnahani yat pṛṣṭhaṃ syāttadādiśya adaḥ pibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurityetadādinā mantreṇa ada iti sarvanāmasthāne rathantaraṃ pibatvityetadādivat
pūrvaṃ yathoktena mantreṇa hutvā uttarāṃ svāhākāreṇa juhuyāt

src: dvaidhaṃ juhuyād iti dhānañjapyo 'daḥ pibatu somyaṃ madhv āyur dadhad yajñapatāv avihrutaṃ svāheti pūrvām imaṃ yajñam ity uttarām
tgt: dvaidhaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā evaṃ juhuyāditi dhānañjapya ācārya āha
hotṛkapṛṣṭhārthamevamabhisambandhaṃ kṛtvā

src: revatīṣu vāravantīyam iti ṣaṣṭhe pṛṣṭhādeśaṃ gautamo mahāvratam iti vrate
tgt: revatīṣu vāravantīyaṃ pibatu ityeva ṣaṣṭhe'hani pṛṣṭhādeśaṃ gautama ācāryo manyate mahāvrataṃ pibatvitvevaṃ mahāvrate

src: revatyaṃ ca vāravantīyaṃ ceti dhānañjapyo yāvanti pṛṣṭhasthāni syuḥ sarvāṇy eva prasaṃcakṣīta pibatu dadhad iti ca yathārtham ūhet
tgt: revatyaśca vāravantīyañcetyevaṃ ṣaṣṭe'hani pṛṣṭādeśaṃ dhānañjayo manyate yāvanti sāmāni mahāvrate pṛṣṭhasthāni bhavanti sarveṣām eva parisaṃkhyānaṃ kuryāt pibatu dadhaditi caite pade yathārthamūhet prayogastu revatyaśca vāravantīyañca pibatāṃ somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhatīti śeṣo mantraḥ sāmānyaḥ evaṃ ṣaṣṭhe gāyatrarathantarabṛhadrājanabhadrāṇi pibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhatī dadhantīti cetyevaṃ mahāvrate mantraśeṣaḥ sāmānyaḥ evetyuktam ubhayapakṣeṇāmnātaṃ bhadre pucche yajñāyajñīye ca pucche yathārthaṃ na kevalamevaṃ ṣaṣṭhamahāvratayoḥ yatra catrānekamāmapṛṣṭhatā tatra tatraivamarthasamatvāt

src: bṛhatā rathantareṇa vā stoṣyamāṇaḥ prāk stomayogād daśa vyāhṛtīr manasā dhyāyed airam iti
tgt: bṛhatā rathantareṇa vā stoṣyamāṇaḥ stotumicchan udgātā stomayogātpūrvaṃ daśa vyāhṛtīrmanasā dhyāyedairamityetadādyāḥ yathāmnānādeva siddhe daśatve saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ daśeti cet ucyate anuliṅgaṃ vibhāgo mābhūditi, vyāhṛtigrahaṇaṃ saṃvyavahārārthaṃ vakṣyati ṛcaṃ pūrvaṃ vyāhṛtibhya iti

src: rathantara evarcaṃ yas te goṣv iti
tgt: rathantara eva kevale ṛcaṃ dhyāyet yaste goṣvityetāṃ evaśabdaḥ anyatra prayukte rathantare mābhūditi ṛcamiti saṃvyavahārārthameva ṛcaṃ pūrvaṃ vyāhṛtībhya iti

src: yuktvā stomam etad brūyād iti śāṇḍilya ṛcaṃ pūrvyaṃ vyāhṛtibhya iti
tgt: yadetaduta prāk stomayogāddaśa vyāhṛtīrmanasā dhyāyedairamityetadādi etayuktvā stomaṃ brūyāditi śāṇḍilya ācārya śraha ayantu kramaḥ ṛcaṃ pūrvaṃ vyāhṛtībhya iti
yatpūrvamuktaṃ tat dhānañjapyasya matam

rathantare sāmni prastūyamāne sarvatra sammīlet yāvatkṛtvaḥ prastuyate tāvatkṛtvaḥ sammīlanaṃ kuryāt atha sarvagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet ucyate evaṃ brāhmaṇam īśvaraṃ vai rathantaramudgātuścakṣuḥ pramathitaḥ prastūyamāne saṃmīletsvardṛśaṃ prativīkṣeteti prathamāyāmṛcyasya vidheḥ kriyāṃ darśayati svardṛśaṃ prativīkṣeteti tena yadviṣayameva prativīkṣamāṇamādiśyate tadviṣayamevaṃ sammīlanaṃ gamyate so'yamācāryaḥ sarvatretyevamārabhate kathamuttarayorapi stotrīyayoḥ sammīlanaprativīkṣaṇe bhaveyātāmiti yāvatā rathantaradharmo'yaṃ nāyamugdharmaḥ svardṛśaśabdaḥ kālamātrajñāpakaḥ vakṣyati prāk pratihāraṃ caturakṣaraṃ śiṣṭvā tat sarvatra prativīkṣeteti apare varṇayanti vakṣyatyayaṃ tasyāpṛṣṭhasya sato nivartterandharmā iti tatkathaṃ nivarttamāneṣvanyeṣu dharmeṣu sammīlanaṃ syāditi ataḥ sarvatragrahaṇamiti

src: ekaikaṃ manasākṣaraṃ stobhair vācā saṃyuñjyāt prathamasvarair akārair bhakārādibhir akrāntair dvitīyasvarottamaiḥ
tgt: ekaikamudgīthākṣaraṃ manasā dhyāyet stobhairvācā saṃyuñjyāt uktaṃ brāhmaṇe balvalā kurvatā geyamiti etat stobharūpaṃ sūtrakāraḥ śrutyantaraṃ dṛṣṭvā vikalpayati prathamasvarairakārairbhakārādibhirakrāntairiti akṣarāṇāṃ stobhānāñca yugapatkriyāṃ darśayati balbalā kurvatā geyamiti prathamasvarairakāraiḥ uktasvarāḥ prathamadvitīyatṛtīyacaturthamandrātisvāryā iti tairakārairbhakārādibhirbhakāra uccāraṇārthaḥ bhakāraiste akārā uccāryyante akrāntaiḥ akrāntāḥ tān prayuñjīta dvitīyasvarottamaiḥ yasteṣāmuttamo varṇaḥ sa dvitīyena svareṇa syāt

evaṃ prayujyamānaṃ rathantaraṃ yathādhītaṃ prayuktaṃ bhavatīti evamācakṣate etacchrutyantaraṃ yathādhītaṃ prayoktavyamiti atha eke bruvate eteṣāmeva balvaleti stobhānāṃ anukaraṇambhakāra iti aparā śrutiḥ rathantare tvakṣarambhakārāntaravanti vyañjanāni yathākṣaraṃ darśayet tadyathā svareṇa sarvāṇi vyañjanāni vyāptānyevaṃ sarvān kāmānavāpnoti yaścaivaṃ veda yasyaite svaravantaḥ prayujyante yaścaivaṃ vidvān prayuṅkte yathā cāgnicandrasūryyabhāsvanto'pahatatamaskāstaddudgātṛyajamānau bhavata evaṃ hyāha bhātyagnirbhāti candramā bhāti sūryo bhānti jyotīṃṣi bhāti rathantaramiti bhakārāṇāmeva dīptiṃ darśayati svaravatāṃ rathantarasya stobhānāṃ svaravantaḥ prayoktavyā iti yatra tu vyañjanavantaḥ prayujyeran kṣodhukā ca badhyāyināvaprajasāvudgātṛyajamānau syātāntasmādanvakṣaraṃ prayuñjānaḥ svaravanti vyañjanāni yathākṣaraṃ darśayet ekā śrutiḥ tasmādikalpaḥ syāt

src: prāk pratihārāc catukṣaraṃ śiṣṭvā tat sarvatra prativīkṣeta
tgt: prāk pratihārāccatvāryyakṣarāṇi śiṣṭvā taccaturakṣaraṃ prativīkṣeta sarvagrahaṇasya prayojanaṃ sammīlanavidhāvevoktam
stutvā rathantareṇa yajamānaṃ varaṃ prati prerayet

tasya rathantarasya apṛṣṭhasya sataḥ nivartteran dharmāḥ vyāhṛtyṛgvācādayo dharmāḥ sarve nivartteran ato'sya grahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet ucyate tasyeti tasyaiva na bṛhadvāmadevyayostu punarapi rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhayoḥ sato nivartterandharmāḥ tathā sata iti pṛṣṭhagatasya tu rathantarasya guṇabhūtasyāpi sato naiva nivartterandharmāḥ tathā bṛhataḥ

saha stobhairdharmmā nivarttarannityevaṃ gautama ācāryo manyate nanu sarve evāśeṣeṇa dharmā nivṛttāḥ kutastobhanivṛttiryena gautamastobhānnivarttayatīti ucyate, vakṣyati stobhā evānviyuriti dhānañjapyaḥ iti uktaṃ paramatamanumatamapratiṣiddhamiti tena gautamasyāniṣpṛṣṭā eva stobhakriyāḥ
sarve'nye dharmāḥ apṛṣṭhasya nivartteran stobhā eva kevalā anviyurityevaṃ dhānañjapyo manyate
agniṣṭomasāma vā yadā syāt sandhisāma vā tadā apṛṣṭhamapi stobhet evaṃ śāṇḍilya āha

src: sarvatrāsvastotrīyaṃ na stobhed iti sthaviro gautamaḥ
tgt: sarvatra pṛṣṭhagatañcānyat sthānagatañcāsvastotrīyaṃ na stobhediti sthaviro gautama āha

src: vāmadevyena stoṣyamāṇaḥ prāk stomayogād gāvo aśvā ajā vayo vrīhayo yavā iti manasā dhyāyet
tgt: bṛhadrathantarayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣadharmāścoktāḥ sāmprataṃ vāmadevyadharmā vivakṣitāḥ tānvivakṣurāha / vāmadevyena stoṣyamāṇa iti vāmadevyena sāmnā stoṣyamāṇaḥ stotumichan pūrvaṃ stomayogāt gāvo aśvā ajā ityetadādi manasā dhyāyet anyo'nyadharma uktaḥ yathākulīputrāniti, atha visamāsaḥ kimarthamiti cet go'śvājāvivrīhiyavān manasā dhyāyet ityevaṃ vaktavyamāsīt ucyate yadyevamavakṣyat tadā gavādīnāṃ dravyāṇaṃ dhyānamabhaviṣyat tadevaṃ mābhūdityata āha ācāryo gāvo aśvā ityetadādi tena kiṃ gāvo aśva ityetadādi mantraṃ manasā dhyāyediti

src: brahmasāmni yaḥ kāmo yajamānasya syāt sa sidhyatv iti dhyāyann upāsīta
