tgt: brahmasāmni stūyamāne yaḥ kāmo yajamānasya bhavet sa sidhyatvityevaṃ dhyāyan yajamāna upāsīta atra sandehaḥ kiṃ kratukāmasya dhyānaṃ utayathākāmyaṃ kāmasya dhyānamiti ucyate, kratukāmasya dhyānaṃ na yathākāmyaṃ kathametadgamyata iti cet ucyate, uddeśanirdeśābhyāṃ yaḥ sa iti yaḥ kratukāmasta dhyāyediti anyathā hi brahmasāmni yajamānaḥ kāmaṃ dhyāyedityevamavakṣyatsūtram
tathā itara udgātā yajamānasya kāmaḥ sidhyatvityevaṃ dhyāyannudgāyet

src: ārbhaveṇa stutvā puroḍāśād ekaikaṃ piṇḍaṃ trīṃs trīn vāparayā dvārā havirdhānaṃ prapadyādhastāt svasya camasasya kuryur yadāsannaḥ syād atra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyadhvam iti
tgt: ārbhavena pavamānena stutvā tārttīyasavanikātpuroḍāśāt ekadeśaṃ gṛhītvā ekaikaṃ piṇḍantrīṃstrīnvā aparayā dvārā paścimayā dvārā havirddhānaṃ praviśya adhastātsvasya camamasya samīpe darbheṣu piṇḍānnidadhyuḥ yasmin kāle āsāditaḥ syāt havirddhāne camasaḥ piṇḍānnidhāya japeyuḥ atra pitaromādadhvaṃ yathā bhāgamāvṛṣāyadhvamiti

src: tam āhriyamāṇaṃ pratimantrayerann amīmadanta pitaro yathābhāgam āvṛṣāyiṣateti
tgt: taṃ camasaṃ bhakṣārthamāhriyamāṇaṃ pratimantrayerannamīmadanta pitara ityanena

src: somyam āhṛtam udgātāvekṣetāyur me prāṇa iti
tgt: somyaṃ carumāhṛtaṃ udgātāvekṣeta āyurme prāṇa ityetadādinā yajuṣā sādhyānāṃ vai devānāṃ satramāsīnānāmityetadādi brāhmaṇaṃ somyasyāvekṣaṇaṃ darśayati udgātṛgrahaṇaṃ ācāryaśailī sarveṣāṃ karmaṇi prakṛte avaśyamudgātṛgrahaṇaṃ karoti

asya somyāvekṣaṇayajuṣaḥ punarasmāsu dadhmasītyeṣo'ntaḥ atrocyate uttarādiḥ pūrvāntalakṣaṇamiti evaṃ vijñāyamāne mantrasyānte tat kimidaṃ vijñāpanaṃ kriyata iti ucyate vakṣyati taṃ daśame'hanyabhyasyeyuriti tatraitāvanmantrābhyāsapradarśanārthamiti
tamavekṣaṇamantrasyāntaṃ daśame'hani dvirbrūyuḥ
āyurme prāṇa ityetasya prāṇamantrasya sthāne yanme yamamityetameke ācāryyā manyante
tuśabdo vyāvṛttyarthaḥ yadetat pūrvoktamavekṣaṇamantraṃ tenaivāvekṣeta na dvitīyena

src: tasminn aṅguṣṭhānāmike avadhāyākṣiṇī vimārjīta yenā hy ājim iti
tgt: tasminnuttaradhṛte somye carau aṅguṣṭhañca anāmikāṅguliñcāvadhāya akṣiṇī vimṛśet yenāhyājimityetadādinā yajuṣā tasmin grahaṇaṃ yadi pūrveṇa yadyuttareṇāvekṣeta kuryādevaitat
evamanena vidhinā itarā praṣṭī kuryātām
eṣa kramaḥ prastotā pūrvaḥ paścāt pratiharttā
tamavekṣitaṃ somyaṃ pratihartturuttareṇa hṛtvā paścimayā dvārā niṣkrāmayeyuḥ yadi vā brāhmaṇoktena vidhinā prāśnīyāt dakṣiṇā sadaso gatvaitaṃ somyātiśeṣaṃ prāśnīyāditi
patnī codgātāram īkṣeta

src: nidhanaṃ prati patnī dakṣiṇam ūrum abhiṣiñcet
tgt: nidhane ucyamāne patnī pātre'ñjalībhiradbhiḥ svaṃ dakṣiṇamūrumabhiṣiñcet tat dakṣiṇānūrūnabhiṣiñcanta iti hi brāhmaṇam

src: tṛtīyāyāṃ stotrīyāyāṃ prastutāyāṃ sarvaṃ tad udakaṃ ninayet
tgt: tṛtīyāyāṃ stotrīyāyāṃ prastutāyāṃ patnī svasminnūrau sarvantadudakaṃ ninayet sarvaśabdo niravaśeṣavācī utpattistotrīyāyāṃ karmastotrīyāyāṃ prastutāyāmiti vivadante tṛtīyāśabdena karmastotrīyāyāṃ nyāyyataram

src: uttamāyāṃ stotrīyāyāṃ bhuvadvājāyibhuvadvājeṣv ity abhyasyennāmiti ca nidhanam anuṣṭubham uttamām akṣareṇāntata iti hy āheti
tgt: stotrasyottamāyāṃ stotrīyāyāṃ bhuvadvājāyi bhuvadvājeṣviti evamabhyāsaṃ kuryāt asya caturakṣarasyābhyāse sati nāmiti ca nidhanaṃ kuryāt yasmādevaṃ brāhmaṇam anuṣṭubhamuttamāṃ sampādayatīti akṣareṇāntataḥ pratiṣṭhāpyamiti ca

src: anabhyāsaṃ tv ācāryā nidhanaṃ ca yathāmnāyaṃ śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: anabhyāsamevācāryā manyante caturakṣarasya nidhanañca yathāmnāyameva kuryurityevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācāryo manyate anabhyāsañceti caśabdaḥ tuśabdo hetvarthaḥ ko hetuḥ yasmātpakṣopanyāsabrāhmaṇamevedaṃ prakaraṇādito vā iti hi

src: tad yadānuśaṃsan hotāpohiṣṭhīyā brūyāt tadainam anvālabherann apāvṛṇvānāḥ
tgt: tadyajñāyajñīyaṃ yadā yasmin kāle anuśaṃsan hotāpohiṣṭhīyā ṛcā brūyāt tadā tasmin kāle enaṃ hotāraṃ anvālabheran spṛśeyuḥ apāvṛṇvānāḥ prāvaraṇānyapāsyamānāḥ apāvṛṇvānā iti sarveṣāṃ pūrvaṃ prāvṛtānāṃ kriyāṃ darśayati uktaṃ prāvṛtenodgeyamiti vaiśvānareṇānabhidāhāyeti tat sūtrakāraḥ sarveṣāṃ prāvaraṇaṃ darśayati hetusamatvāt kiṃ hetusamatvam anabhidāhaḥ
yajñāyajñīyasyāgniṣṭomasāmno'nyasthāne prayujyamānasya sarve dharmā nivartteran

src: yad anyad agniṣṭomasāma syāt tasya syuḥ
tgt: yadanyadagniṣṭomasāma bhavet tasya dharmā bhaveyuḥ
ahiṅkāretvagniṣṭomasāmni pratihāravelāyāṃ patnīmudgātā īkṣeta patnī codgātāram

src: anubrāhmaṇam ārcikān saṃnāmān sarvatra kuryād apy anyasmin sāmni
tgt: ye brāhmaṇe ṛcaṃ sāmni pratisannāmā uktāḥ evaṃ kṛtvodgeyaṃ paprīmvayamiti suśaṃsiṣamiti caitān sarveṣvagniṣṭomasāmasu darśayati sarvagrahaṇaṃ pavamānagate'pi yajñāyajñīye bhavati na kevalaṃ yajñāyajñīye apyanyasmin rathantare'pi atha sāmnīti kimarthaṃ ucyate yadā rathantareṣvṛkṣu anyatpṛṣṭhaṃ kriyate tattadāpi asyuṣa iti susṭuṣa iti vā sannāmayet

src: tṛtīyasavane sarveṣu stotreṣu samāpteṣu bhakṣayitvā stomaṃ vimuñceyur ṛtasya tveti
tgt: tṛtīyasavane sarveṣu stotreṣu samāpteṣu bhakṣayitvā camasaṃ stomavimocanaṃ kuryuḥ ṛtasya tvetyanena yajuṣā, natu tat kimidaṃ tṛtīyasavanagrahaṇaṃ yadā sarveṣu stotreṣu samāpteṣvityuktam ucyate idantāvadyajurupari sandhibhakṣātmamāmnātaṃ tatra vimocanaṃ yajuṣā tasminneva krame prāpnoti ataḥ tṛtīyasavanagrahaṇaṃ tāvatkrayate kathaṃ na kevalamupari sandhibhakṣāt stomavimocanaṃ syāt yasyāṃ yasyāṃ saṃsthāyāṃ kratuḥ samāpyate tasyāntasyāṃ saṃsthāyāṃ syāditi atha sarvagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet stotreṣviti bahuvacanasāmarthyātsiddhe sarvatve idamucyate idaṃ stomavimocanaṃ kratvantastotre dṛṣṭaṃ pratistotrañca stomayojanaṃ bhavati yuktasya ca vimocanaṃ bhavatyeva tasya ca yuktasya stomasya yasmin kāle vimocanamityeṣa saṃśayaḥ ataḥ sarvagrahaṇaṃ karotyācāryaḥ kathaṃ pūrveṣvapi stotreṣu ekaikasmin stotre bhakṣayitvā stomaṃ vimuñceyuḥ atra tu tṛtīyasavane kathamiti
saṃlobhanaṃ ekatrīkaraṇaṃ kuryuḥ

src: yajamānavācanād anantaram atra vā yajamānaṃ vācayet taṃ tavemā jyotiṣety asāv anumātanu hi jyotiṣeti yathājyeṣṭhaṃ putrāṇāṃ nāmāni gṛhṇīyāt
tgt: yajamānavācanādanantaraṃ yadetat stutasya stutamasīti yajamānavācanaṃ etasmādanantaraṃ etat karma kuryāt tadvakṣyate atra vā asmin kāle kuśānāṃ saṃlobhanaṃ kṛtvā kuryuḥ iti vikalpaḥ tantave mā jyotiṣetyuktvā asāvanumātanuhi jyotiṣeti yathājyeṣṭhaṃ putrāṇaṃ nāmāni gṛhṇīyāt asāviti sarvanāmasthāne nāma gṛhṇīyāt yo yo jyeṣṭho yathājyeṣṭhaṃ prayogastu tantave mā jyotiṣā yajñadatta anumātanuhi viṣṇumitra anumātanuhi somabhūte anumātanuhi jyotiṣā apare pratyekaṃ purastājjapopariṣṭājjapau kurvanti

ajāteṣu putreṣu janiṣyamāṇa iti sarvanāmasthāne kuryāt prayogastu tantave mā jyotiṣā janiṣyamāṇa anumātanuta jyotiṣā ajātaputrasyaiṣa kalpaḥ apare bruvate jātaputro'pi putrāṇāṃ nāmāni gṛhītvā janiṣyamāṇa iti gṛhṇīyāt āśīryogatvāt janiṣyamāṇa ityajāteṣviti pratipattiriyamiti

src: jāteṣv ajāteṣu ca putrā ity eva satreṣu
tgt: jāteṣu ajāteṣu ca putreṣu satreṣu putrā ityevaṃ nāmagrahaṇaṃ prayogaḥ tantave mā jyotiṣā putrā anumātanuta jyotiṣā yadyekaḥ kuryāt tathāpi bahuvacanaṃ kuryyāt no'haṃ kuryyāt

src: vaṣaṭkṛte hāriyojanasya yathetam aparayā dvārā niṣkrāmanto japeyuḥ somehīti
tgt: vaṣaṭkṛte hāriyojanasya haviṣaḥ hāriyojanasyetyavayavalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī yathetaṃ yathāgatamityarthaḥ dakṣiṇenaudumbaryyā gatvā paścimayā dvārā niṣkrāmanto japeyuḥ some hītyetadādi yajuḥ athāparayā dvāreti kimarthaṃ yadā yathetamityukte siddhamevaitat te hi samastopasthānaṃ kṛtvā aparayaiva dvārā praviṣṭāḥ atrocyate visaṃsthite savane pūrvayā dvārā sañcara ityuktaṃ na cātra savanaṃ santiṣṭhate tadyadyaparayeti na brūyāt visaṃsthite sañcareṇa nirgamaṇaṃ syāt evaṃ mābhūdityata āha aparayeti yathetamiti cokte te piṇḍaṃ pitṛyajñaṃ kṛtvā pūrvayā dvārā praviṣṭāḥ tatraiṣo'pi sañcaro gamyetāparayetyanucyamāne
subhūrasītyanena yajuṣā ādityamupatiṣṭheran
yadyastamitaḥ syādādityaḥ tato'nena yajuṣā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭheran ko'sya viṣayaḥ ṣoḍaśīvājapeyau anyasmiṃśca kālātikrame

src: āgnīdhrīye dve āhutī juhuyur apāṃ puṣpam iti pūrvāṃ svāhākāraṇottarām
tgt: āgnīdhrīye'gnau juhuyurgatyānupūrveṇa apāṃ puṣyamityanena yajuṣā pūrvāmāhutiṃ juhuyāt svāhākāreṇottarāṃ athāhutī iti dvivacanena dvitve siddhe kimidaṃ saṃkhyāgrahaṇaṃ dve iti ucyate niyamārtham ekaṃ anena hiraṇyamalpīyo bhogādāgacchedaudumbaryāmāśleṣayedāgnīdhrīye vā juhuyāditi tasya hiraṇyasyāyaṃ homakālaḥ yāsau dvitīyā āhutistasyāmeva hiraṇyaṃ prakṣipya juhuyāditi

src: hāriyojanyo nāma dhānā droṇakalaśe bhavanti tāsām udgātā prathama ādadānaḥ samupahūtā bhakṣayiṣyāma iti brūyāt
tgt: hāriyojanya iti saṃjñā dhānānāṃ droṇakalaśe tāḥ sthāpitā bhavantyadhvaryubhiḥ somamiśrāḥ tāsāṃ dhānānāmavayavamudgātā ādadānaḥ samupahūtā bhakṣayiṣyāma iti brūyāt ādānaṃ grahaṇam
tathetarau yathodgātā kuryyāt tenaiva vidhinetarau praṣṭī kuryyātām

src: unnetary upahavam iṣṭvā hāriyojanasya ta iti tirohyasyety atirātre yathādhītaṃ vā sarvatra dvir upaghrāya paścād āhavanīyasyāntaḥ paridhi nivapeyuḥ
tgt: unnetari ityadhikaraṇasaptamī upahavamiṣṭvā upahavaṃ yācitvā hāriyojanasya ta ityetena yajuṣā yadvakṣyate tat kuryuḥ tirohyasyetyatirātre etadadhikaṃ kuryyuḥ yathādhītaṃ vā sarvatra atirātre cānatirātre ca dvirupaghrāya āhavanīyasya paścime pradeśe paridhīnāmabhyantarato nivapeyuḥ nāgnau
yadi paridhayaḥ anuprakṛtāḥ prakṣiptā agnau bhavanti tadā bhasmānte samīpe nirvapeyuḥ

src: apa upaspṛśyāṣṭāv aṣṭau śakalāny āhavanīye prahareyur devakṛtasyety etatprabhṛtibhir ikārāntaiḥ
tgt: upadhānāt anantaraṃ apaḥ spṛṣṭvā ekaikaḥ aṣṭau aṣṭau śakalāni āhavanīye prakṣipeyuḥ devakṛtasyetyetatprabhṛtibhirmantraiḥ ikārāntairiti mantrāntajñāpanārtham
sarvān mantrānuktvā sakṛdeva sarvāṇi sakalāni uttamena mantreṇa prakṣipeyuriti śaucivṛkṣirācārya āha

src: apsu ṣomā nāma camasāś cātvāladeśe 'dbhiḥ pūrṇās teṣu haritāni tṛṇāni prāstāni bhavanti
tgt: apsu ṣomā iti saṃjñā te apsu ṣomāścamasāścātvālasannikṛṣṭe deśe adbhiḥ pūrṇā sthāpitā bhavanti teṣu haritāni tṛṇāni prāstāni bhavantyadhvaryubhiḥ

src: te svaṃ camasauṃ paryupaviśyāpsu dhautety avamṛśya japeyuḥ
tgt: te udgātāraḥ svakīyacamasasannidhāvupaviśya dakṣiṇena pāṇinā spṛṣṭvā apsu dhautetyetadādi yajurjapeyuḥ
madhumantamityanena yajuṣā pāṇīnupajigheran

src: śam adbhya ity udañcaṃ camasaṃ ninayeyuḥ
tgt: śamadbhya ityanena yajuṣā udaṅmukhaṃ camasaṃ kṛtvā tatsthā āpaḥ nīcaiḥ camasaiḥ bhūmau ninayeyuḥ
kāmetyanena yajuṣā abhimukhamātmanaḥ camasasāvarttayeyuḥ
ūrgityanena yajuṣā uraḥsu pāṇīnnidadhīran nidhānaṃ sthāpanam
prāṇasometyanena yajuṣā mukhyān prāṇānabhimṛśeran mukhe bhavā mukhyāḥ prāṇa indriyāṇi akṣiṇī nāsike karṇāviti

src: āgnīdhrīyaṃ gatvā dadhibhakṣaṃ bhakṣyeyur asamupahūya dadhikrāvṇa iti
tgt: āgnīdhrīyapariśritaṃ gatvā dadhibhakṣaṃ bhakṣayeyurasamupahūya dadhikrāvṇa iti anayā ṛcā asamupahūyeti samupahvānapūrvakāḥ sarve bhakṣā vihitāḥ tadiha bhūyastvaṃ gṛhītvā pravartteta tasya pratiṣedhaḥ asamupahūyeti
agniṣṭapatīti stobhaliṅgena avabhṛthasāmādeśaḥ ukto grahaṇena ceti

tasyāvabhṛthasāmna āvṛdvidhiḥ yathā prathamasya pravargyasya sāmnaḥ yena prakāreṇetyarthaḥ prathamaṃ pravargyasāma tyagnāyirityetat atha tasyeti kimarthamiti cet ucyate avabhṛthasāmāntarāṇyupadekṣyante abhiṣecanīyāśca trirātrayoḥ tadarthaṃ tasya grahaṇam

tasyāvabhṛthasāmnaḥ sarva ṛtvijo nidhanaṃ brūyuḥ sarvagrahaṇaṃ yathā prathamasya pravargyasāmnaḥ ityuktaṃ tasmiṃśca gharmopayuktānāṃ nidhanopapattiḥ tanmābhūdataḥ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kathamiha sarveṣāmṛtvijānnidhanopapattiḥ syāditi
abhiṣecanīye kratau iṣṭāhotrīyamavabhṛthasāma syāt
samasyeti vāvabhṛthasāma syādityabhiṣecanīye iṣṭāhotrīyaṃ veti vikalpayati
uktamahīneṣu dadhibhakṣāntānyahāni prāgudayanīyādatirātrāditi ca ayamaśvatrirātre viśeṣaḥ nānāvabhṛthānyahānīti nānā pṛthagityarthaḥ

src: teṣāṃ prathamasya sanād agra ity avabhṛthasāma
tgt: teṣāmāśvamedhikānāmahnāṃ prathamasyāhnaḥ sanādagna ityetadavabhṛthasāma syāt avabhṛthasāmagrahaṇaṃ tatra sāmamātraṃ na kṛtsno'vabhṛtha iti

src: yad vā uviśyatir iti dvitīyasya tyagnāyir iti vā
tgt: yadā uviṣyatirityetat sāma dvitīyasyāhno'vabhṛthasāmeti prakṛtaṃ tyagnāyiriti vā vikalpaḥ tṛtīyasya siddhaṃ prākṛtam

src: avabhṛthe 'ṣṭau saṃsthitāyām avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerur asi nicumpuṇāva devair devakṛtam eno yāsiṣam ava martyair martyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣas pāhīty apa upaspṛśya trir abhyukṣeran
tgt: avabhṛtheṣṭau samāptāyāṃ avabhṛthanicuṃpuṇetyetadādinā yajuṣā yāścāvabhṛtheṣṭiṃ kurvanti tāḥ spṛṣṭvā snātvā nirabhyukṣeran kriyābhyāse sakṛnmantra ityuktam

src: ādityam upatiṣṭherann ud vayaṃ tamasas pari jyotiḥ paśyanta uttaraṃ svaḥ paśyanta uttararaṃ devaṃ devatrā sūryam aganma jyotir uttamam iti
tgt: abhyukṣaṇānantaraṃ ādityamupatiṣṭheran udvayantamamasparītyetadādinā mantreṇa
yadyastamita ādityaḥ syāt tadāhavanīyamupatiṣṭheran udvayantamasasparītyetayarcā viśeṣa uktaḥ prāgeva prastamitaścedgārhapatyamityetasmin

src: tasmin samidha ādadhyur edho 'sy edhiṣīmahīti prathamāṃ samid asi samedhiṣīmahīti dvitīyāṃ yad enaś cakṛmā vayaṃ yad vānyakṛtam ārimānayā samidhā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tad apamṛjya ha iti tṛtīyām
tgt: tasminnāhavanīye sarve samidha ādadhyuḥ ādhānaṃ prakṣepaḥ edhosyedhiṣīmahītyetadādibhiryathoddiṣṭairmantraiḥ atha tasminniti kimarthamiti cet yadāstamitaścedāhavanīyamityadhikṛta evāhavanīyaḥ atrocyate upasthite cānupasthite ca tasminsamidha ādadhyureva anyathā tasyopasthāne sati samidādhānaṃ syāt

src: tam evopatiṣṭherann apo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samaganmahi payasvān agna āgamantaṃ mā saṃsṛja varcaseti
tgt: tamevāhavanīyamupatiṣṭheran apo adyānvacāriṣamityetadādinā mantreṇa apśabdena somamupacarati somamiṣṭvā bhakṣayanti tameveti prakṛtāvadhāraṇam ādityasya samupasthānamuktam ataḥ tamevāhavanīyamityavadhārayanti

src: prāg udayanīyād atirātrād apsu ṣomāntam ahaḥ satreṣu
tgt: satreṣu udayanīyādatirātrātpūrvāṇi yānyahāni teṣu dadhibhakṣādikarmaśeṣo na bhavati
ahīneṣu dadhibhakṣāntānyahāni bhavanti prāgudayanīyādatirātrāditi varttate

src: yāvanty ahāni rājānaṃ bhakṣayeyus tāvat svabrāhmaṇyocchiṣṭaṃ na dadyur adbhir vā prokṣya dadyuḥ
tgt: yāvantyahāni rājānaṃ somaṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ ṛtvijastāvat svabrājñaṇayocchiṣṭaṃ na dadyuḥ adbhirvā prokṣya chādanaṃ kṛtvā dadyuḥ kimidam ucyate, śrutyantareṣu dṛṣṭaṃ rājanyavaiśyayoḥ somabhakṣābhāvo bhakṣaviśeṣāmnānāditi evaṃ vidhiṃ sūtrakāraḥ prakārāntareṇa darśayāmāsa

src: tad eṣa ślokaḥ somam etat pibata yat kiṃcāśṇīta brāhmaṇā mā brāhmaṇāyocchiṣṭaṃ dātam āyāt somam asomapa iti
tgt: tadeṣa śloka iti etamevārthamanuvadati somametat pibatetyetadādinā ślokena

src: evaṃ parikramaṃ sarvakratuṣu vidyāt sarvakratuṣu vidyāt
tgt: yo'yaṃ mantravidhiścādigrahaṇenetyetadādividhiḥ parikrānta etaṃ sarvakratuṣu jānīyāt, nanu uktaḥ sarvakratvadhikāra iti tat kimidaṃ punarucyate sarvakratuṣu vidyāditi ucyate antaprajñāpanārthaṃ kathaṃ atha vidhyavyapadeśe sarvakratvadhikāra iti etadādividherayamanta iti etaṃ sarvakratuṣu vidyāditi apara āha, sarvakratoradhikāraḥ sarvakratvadhikāra iti sarvakratuḥ jyotiṣṭomaḥ kutaḥ śruteḥ eṣa vā prathamo yajñānāmityuktvāha yathā vā idamagnerjātādagnayo vijñayanta evametasmādadhyanye yajñā vihriyanta ityuktvāha yo hi trivṛdanyaṃ yajñakratumāpadyate sa tandīpayatītyetadādyuktvāha etadyadāhureko yajña ityetaddhi sarve jyotiṣṭomā bhavantīti etadvidhānamāpadyamānāḥ sarve jyotiṣṭomā bhavantīti sarvakratuṣu jyotiṣṭomaḥ tadādāveva sarvakratvadhikāra iti jyotiṣṭomādhikāraḥ teṣāṃ punaruktadoṣo nāsti evaṃ jyotiṣṭomavidhiṃ sarvakratuṣu vidyāt adhikavidheśca pratyāhāraṃ kuryāt
yo'yaṃ ṣoḍaśigrahasyāvekṣaṇe vidhiruktaḥ ṣoḍaśisāmnā stoṣyamāṇa ityetadādi tenaiva prātaḥsavane'pyavekṣeta yadi prātaḥsavane'pi gṛhyeta prātaḥsavane ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhītantaṃ tṛtīyasavane prajanayati
yadyuttarayorapi savanayorgṛhṇīyuḥ tayorapyanenaiva prakāreṇāvekṣeta

src: aśvaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pūrvasyāṃ sadasodvāri pratyaṅmukhas tiṣṭhed iti dhānañjapyaḥ
tgt: uktaḥ aśvaḥ kṛṣṇa upatiṣṭhati sāmyekṣyāyai tasya sthānanirddeśaḥ kriyate aśva iti pratītapadārthakaḥ śabdaḥ kṛṣṇa iti varṇanirdeśaḥ pūrvasyāṃ sadaso dvāri pratyaṅmukhastiṣṭhediti dhānañjapyaḥ ācārya āha
aparasyāṃ sadaso dvāri prāṅmukho'śvastiṣṭhedevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācārya āha
kṛṣṇasyāśvasyābhāve śyāvaḥ syāt śyāva ityanirukto varṇaḥ na kṛṣṇo na śvetaḥ tayorantareṇa varttate

tasyābhāvaḥ tadabhāvaḥ taditi pūrvanirddeśaḥ tasya śyāvāśvasyā bhāve yaḥ kaścāśvaḥ syāt atha yaḥ kaśca iti siddhe kiṃ punaraśvagrahaṇamadhikaṃ kriyate'śva iti ucyate, anyatrāpyabhāve yaḥ kaścāśvaḥ syāt yathā tasmā amumādityamaśvaṃ śvetaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇamānayanniti tathā aśvaśyāvo dakṣiṇā sahyaniruktaḥ sabrahmaṇe deya iti tatrāpi śvetaśyāvayorabhāve yaḥ kaścāśvaḥ syāt

yadyaśvo na syāt gaurvājo vā bhavet athehāśvagrahaṇaṃ punaḥ kimartham ucyate, tadabhāve yaḥ kaścāśva ityuktaṃ śvetaśyāvayorapyabhāve madyaktopahavyayoḥ yaḥ kaścāśva iti tayorapi gaurvājo vāśvābhāva iti prāpnoti tannivṛtyarthamaśvagrahaṇaṃ karoti, kathaṃ, ṣoḍaśinyeva gaurvājo vāśvābhāve bhavet na tathātayorapīti

src: yo yaḥ sāmāṅgaṃ brūyāt sa hiraṇyaṃ dhārayet
tgt: uta hiraṇyasampradānaṃ ṣoḍaśinā stuvata iti tadvivekārthamāha, yo yaḥ ṣoḍaśisāmnaḥ aṅgaṃ brūyāt sa sa hiraṇyaṃ dhārayet svasyāṃ svasyāṃ bhakto
udgātā nidhanaṃ bruvatsu taṃ hiraṇyaṃ dhārayet
sarve vā hiraṇyamabhimṛśeyurnidhanamupayantaḥ
avasarpatyāditye ṣoḍaśisāmnaḥ prathamaṃ paryāyaṃ gāyet channam aprakāśam ava adhobhāve sṛgatau nanu kathametadgamyate yathā avasarpatyāditya iti ucyate upariṣṭādvakṣyatyastamite tṛtīyamāviriti
vigate site visite vigate śukle varṇe dvitīyaṃ paryāyaṃ gāyenmadhyamena svareṇa
astaṅgate āditye tṛtīyaṃ paryāyaṃ gāyet prakāśam

iha prathamaṃ kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ avasarpati prathamaṃ paryāyamityetadādi so'yaṃ vikalpayati yadā yasmin kāle upākuryuradhvaryavaḥ tasminneva kāle stuvīran na svaṃ kālamādriyeran apare viniveśaṃ varṇayanti sandhikāle ṣoḍaśini atyagniṣṭome'hani atirātre rātrāviti, apare bruvate vicāritaṃ, kimarthamidam ṣoḍaśina udgāturiti ucyate atrācāryyāṇamubhayathā pratipattiḥ yeṣāmaharante teṣāmahanyupākaraṇaṃ yeṣāṃ rātrī teṣāṃ rātrāviti ato'yamācārya ārabhate yadopākuryuḥ tadā aprakāśaṃ stuvīranneveti atha tatra kaḥ svara ityucyate
yadāhanyupākuryuḥ tadā aprakāśaṃ stuvīran rātrau prakāśam

udgātre dadyād yajamānaḥ aśvahiraṇye aśvaśca hiraṇyañcāśvahiraṇye dakṣiṇavatsu yajñeṣu atha dakṣiṇavatsviti kimartham adakṣiṇeṣu dānaprasaṅga eva nāsti ucyate, paśyatyayaṃ satreṣvaṅgadakṣiṇāprasaṅga tena satyapyaṅgadakṣiṇāprasaṅge satreṣu ṣoḍaśinyaśvahiraṇye nivarttayati

src: satra eva grahasya bhakṣayeyur aindraṃ saha ity udasya harivadaharikāsu cet stuvīran
tgt: ṣoḍaśigrahasya satra eva bhakṣayeyuḥ nekāhāhīneṣu aindraṃ saha ityanena yajuṣā udasya harivadaharikāsu stuvīran yo'smin yajuṣi harivacchandaḥ tam utkṣipya utsṛjya yadyaharikāsu ṛkṣu ṣoḍaśinaṃ stuvīran atha punaḥ harivatīṣu sṭuvīran naiva harivacchandamudasyeyuḥ harivat kṛtameva mantraṃ prayuñjīran atraivaśabdaḥ kimarthaṃ satra eveti ucyate, na kevalaṃ ṣoḍaśigrahasya anye ye grahāsteṣāmapi ca satra eva bhakṣayeyuḥ naikāhāhīneṣu etasyānyatarasmin tryahe nigrāhyāṇāṃ dravyānāṃ bhakṣayeyurityetadādinā
ṣoḍaśini stotre yaścamasaḥ tasyānuṣṭupcchandasā bhakṣayeyuḥ
mantreṇa camamasya bhakṣayeyuḥ aindraṃ maha ityanena udasya harivadaharikāsu stuvīrannityanuṣajyata eva

src: tathā kurvann indraś ca samrāḍ varuṇasya rājā tau te bhakṣyaṃ cakratur agra evaṃ tayor aham anubhakṣyaṃ bhakṣyāmi vāg juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatv iti grahasya
tgt: tathā kurvan pūrveṇa mantreṇa camamasya bhakṣaṇam indraśca samrāḍvaruṇasya rājetyetadādinā yathāsūtritena mantreṇa grahasya bhakṣayeyuḥ

src: indram iti vā vāg devī somasya pibatv ity etad adhikayā
tgt: indramiddharivadityetayarcā vāgdevī somasya pibatvityetadadhikayā bhakṣayediti vikalpaḥ

src: aindraṃ saha iti camasasya sattre triṣṭupchandasā vājapeyasāmni bhakṣayed iti gautamaḥ
tgt: vājapeyasāmni triṣṭupcchandasā ityeva chanda ādeśaṃ kṛtvā bhakṣayediti gautama ācārya āha tacchandastvāt stotrasva
anuṣṭupcchandasā vājapeyasāmni bhakṣayediti dhānañjapyaśāṇḍilyāvācāryāvāhatuḥ yadūrddhvamukthebhyaḥ anuṣṭubhaḥ sabhāga iti anuṣṭupcchandasā rātrau
na bhakṣayeyuḥ anuṣṭubhatvāt rātreḥ
pṛthaṅnānetyarthaḥ nānātṛcebhyaḥ sandhau hiṃkuryuḥ nānādaivatyatvāttṛcānām
iṣṭayajuṣa ityanena yajuṣā sandhau bhakṣyaḥ
atiriktastotreṣu gāyatracchandasā bhakṣaṇamiti evaṃ gautama ācāryyo manyate samāpteṣu bhakṣachandaḥsu punarupakrame ko'nyo gāyatryāt syāditi

yāni catvāri bhakṣachandāṃsi taiḥ pṛthak pṛthak ānupūrvyeṇa caturṣvanavekṣya tadānupūrvyeṇa bhakṣayeyuriti dhānañjapyaśāṇḍilyāvācāryāvāhatuḥ sambhavācca sarveṣāṃ bhakṣachandasām arthācca, ko'rthaḥ agnyādīnāṃ devatānāñca chandobhāvāt
mantreṇa bhakṣayeyuḥ anuṣṭupbhāganimittatvāt yadūrddhvamukthebhyaḥ anuṣṭubhaḥ sabhāga iti
achandasā vā mantreṇa bhakṣayeyuḥ upayuktatvāt bhakṣyachandasām
yathā vā mantrī tathā vā bhakṣayeyuḥ pravṛttatvāt mantrasya anupadeśādvānyeṣām

src: āhitāgnir asomayājī paraṃ somena yājayitvā paribhakṣaṃ kurvīta
tgt: uktāḥ ṣoḍaśino dharmāḥ somasya ca bhakṣavidhānamuktaṃ yāvadatiriktastotrāṇīti sāmpratamupari bhakṣavidhānamucyate āhitāgniḥ āhitā agnayo yena sa āhitāgniḥ somayājī yena somena iṣṭāṃ sa somayājī na somayājī asomayājī param anyaṃ somena yājayitvā aparibhakṣaṃ kurvīta aparibhakṣa iti karmaṇaḥ saṃjñā parasyāgniṣu yena somo bhakṣitaḥ tena svāgnayaḥ paribhakṣitāḥ pitaraśca tadaparibhakṣārthamidaṃ karmārabhyate nanu āhitāgnigrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti yadā avakṣyadasomayājīti nahyanāhitāgneḥ somayāgaḥ syāt anyārthena vāhitāgnitvaṃ vijñāpyate iha gārhapatyadakṣiṇāgnyāhavanīyeṣu ājyādhiśrayaṇadrapsānidhānājyagrahaṇānyādekṣyante hutāyāṃ prātarāhutāvājyaṃ gārhapatye'dhiśrityodagudvāsayet kaṃse camase vā drapsānavadhāya dakṣiṇāgnāvupasādayet sphyadarbhamuṣṭī ca paścimena gārhapatyaṃ gatvā paścādāhavanīyasyopaviśya sruveṇa srucyājyaṃ gṛhṇīyādyāvadgṛhītī syāditi asya ca karmaṇo nāntareṇāhitāgneḥ prasiddhiḥ tadevamarthādāhitāgnitve siddhe yaducyate āhitāgnirityetadanarthakaṃ tasmādāhitāgnigrahaṇaṃ na karttavyaṃ kriyamāṇe kāraṇaṃ vaktavyam ucyate, yadyāhitāgnigrahaṇaṃ na kuryyāt anāhitāgneryājanaprasaṅgo na syāt so'yamāhitāgnigrahaṇaṃ karoti āhitāgnirasomayājī paraṃ somena yājayitvā itthaṃ karma kuryāt anāhitāgniryājayitvāpi paraṃ na vedaṃ kuryyāt yāvatā tasyāgnayo naiva santi yeṣāmaparibhakṣārthannaivedaṃ karma kriyate athāsomayājīti kimarthaṃ yāvatā vakṣyati somayājyapīti śāṇḍilya iti somayājigrahaṇaṃ kathamucyate aniṣṭaprathamasyedaṃ karma syāt iti somayājī hi anāhitāgnirapi bhavati satreṣu tathāpyasāvasomayājyeva atha paragrahaṇaṃ kimarthaṃ yadā yājayitva siddhametat paramiti ucyate, paragrahaṇaṃ parameva yājayitvā na pitaraṃ vā putraṃ vā bhrātaraṃ veti nirguṇaḥ svajanaḥ ebhyo yo'nyaḥ paraḥ para eva saḥ
somayājyapyetat karma kuryāditi śāṇḍilyaḥ ācārya āha, sāmpratamasyāparibhakṣasya karmaṇaḥ karttavyatocyate
hutāyāṃ prātarāhutau ṛte'gnihotre ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ gārhapatyāgnāvadhiśritya udak udāsayet

src: kaṃse camase vā drapsān avadhāya dakṣiṇāgnāv apasādayet
tgt: kaṃse vā bhājane dārave vā camase dadhidrapsānavadhāya dadhyavayavān dakṣiṇāgneḥ samīpe sthāpayet
sphyaśca darbhamuṣṭiśca sphyadarbhamuṣṭī dakṣiṇāgneḥ samīpe sthāpayet

src: paścimena gārhapatyaṃ gatvā paścād āhavanīyasyopaviśya sruveṇa srucy ājyaṃ gṛhṇīyād yāvad gṛhītī syāt
tgt: drapsān sphyadarbhamuṣṭī ca sthāpayitvā anantaraṃ paścimena pradeśena gārhapatyasya gatvā āhavanīyasya paścime pradeśa upaviṣya yattadājyaṃ gārhapatye'dhiśrityodagudvāsitaṃ tasmāt sruveṇa sruci gṛhṇīyāt yāvadgṛhītī sthāt yadi caturgṛhotī yadi pañcagṛhītī

src: taj juhuyād imām agne śaraṇiṃ mīmṛṣo na imam adhvānaṃ yam agāma dūram āpiḥ pitā pramatiḥ somyānāṃ bhrimir aspṛṣi kṛnmatyānāṃ svāheti
tgt: yadi caturgṛhītaṃ yadi pañcagṛhītaṃ tajjuhuyādimāmagne ityetadādinā yathāsūcitena mantreṇa

src: evam eva gṛhītvāpāṃ puṣpam asty oṣadhīnāṃ raso 'gneḥ priyatamā tanūr indrasya priyatamaṃ chaviḥ svāheti
tgt: evameva gṛhītvā yadi caturgrahītaṃ yadi pañcagṛhītaṃ apāṃ puṣpamity etadādinā yathāsūtritena mantreṇa juhuyāt

src: ājyasya pūrvān grahān gṛhītvā dadhna uttamaṃ viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāheti
tgt: ājyasya pūrvān grahān gṛhītvā yadi caturgṛhītaṃ trīnājyasya gṛhītvā dadhna uttamaṃ yadi pañcagṛhītaṃ catvāra ājyasya gṛhītvā dadhna uttamaṃ viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāheti anena yajuṣā juhuyāt

src: dadhiśeṣaṃ srucy ānīyodaṅṅ āvṛtya prāśnīyāt tava soma vrate vayaṃ manas tanūṣu piprataḥ prajāvanto aśīmahīti
tgt: dadhno gṛhītāvadānasya avayavaḥ syāt taṃ srucyānīya sruci kṛtvodaṅṅāvṛtya prāśnīyāt tava soma vrate vayamityetadādinā yathāsūtritena mantreṇa

src: prakṣālya srucaṃ yathetaṃ pratyāvrajya prācīnāvītī bhūtvā dakṣiṇā dakṣiṇāgneḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ samuhyādbhiḥ saṃprokṣya sphyena sakṛd ullikhyolmukam upanidhāya darbhān upastīryāpa upaninīyāmīṣāṃ drapsānāṃ nipṛṇuyād avamebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhā saha bhakṣebhya iti prathamam
tgt: prāśya dadhiśeṣam ācamya prakṣālya srucaṃ adbhistatkṣaṇaṃ saucaprāpteḥ yathāgataṃ pratyāvrajya dakṣiṇāgneḥ samīpaṃ prācīnāvītitvamuktaṃ gṛhye evaṃ prācīnāvītī bhavatīti tatkṛtvā dakṣiṇāgneḥ dakṣiṇe pradeśe sthaṇḍilaṃ samuhya śodhayitvā adbhiḥ samprokṣya sphyena sakṛdullikhya ullekhanaṃ kṛtvā ulmukaṃ upanidhāya ulmukaṃ lekhāyāḥ samīpe nidhāya darbhānupastīrya apo ninīya darbheṣu amīṣāṃ drapsānānnipṛṇuyāt ye te dadhidrapsāḥ kaṃse camase ca kṛtvā dakṣiṇāgneḥ samīpe sthāpitāḥ teṣāmekadeśaṃ gṛhītvā teṣu darbheṣu nipṛṇuyāt nidadhyāt avamebhya ityanena yathāsūtritena mantreṇa prathamam

src: aurvebhyaḥ kāvyebhya ity evam eva dakṣiṇā pṛthak
tgt: yo'yaṃ vidhiruktaḥ prathamasya niparaṇasya anenaiva vidhinā tasya dakṣiṇārddhe dvitīyasya niparaṇaṃ kuryyādaurvebhya ityanena mantreṇa tadanantaramanenaiva vidhinā tṛtīyaṃ nidadhyāt kāvyam ityanena uktaṃ pitṛbhiriti sarvatrānusaṃharedityetadādi

src: atra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgam ity uktvodāvartetāsitvā yāvan manyeta tāvad abhiparyāvartamāno japed amī madanta pitaro yathābhāgam anantaritāḥ pitaraḥ somapīthād iti
tgt: evaṃ sarveṣāṃ nidhānaṃ kṛtvā atra pitaro mādayadhvaṃ yathābhāgamityuktvā āsitvā yāvat manyeta tāvat yāvantaṃ manyeta manuṣyāṇāṃ bhojanakālaṃ tāvantamāsitvā bhuktaṃ pitṛbhiriti matvā tataḥ ābhimukhyena paryyāvarttamāno japet amīmadanta pitara ityetaṃ yathāsūtritaṃ mantram

src: tān darbhān drapsāṃś ca dakṣiṇāgnau praharet
tgt: tān darbhān yeṣu niparaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tāṃśca drapsān ye nihitāḥ tān dakṣiṇagnau praharet prakṣipet

src: yajñopavītī bhūtvāpa upaspṛśya gṛhān vrajañ japed gṛhā mā bibhīta mā vepiḍhvam ūrjaṃ bibhrata evam asy ūrja bibhrad vaḥ sumanāḥ sumedhā gṛhān emi manasā daivena yeṣām adhyeti prasavasanneṣu saumanaso bahur gṛhān upahūyāmahe teno jānantu jāna upahūtā isa gāva upahūtā ajāvayo 'tho annasya yo rasa upahūto gṛheṣu na iti
tgt: iha prācīnāvītinā karmma kṛtaṃ paitṛkamanantaramāha yajñopavītī bhūtveti yajñopavītī bhūtvāpa upaspṛśya apaḥ spṛṣṭvā gṛhān vrajan japati gṛhāmābibhītetyetadādi yathāsūtritaṃ mantram atrocyate gṛhān vrajan japedityāha athedaṃ pūrvaṃ karma kasmiṃsciddeśe kṛtamiti yenedānīmāha gṛhān vrajan japediti tatraike tāvadvarṇayanti so'gnihotra evāsau yajñabhūmigataḥ atastasmin deśe idaṃ karma kṛtamiti ato'nantaraṃ gṛhān vrajannidañjapediti, apare varṇayanti tretāgniśaraṇaṃ havirgṛhebhyaḥ pṛthageva bhavati tasminnidaṃ karma kṛtvā gṛhān vrajannetajjapediti, ubhayamaviruddham

src: paścācchālāgner upaviśya japed iha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvam ihāśvā iha puruṣā iho sahasradakṣiṇo 'pi pūṣā niṣīdatv iti
tgt: gṛhān praviśya śālāgneḥ paścime pradeśe upaviśya japediha gāvaḥ prajāyadhvamityetadādi yathāsūtritam

src: agnes tṛṇāni pratyuhya yaḥ suhṛt tam abhibhāṣeta
tgt: śālāgneḥ samīpe yāni tṛṇāni prātarhomastaraṇasambandhīni tāni pratyuhya yo'sya suhṛttasya pitā vā putro vā bhāryā vā taṃ prathamamabhibhāṣeta

src: goṣu gā api sṛjed upedam upaparcanam āsu goṣūpṛcyatām uparṣabhasya retasy upendra tava vīrya iti
tgt: goṣu gā apisṛjet yā asya svāgāvaḥ tāsu yā dakṣiṇā prāptāstāmiśrayet upedamupaparcanamiti yathāsūtritena mantreṇa

sāmpratamasya gavāmayanasya vidhiḥ vivakṣitaḥ taṃ vivakṣuḥ sarvasatrāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ vidhānamārabhate satreṣu sarvānadhvayurdīkṣayediti satreṣvityadhikaraṇe saptamī sarvāniti niravaśeṣavācī śabdaḥ satreṣu sarvān satriṇaḥ adhvaryurdīkṣayet

src: dīkṣiṣyamāṇān darśayet svasty ātreyam arundhatīṃ dhruvam udapātraṃ ya eṣo 'kṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyate
tgt: dīkṣiṣyamāṇān svastyātreyādīni darśayet dṛśirau prekṣaṇe svastyātreya ādarśaḥ ṛjvanyat
kimarthaṃ punareṣāṃ darśanamucyate naitāni parāsuḥ paśyati yeṣāṃ parābhūtāḥ asavaḥ prāṇaḥ mumūrṣavaste svastyātreyādīni na paśyantīti
tān parāsūnna dīkṣayet kasmādyataḥ asamāpte satre teṣāṃ mṛtyurbhavati etat vidhānaṃ saṃvatsarasatraṃ yāvaddraṣṭavyaṃ ūrddhvaṃ mṛtasya vidhānadarśanāt

src: dīkṣiṣyamāṇāḥ saṃvaderan saha naḥ sādhukṛtyā nānā pāpakṛtyā yāsmin sattre
tgt: dīkṣākāle upasthite saṃvaderan etat samayaṃ kuryuḥ saha naḥ sādhukṛtyāḥ sādhūnāṃ karmaṇāṃ yā kriyā sā naḥ sādhāraṇī yā pāpānāṃ mā pṛthak asmin satre

src: atha yat purā cakṛma kartāsmaśca yathopasthitam eva nas tad iti
tgt: atha yatpurāsannāḥ kṛtavantaḥ karttāsmaḥ yathoktaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ yathopasthitameva nastaditi yadyaḥ karoti tasyaiva taditi, nanu anukte'pyevameva nahyanyena kṛtamanyasminnṛcchati karmakarttāraṃ gacchati atrocyate, prāk satradīkṣāyāḥ teṣāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ iṣṭakāpaśurbhavati ūrddhvañca vakṣyati saṃvatsaraṃ saṃvaseyurdaśarātramahorātrau vā yāvadvā sunuyuriti tatkā svanivṛtyarthamārabhate yāsmin satre iti
teṣāṃ satriṇāṃ dīkṣāmārabhya patnīśālāyāṃ bhojanaṃ saṃveśanañca bhavetāṃ prabhṛti śabda ādau
upavasathyāhna ārabhya satriṇāṃ bhojanasaṃveśane āgnīdhrīye bhaveyātām
dvayor api sandhivelayorvāgyamanaṃ kuryuḥ āsūryodayādānacatradarśanācca

vāgyamanādanantaraṃ yāṃ vācaṃ bhāṣeran tāṃ vicakṣaṇantāṃ vicakṣaṇamante yasyāḥ mā vicakṣaṇantā, apare bruvate vicakṣaṇantāmiti sādhyantāṃ vācaṃ brūyuriti pūrva eva tu yaḥ śreyān tasya sādhuvacanaprasaṅgo'sti
yo'pyavaśyamabhivādanīyaḥ tamapi nābhivādayeran canetyayaṃ nipātaḥ netyayaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ
na śūdreṇa saha sambhāṣaṇaṃ kuryuḥ
ye parigṛhītā agnayaḥ tānmuktvā anyeṣvagniṣu nottaperan
ṛjvarthaḥ
devayajanasya prāgudagvā niṣkramya mūtrapurīṣe kurvīran
nāprayojanaṃ bahu vadeyuḥ
na kasyaciddantān darśayeran jāyate vāva dīkṣayeti
havirucchiṣṭabhakṣāḥ syuḥ
nainān bhuñjānānanyaḥ paśyet pariveṣṭṛbhyo'nyatra
sarveṣāṃ savanānāṃ savanamukhīyān bhakṣayitvā mantreṣu nārāśaṃseṣu bhojanaṃ kuryuḥ
ṛjvarthaḥ
etāni yathoddiṣṭavratāni dīkṣāsu bhavanti
athavā dīkṣāsu copasatsu ca
yāvad vā sattrasamāptir iti etāni yathāsambhavaṃ syuḥ
ādityasya udayāstamayau abhyāśrāvaṇañca haviṣaḥ prasṛte sutyāsu bahirvedi varjayeyuḥ eteṣu kāleṣu bahirvedisthānamāsanaṃ vā varjayeyuḥ

src: teṣāṃ ced enāṃs trayāṇāṃ kiṃcid eyād grahapatāv upahavam iccheran
tgt: teṣāṃ udayāstamayābhyāśrāvaṇānāṃ bahirvedi sthānaṃ kiñcidāgacchet gṛhapatāvupahavamiccheran upahave gṛhapatiradhikaraṇabhūtaḥ gṛhapateḥ sakāśādupahavamiccheyuḥ
taṃ yadi gṛhapatiḥ eṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ kiñcidāgacchet udgātuḥ sakāśādupahavaṃ gacchet
dīkṣānupūrvyeṇa vā yo yasyānantaraṃ dīkṣitaḥ ma tasmādupahavamicchet
vasatīvarīpariharaṇe kṛte tataḥ svapeyuḥ

src: teṣāṃś cet kaścit preyād atīrthena nirhṛtyāhāryeṇānāhitāgniṃ daheyuḥ
tgt: teṣāṃ sattriṇāṃ yadi kaścit mriyeta tamatīrthena nirhṛtya niṣkrāmya āhāryyeṇāgninā anāhitāgnindaheyuḥ teṣāṃ satriṇāṃ āhāryeṇa laukikenetyetadvidhānaṃ anāhitāgnerapi satrāsanaṃ darśayati

src: araṇyor agnīn samāropya te āpnānena nirhṛtya nirmathyenāhitāgnim
tgt: araṇyoḥ agnīn samāropaṇaṃ kṛtvā mantravatte araṇī āpnānena tīrthena nirhṛtya nirmanthyenāgninā āhitāgniṃ daheyuḥ te iti kimartham ucyate, preto'trādhikṛtaḥ ataste ityāha, te araṇītīrthena nirhareyuḥ natvāhitāgnimapi tīrthena, nanu yadā tāvaduktaṃ dīkṣiṣyamāṇān darśayet svastyātreyādīni naitāni parāsuḥ paśyatīti tānna dīkṣayediti tadadarśitā naiva dīkṣante tat kimidamārabhyate teṣāñcet kaścit preyādityādi atha punastaddarśito'pi mriyante tataḥ tadvidhānānarthakyam ucyate yānyetāni nimittāni tāni parimitakālāni teṣāṃ dīrghasatreṣvasambhavaḥ ato vidhānaṃ tadartham

src: madhyamasya rātriparyāyasya daivodāsaṃ hotṛṣāma syād aurdhvasadmanaṃ vā
tgt: iha satriprakaraṇe madhyame paryāye dve hotṛṣāmanī paṭhite tayośca dvayorekasmin kratau sambhavo nāsti ekārthatvāt ato bravīti daivodāsaṃ hotṛṣāma syādaurddhvasadmanañceti vikalpayati satre

src: abhiplavasya dvitīye 'hani bhargoyaśa iti prāgviṣuvato vyatyāsaṃ syātām iti gautamaḥ
tgt: iha maśakaḥ paṭhatyābhiplavike dvitīye'hni paritoṣiñca tāsu tamiti mādhuchandasañca bhargaśca yaśo veti tat kimayaṃ viniveśārthaṃ vibhāṣitaḥ athaikatra yaddvayameva vikalpayati so'yamācāryo viniveśaṃ vikalpayati abhiplavasya dvitīye'hani bhargo yaśa iti prāgviṣuvatovyatyāsaṃ syātāmiti ye prāgviṣuvato'bhiplavāḥ teṣu bhargasya yaśasīti dvitīye'hani vyatyāsaṃ syātāmiti prathame bhargaḥ dvitīye yaśa iti
ūrddhvañca viṣuvataḥ ye trayo'bhiplavāḥ teṣu ca bhargo yaśo bharga iti
teṣāmapyūrddvaṃ ye'bhiplavāḥ uttarasmin pakṣasi teṣu yaśo bharga ityevaṃ vyatyāsaḥ syāt

src: sakṛd dvir vā yaśaḥ purastāt tathopariṣṭād bharga itareṣv ity aparam
tgt: aparamanyadvidhānaṃ sakṛddvirvā yaśaḥ purastādbhavet tathopariṣṭādviṣuvataḥ triṣvabhiplaveṣu sakṛddvirvā yaśo bhavet bharga itareṣu abhiplaveṣu syāt

src: bhargaḥ pūrvasmin pakṣasi yaśa uttarasminn ity aparam
tgt: aparam anyattṛtīyaṃ vidhānaṃ bhargaḥ pūrvasmin pakṣami syāt yaśa uttarasminniti abhiplaveṣviti prakṛtam
abhiplavika evaṃ caturthe'hani paṭhati vīṅkaśuddhāśuddhīyañceti tayorapyeta eva vikalpāḥ syuḥ ye bhargayaśasaḥ

src: viṣuvata ūrdhvam vīṅkam eva syād iti dhānañjapyaḥ
tgt: viṣuvata ūrddhvaṃ ye'bhiplavāsteṣu vīṅkameva syāt na śuddhāśuddhīyam ityevaṃ dhānañjapya ācāryo manyate evaśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ

src: pañcame yad ahargrāme geyaṃ saṃtatiḥ syān mānavāt pūrvaṃ cāmraṃ syāt
tgt: pañcame'bhiplave yasminnahani grāme geyaṃ santatiḥ syāt tasminmānavāt pūrvañcāmraṃ syāt bṛhatyām ajāmyarthena uktamarṣāsoma dyumattama iti gāyatrañca ya evañcāpatyaṃ santatiḥ śākvaravarṇantānyuttareṣviti

evaṃ maśakaḥ paṭhati ābhilavike ṣaṣṭhe'hani indrāyendo marutvata iti gāyatrañcāśvasūktañca sakṛdiṣovṛdhīyaṃ kuryyāt mṛjyamānaḥ suhatyetyaiḍañcaukṣorandhaṃ trinidhanañcāyyāsya sakṛt samantaṃ kuryyāt sakṛt sakṛdityuktena vai spaṣṭaṃ katarasminnabhiplava iti so'yamācāryyaḥ spaṣṭīkaroti pṛṣṭhyānantarye ṣaṣṭhe'hani iṣovṛdhīyañca samantañca iṣovṛdhīyasamante yasyābhiplavasyānantaraḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ syāttasya ṣaṣṭhe'hani kuryyāt atha ṣaṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet yadā ṣaṣṭhe viṣaye eva ete ukte ucyate āvṛttasyāpyetasmin pakṣasi niyamārtham
pūrvasmin pakṣasi ṣaṣṭhe māsi trīnabhiplavān paṭhati tatra triṣu karttavyeṣu prathamo lupyatām utānya iti saṃśayaḥ so'yamācārya āha triṣu karttavyeṣu caturtho lupyeta śākvaravarṇavāniti
ya ete pūrvasmin pakṣasi abhiplavā anukrāntāḥ eta eva sarve uttarasmin pakṣasi āvṛttā bhaveyuḥ uttamāduttamādārabhyeran natu pratimāsam
teṣāmabhiplavānām āvṛttānāṃ satām ahānyapi prātilomyena kuryuḥ ṣaṣṭhādahna ārabhya prātilomyena yāvat prathamam
pṛṣṭhyaśca svarasāmānaśca pṛṣṭhyasvarasāmānaḥ teṣāṃ pṛṭhyasvarasāmnāṃ uttarasmin pakṣasi prātilomyena ahānyupeyuḥ

src: daśarātrasamīpe triṣu caturṇām āvṛttānāṃ prathamo lupyeteti dhānañjapya uttama iṣovṛdhīyasamante syātām iti
tgt: daśarātrasya sannikarṣe ye goāyuṣaḥ pūrvāstrayo'bhiplavāḥ teṣu caturṇāmāvṛttānāṃ yaḥ prathamaḥ sa lupyeta evaṃ dhānañjapyo manyate uttame cābhiplavike uttame iṣovṛdhīyasamante syātāmiti
etadvidhānaṃ viparītaṃ śāṇḍilyāyanasya viparyayaḥ prātilomyaṃ uttamo lupyeta prathama iṣovṛdhīyasamante syātāmiti
viṣuvatsamīpe ca ye'bhiplavāstrayasteṣu caivameva śāṇḍilyāyanasya
triṣvabhiplaveṣu karttavyeṣu abhāvaḥ akriyā iṣovṛdhīyasamantayoḥ

src: bhāvas tv ācāryāṇāṃ bhāvas tv ācāryāṇām
tgt: iṣovṛdhīyasamantayoḥ bhāvaḥ ācāryyaṇaṃ matena, tuśabda akriyāpekṣānivṛtyarthaḥ

src: pṛṣṭhye ratham ativaheyuḥ paścāt prāñcaṃ dakṣiṇato vodañcaṃ bahirvedi rathantarasya stotre
tgt: abhipave ye saṃśayāste nirṇītāḥ sāmprataṃ pṛṣṭhyasya dharmmā vivakṣitāḥ tadvivakṣurāha pṛṣṭhye rathamativaheyuriti iha brāhmaṇaṃ prajāpatirvā etāṃ gāyatrīṃ yonimapaśyat sa ādīdhītāsmādyoneḥ pṛṣṭhāni sṛjā iti sa rathantaramasṛjata tadrathasya ghoṣo'nvasṛjyatetyetadādi ṣaṇṇāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ rathantarādīnāṃ ghoṣādayo dharmmā jyotiṣṭomaprakaraṇe āmnātāḥ teṣāñca samuditānāmasambhavaḥ jyotiṣṭome taiśca dharmmaiḥ pratiprayogamavaśyaṃ bhavitavyaṃ tataḥ tatpratyanuṣṭheyāḥ yāvatā anubrāhmaṇasyāntarghoṣāḥ pṛṣṭhadharmmāḥ tatpratyanuṣṭheyā iti teṣāṃ samuditānāṃ prayogaviṣayo'yaṃ vidhistamāha pṛṣṭhye rathamativaheyuriti atrocyate, tat kimidaṃ pṛṣṭyagrahaṇaṃ yāvatā abhiplavasyānantaraḥ pṛṣṭhya eva ābhiplavikastu vidhiruktaḥ taccheṣo vidhirucyamānaḥ ānantaryādatra pṛṣṭhyo bhavatyeva vairūpādīnāñcāsambhavādabhiplava iti ucyate pṛṣṭhyagrahaṇaṃ kriyate viśeṣavidhyarthaṃ pṛṣṭhyānāṃ samastānāṃ dharmmārthaṃ pṛṣṭhānyasmin santīti pṛṣṭhyaḥ etaddarśayati yatra yatra samuditāni pṛṣṭhāni bhaveyuḥ tatra tatra dharmā bhaveyuriti yathā viśvajiti viśvajicchilpe'ptoryāmīti pṛṣṭhya ityadhikaraṇe saptamī ādhāro'dhikaraṇaṃ ādhriyate rathaghoṣādayo dharmmā rathamativaheyuḥ śīghraṃ vaheyuḥ paścātprāñcandevayajanasya paścāt prāṅmukhaṃ vaheyuḥ dakṣiṇato vā udañcam ativaheyuḥ bahirvedi vederbahiḥ rathantarasya stotre rathantarasya sāmnaḥ stotre stūyamāne āstotrāntāt
bṛhataḥ stotre stūyamāne dundubhimāhanyuḥ stanayitnuśabdo'nukarṣaṇārthaḥ nahi śakyaṃ stanayitnuśabdaṃ balādupapādayitum ato dundubhiṃ vādayeyuḥ bahirvedīti prakṛtam
vyajanena itaretaram upavājayamānāḥ santaḥ vairupeṇa sāmnā stuvīran anyairvopavājyamānāḥ itaretaramekena vyajanena

src: vācayitvā yajamānaṃ stutam asīty anena vāta āvātv iti tṛcenānumantrayet
tgt: katamasyānumantraṇaṃ vyajanasya yo ghoṣavāhaḥ

src: vairājasya stotra upākṛta uparyanūrusakalaṃ nidhāya tṛṇe ca tasyopari tiraścīm araṇiṃ nidhāyābhyāt saṃprajananaṃ kṛtvā triḥ pradakṣiṇam abhimanthed gāyatraṃ chando 'nuprajāyasva traiṣṭubhaṃ jāgatam ānuṣṭubhaṃ vairājam iti gautamaḥ
tgt: vairājasya sāmnaḥ stotre upākṛte purastājjapaṃ japitvā urorupariṣṭāt sakalam ānulomyena nidhāya prasthāpayitvā tṛṇe ca tasya sakalasyopari tiraścīmaraṇiṃ sthāpayitvā abhimukhamātmanaḥ agneḥ prajananaṃ kṛtvā yena pradeśenāgniḥ avatāryyate taduttarāraṇyā triḥ pradakṣiṇamabhimanthet gāyatraṃ chando'nuprajāyasvetyetadādinā mantreṇa evaṃ gautama ācārya āha
caturbhiśchandobhiriti dhānañjapya ācāryo manyate gāyatraṃ chando'nuprajāyasva traiṣṭubhaṃ jāgatamānuṣṭubhamiti
tribhiśchandobhiriti śāṇḍilya ācārya āha, gāyatraṃ chando'nuprajāyasva traiṣṭubhaṃ jāgatamiti kriyāyāḥ sarvatrānuvacanam

src: araṇyoḥ saṃdhānam ālabhyopajighret tejo 'si tejo mayi dhehīti
tgt: araṇyoḥ sandhānamālabhya spṛṣṭvā upajighrettejo'si tejo mayi dhehītyanena mantreṇa, ghrā gandhopādāne
mathyamāne'gnau yathāvidhānaṃ stomayojanaṃ kuryyāt
jāte'gnau stuvīran agnighoṣe

src: vācayitvā yajamānaṃ punar ūrjā nivartasva punar agna iṣāyuṣā punar naḥ pāhy aṃhasaḥ saha rathyā nivartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā viśvapsyā viśvatas parīty anumatryābhijuhuyāt tad uktaṃ brāhmaṇena
tgt: vācāyitvā yajamānaṃ stutasya stutamasīti punarūrjā nivarttasvetyetadādinā yathāsūtritena mantreṇa agnimanumantrya prāharatyāhavanīye ājyenābhijuhuyāt taduktaṃ brāhmaṇena preddho agne dīdihi puro na iti virājābhijuhotīti
uttarāmāhutiṃ svāhākāreṇa juhuyāt āgatyopariṣṭājjapaḥ
apa iti karmaṇi dvitīyā saha avakābhiḥ sāvakāḥ avakāḥ saivālāḥ

src: yo yaḥ sāmāṅgaṃ brūyāt sa udaghoṣaṃ janayet
tgt: yo yaḥ svabhaktiṃ brūyāt sa udaghoṣaṃ kuryyāt nidhane tu sarve

src: vācayitvā yajamānaṃ tā ninayed āstāve 'nādhṛṣṭāsi tāntvā somo rājāvanuyāma potā upatiṣṭhanta āpīye śākvarā ṛṣabhā ye svarājas te arṣantu te varṣantu te kṛṇvantv iṣam ūrjaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ tad videyeti
tgt: vācayitvā yajamānaṃ āpaḥ avakāmiśrā ninayet nikṣipet āstāve anādhṛṣṭāsītyetadādinā yajuṣā yathāsūtritena āstāvaścātvāladeśe prasiddhaḥ
samanyāyantīti etayarcā vā ninayet
samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomītyetadādinā yajuṣā vā ninayet
sarvairvvā ninayanamantraiḥ anādhṛṣṭāsītyetadādibhiḥ ninayet
sarvairvā aṣṭhīvatoraṅgapradeśayoḥ sthāpayeyuḥ aṣṭhīvatoriti jānubhyāmupari
chadiṣi chādanasyopari varṣakāmaḥ nidadhyāt evaṃ śāṇḍilya ācārya prāha
avakā nidadhyāt
yaśaskāmaḥ sabhāyāmavakā nidadhyāt
abhicaran abhicāraṃ kurvan śmaśāne avakā nidadhyāt śmaṃ śarīraṃ tadyasmin śete tat śmaśānam

src: vāravantīyasya stotre dhenuḥ saṃvāśayeyur dakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvottarato vatsān
tgt: uktaṃ sa revatīrasṛjata tadgavāṃ ghoṣo'nvasṛjyateti tāśca revatyaḥ pavamāne prayujyante rathantarādīnāṃ pañcānāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ pṛṣṭhasthāneṣu prayujyamānānāṃ sannidhau rathavyativarttanādayo dharmmāḥ prayuktāḥ tatsannidhitvāt dharmmāṇāṃ kiṃ sannidhau revatīnāṃ pavamāna eva kriyate dharmāḥ atha pṛṣṭhasthāne ityatrāha, vāravantīyasya stotre dhanūḥ saṃvāśayeyuriti apāṃ vā eṣa raso yadrevatyo revatīnāṃ raso yadvāravantīyamiti revatīnāṃ vāravantīyaṃ rasaḥ sāramiti tadvāravantīyamiti sannidhau prayujyamānā revatyaḥ prāpnuvanti vāravantīyasya sāmnaḥ stotre dhenuḥ saṃvāsayeyuḥ kathaṃ saṃvāsayeyuḥ devayajanasya dakṣiṇe pradeśe kṛtvā gā uttarato vatsān kṛtvā

src: pūrveṇa sadaḥ saṃsṛjya paścimenāgnīdhrīyam udīcīr atyajeyuḥ
tgt: samāpte stotre sadasaḥ pūrve pradeśe miśrayitvā vatsaiḥ samādhāya āgnīdhrīyasya paścime pradeśe udīcīndiśaṃ prati prasthāpayeyuḥ niṣkālayeyuḥ idamudgātṛkarma tatsaṃyogāt rathapravarttanādidhenvantāḥ pṛṣṭhadharmāḥ sarvatra bhaveyuḥ teṣāmupadiṣṭatvāt yasya yena karmaṇā saṃyogaḥ sataddravyaṃ labhate pratistotramudgātre etat dadyāt

src: vācayitvā yajamānaṃ gonāmabhir anumantrayeta havye kāmye candre jyota iḍe rante juṣṭe sūnari mayi vīrāyaḥ ayantām iḍa ehyadita ehi juṣṭe juṣṭiṃ te gameyam upahūtā upahavaṃ vośīyeti
tgt: vācayitvā yajamānamudgātā gāḥ gonāmabhiranumantrayeta havye kāmye ityetadādibhiryathāsūtritaiḥ atrocyate gonāmabhiriti kimarthaṃ yadā sarvāṇi nirdiṣṭānyeva, ucyate gonāmagrahaṇaṃ saṃvyavahārārtham anyatrāpi yatra gonāmānīti brūyāt tatraitānyeva prāptavyāni yathā dakṣiṇe'syāḥ karṇe gonāmāni japitveti yāni ca prakaraṇāmnātānyeva tāni ca
saharṣabhā ityetayarcā vā upamantrayet
saharṣabhā havye kāmye ityetadādinā mantreṇa vānumantrayet

src: adbhiś ced upākuryus tā ninayed āstāve āpohiṣṭhīyābhiḥ
tgt: yadyadbhirupākaraṇaṃ kuryuradhvaryavaḥ tā āpaḥ ninayedāstāve āpohiṣṭhoyābhiḥ ṛgbhiḥ adbhirupākaraṇasya kaḥ sambandhaḥ āpovai revatya iti

src: ṣaṣṭhe 'hani saṃsthite 'bahuvādinaḥ syur na cādhīyīrann ottarasyāhna upākaraṇāt
tgt: brāhmaṇe ca ūhuṣī vā etarhi vāgyadā ṣaḍahaḥ santiṣṭhate na bahu vadennānyaṃ pṛchennānyasmai prabrūyāt madhu vāśaye ghṛtaṃ vā yathohuṣovahaṃ pratyanakti tathā taditi ete saṃsthādharmmaḥ śrūyante ata āha ṣaṣṭhe'hani saṃsthite'bahuvādinaḥ syuriti ṣaṣṭhe'hani samāpte'bahuvādinaḥ syuḥ na cādhīyīran ā uttarasyāhna upākaraṇāt upākaraṇaṃ nāma prārambhaḥ etaddarśayati anyeṣvahaḥsamāptiṣvadhyayanaṃ kurvīteti atha ṣaṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti ucyate niyamārthameva yadā ṣaḍahaḥ santiṣṭhata iti tadā vṛttasya prathame'hani saṃsthānaṃ tatra saṃsthādharmmāḥ prāpnuvanti so'yamācāryyaḥ ṣaṣṭhagrahaṇaṃ karoti kathaṃ āvṛtte'pyetasmin syuriti etadāvṛtterūpaṃ ya iha upakramadharmmāste āvṛtteḥ saṃsthādharmāḥ ye tatra saṃsthādharmāste iha upakramadharmā iti
sarpiṣā madhvā ca yajamānaḥ ṛtvijo bhojayedahīneṣu sarpiriti ghṛtasya paryāyaḥ
sarpiṣā madhvā vā ekena bhojayet

sarpiṣaiva tṛtīyasavane bhojanaṃ satriṇām evaśabdo madhu nivarttayati atha tṛtīyasavanagrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti cet ucyate ṣaṣṭhe'hani saṃsthite etenoktaṃ tat satreṣu yadeva tārttīyasavanīkambhojanamupadiṣṭam tadeva sarpiṣā syāt tat saṃsthite'hani bhojanamastu satriṇāṃ na anusavanantu satreṣviti tadyathākāmyādeveti

src: etasyānyatarasmiṃs tryahet grāhyāṇāṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ srutvā pṛṣṭhena
tgt: etasya pṛṣṭhyasya ṣaḍahasya anyatarasmiṃstryahe atigrāhyāṇāṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ atigrāhyā grahāḥ atiriktāḥ prakṛtebhyo gṛhyante ityatigrāhyā yasmiṃstryahe gṛhyeran tasmiṃsteṣāṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ, kasmin kāle stutvā pṛṣṭhena
viṣuvadgagatayoñca atigrāhyāṇāṃ bhakṣayeyuḥ
triṣṭupchandasā mantreṇa bhakṣayeyuḥ
pūrvaṃ sarvacamasebhyo bhakṣyeyuḥ
anyatra ca anyayajñeṣu ca etasmin kāle yān grahān bhakṣānāhareyusteṣāṃ triṣṭupacchandasā pūrvaṃ camasebhyo bhakṣayeyuḥ
ete pṛṣṭhyasya dharmā gavāmayanaprakaraṇa āmnātāḥ ete yatra yatra pṛṣṭhāḥ prayujyante tatra tatra syurna kevalaṃ gavāmayane
daśamañcāhavratañca yatra yatra kriyetāṃ tatra tatra sahadharmaiḥ

src: āmīvartastotrīyān ābhiplavikān pṛṣṭhye saṃśayed brāhmaṇācchaṃsinā kāleyarco 'cchāvākena sarvatra yadā pavamāne syātām
tgt: ye ābhīvarttastotrīyāḥ ābhiplavikāḥ tān sarvatra pṛṣṭhye saṃśayet brāhmaṇācchaṃsinā yadābhīvarttapavamāne syāt kāleyasyarcaḥ acchāvākena saṃśayet yadā tat pavamāne syāt na kevalaṃ pṛṣṭhye kāleyasya anyatrāpi yadā kāleyaṃ pavamāne syāt tatrā'pyetasya stotrīyaṃ śaṃsayedacchāvākena yathā viśvajitīti
ūrddhvaṃ viṣuvataḥ yānyahāni teṣu sarveṣvindrakratuṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsinaḥ śaṃsayet prāgatirātrāt udayanīyam atirātraṃ varjayitvā sarvaśabdo niravaśeṣavācī

uktaṃ yatra yatra samuditāni pṛṣṭhāni prayujyeran tatra tatra eṣāṃ rathavyativarjamānādayo dharmāḥ syuriti tadiha sarvapṛṣṭhaviśvajit tasmin viśvajiti rathantarādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ pṛṣṭhyādīnāṃ vairāje'dhikaraṇe dharmān kuryyāt etaddhi dharmāṇāṃ sthānaṃ hotāpi sarveṣāṃ tasminneva yonīḥ saṃśati
itareṣvapi pṛṣṭheṣu dharmān kuryyāt eṣā ācāryyāṇāṃ matiḥ sannikṛṣṭanyāyatvāddharmāṇam itareṣu triṣu pṛṣṭheṣu mahānāmnīvairūparevatīṣu svadharmāḥ syuḥ bṛhadrathantaravairājānāṃ vairājā dharmāḥ syuriti

src: maukṣasomasāmanī gāyatrasyottarayor agner arkas tisṛṣv iti vā
tgt: athavā gāyatramekarce kṛtvā tasyottarayormaukṣasomasāmanī kṛtvā tasminneva tṛce agnerarkastisṛṣu kurvyāt araṇye geyamidamapavitramiti

sākamaśvasya iḍānāṃ saṃkṣārasya ca aṣṭamanavamayorahnorvyatihārameke ācāryyāḥ kurvanti āṣṭamikī iḍā vibhaktirnavame'hani kṛtvā aṣṭama eva kalpayati iḍā saṃkṣāro'ṣṭamasya vibhaktirnavame'hani kriyata iti vyatihāro nāma anyo'nyasthānopādānaṃ iḍānāṃ saṃkṣārau sākamaśvasya sthāne kurvanti sākamaśvamiḍānāṃ saṃkṣārasyeti

aṣṭame'hani surūpaṃ gāyatryatṛcasthamāmnātaṃ krauñcaṃ cānuṣṭubhi uṣṇikkakubhāvekarcau kṛtau tadeke ācāryyā liṅgaṃ dṛṣṭvā vikalpayanti prāṇāśiśurmahīnāmiti prāṇavatyo bhavantīti asya ca bahuvacanasya uṣṇikkakubhorekarci kriyānarthakyaṃ tadeke uṣṇikkakubhau tṛcayoḥ kurvanti uṣṇikkakubhostṛcaikarcatvamanyathā teneti surūpakrauñce ekarcayoḥ

navame'hani bahiṣpavamāne evaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ paṭhati savā uttamaḥ ṣaḍṛco bhavatītyuktvāha tṛca uttamo bhavatīti na ca tasyānantarastṛco'sti ṣaḍṛcaḥ tasyānantaraḥ nacāvacchedaṃ kṛtvā kalpanā yuktā ṛte vacanāt so'yamācāryyaḥ prākṛtaṃ paryyāsaṃ vidhitsurāha navamasya jyotiṣṭomaḥ paryāsa iti anādeśe prakṛtipratyayāt
eke ācāryāḥ sāptamikaḥ paryyāsaḥ syādityevamāhuḥ kasmāt saprabhṛtitvāt uktaṃ saprabhṛtayo bhavantīti tāḥ śvasanādayaḥ

src: tasya bṛhatyām araṇye geyāni tṛceṣu pṛṣṭhyaṃ ca
tgt: tasya grahaṇaṃ yadi jyotiṣṭomaḥ paryyāsaḥ yadi sāptamikaḥ tasya bṛhatyāmekādaśasāmāni paṭhitāni teṣāṃ tṛcaikarcatvaklṛptiḥ kalpayati yānyaranye geyāni tāni tṛceṣu syuḥ pṛṣṭhyañca anyānyekarceṣu

tat kimidamārabhyate anuprāptameva vāsiṣṭhamadhyāsyāyām ācāryyairapi prakaraṇe'dhyāsyāyāmeva gītam ucyate niyamārthamārabhyate vakṣyate saptaiva tṛceṣu yairajāmītyaparamiti na tat kalpe vāsiṣṭhaṃ syāt adhyāsyāviṣayameva vāsiṣṭhamiti
pāṭhakramaṃ vikalpayati ajāmyarthena vaiyaśvaṃ prāgabhargādbhavet abhīśavaṃ yaśasaḥ prāgiti varttate
aparaḥ kalpaḥ bṛhatyāṃ saptaiva tṛceṣa syuḥ yaiḥ kriyamāṇairjāmi na bhavati etadaparaṃ ācāryamataṃ prathamaḥ kalpo yathāmnātānāṃ kriyāśeṣe vikalpaḥ
ante dīrghatamaso'rkaḥ sāmarājañca tayośca dvayorekasmin sambhavo nāsti tasmād vikalpaḥ syāt ekārthatvāt

yadā tāvat dīrghatamaso'rko'ntyaḥ syāt tadā sāmarājasyābhāva eva yadā punaḥ sāmarājamantyaṃ syāt tadā pṛṣṭhasyottarayoḥ stotrīyayoḥ dīrghatamaso'rkaḥ syāt māṇḍavaṃ caiḍaṃ dīrghatamaso'rkaḥ arko'nugrahārthaḥ māṇḍavaṃ stomapūrṇārtham

src: anurūpeṣu tṛcā pratilomā ṛcā navarca iti gautamaḥ
tgt: uktaṃ pañcānāmahnāmanurūpaiḥ pratyavayanti yathābhyāruhya pratyavarohettathā taditi tatpratyavarohaṇaṃ kiṃ ṛkprātilomyena athavā tṛcaḥ prātilomyeneti ucyate anurūpeṣu tṛcā pratilomā ṛcā navarce ṣāṣṭikādanurūpādārabhya prātilomyena tāvadyāvaddvitīyaka iti taiḥ pratyavarohaḥ na ṛcāmapi asṛkṣata pravrājinaḥ pavamānasya viśvavitpavamāno ajījattadete asṛgramindavaḥ pavasvendovṛṣāsuta ityeṣa karmakramaḥ tata ṛcaḥ pratilomāḥ syuḥ upāsmai gāyatānara ityata ārabhya yāvadasya pratnāmanudyutamiti evaṃ pratyavarohaṇaṃ gautama ācāryo manyate
sarvatra sarvasmin bahiṣpavamāne tṛcā prātilomyena dhānañjapya ācāryo manyate anurūpāṇāṃ yathoktaṃ navarce tu upaśikṣāya tasthuṣa eṣa pratnena janmanāsya pratnāmanudyutamityevantṛcaḥ prātilomyam
anurūpāṇāṃ yathoktameva prātilomyaṃ navarce tu yathādhītameveti evaṃ śāṇḍilyāyana ācāryo manyate

sarvatrānurūpeṣu navarceṣyṛcaḥ pratilomāḥ syurityevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācāryyo manyate, dvitīyakādanurūpādārabhya yāvat ṣāṣṭika iti ete ṛkpratilomāḥ syuḥ anyathā hi yadi ṣāṣṭikādārabhyeran evamubhayaprātilomyaṃ syāt ṛkprātilomyantṛcaprātilomyañca navarce tu sarvamṛkpratilomameva syāt upāsmai gāyatā nara ityata ārabhya yāvadasya pratneti

apratibhāṃ na pratibhām anavasthānamityarthaḥ yadetasminnahani pratibhāyāḥ stotrāṅgaṃ kiñcittadanuṣṭummātrāṃ kṛtvācakṣīran uktaṃ yāvatyanuṣṭuptāvatīṃ vācaṃ sampādya vibrūyuriti atha mātrāgrahaṇaṃ kimarthamiti ucyate ṛknyāyannādriyeran dvātriṃśanmātrāṃ kṛtvācakṣīran

src: jyāyasi chandasi lumpeyur akṣarāṇi kanīyasy abhyasyeyuḥ
tgt: jyāyastvaṃ nāma vṛddhiḥ kanīyastvaṃ hrāsaḥ jyāyasi indasyākhyātavye anuṣṭummātrāṃ kṛtvā adhikānyakṣarāṇi lumpeyuḥ kanīyasī abhyasyeyuḥ ke yeṣāmudgātṛṛṇāmidaṃ karmma upadiṣṭam

src: huteṣu patnīsaṃyājeṣu gārhapatya udgātā juhuyād upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dharuṇo dhayan rāyaṣpoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat svāheti pūrvam
tgt: agniṣṭomasāmnā stutvā prāk patnīsaṃyājebhyaḥ yadebhirudgātṛbhiḥ prastute some prasavādārabhya sarvairdūraṅgataṃ syāt tadgatvā pratyāvrajya manasānutsāhe yadyutsāho na syāt gamanāgamane manasā gamanāgamane kṛtvā huteṣu patnīsaṃyājeṣu gārhapatya udgātā juhuyāt upasṛjandharuṇaṃ mātra etadādinā yathāsūtritena mantreṇa udgātṛgrahaṇaṃ na sarve eva
uttarāmājatiṃ svāhākāreṇa juhuyāt

src: āhavanīyaṃ gatvā paścāt tiṣṭhanto 'yaṃ sahohā iti trir udgātā gāyeta nidhanam itarāv anūpeyātām
tgt: gārhapatye udgātā hutvā adhvaryuṇā sampreṣite āhavanīye gatvā tasya paścime pradeśe tiṣṭhanto yadvakṣyate tat kuryuḥ kiṃ punastat ayaṃ sahohā ityetatsāma trirudgātā gāyet nidhanamitarau prastotṛpratihattarau udgātāramupayantaṃ anupeyātāṃ gānagrahaṇaṃ uktamatichandasāhavanīyamupatiṣṭhanta iti ṛcā mābhūditi

src: yajamānasaṃcareṇa gatvā pūrvayā dvārā sadaḥ praviśeyuḥ
tgt: yajamānasya yaḥ sañcarastena gatvā nodgātṛsañcareṇa pūrvayā dvārā sadaḥ praviśeyuḥ

src: yadā adhvaryur upākuryād atha mānasena stuvīran nāyaṃ gāḥ pṛśnir akramīd iti gāyatreṇa pṛthak stotrīyābhyo hiṃkāraṃ trikena stomenāstomayogā yajamānavācanena
tgt: yasmin kāle adhvaryurupākaraṇaṃ karoti athānantaraṃ mānasena stotrena stuvīran manasā kriyata iti mānasam uktaṃ manasopāvarttayatyetadādi ayaṅgauḥ pṛśnirakramīdityetasmiṃstṛce gāyatreṇa sāmnā uktaṃ sārparājñā ṛgbhiḥ stuvantīti etā sārparājñyaḥ pṛthak stotrīyābhyo hiṅkāraṃ pṛthak nānetyarthaḥ stotrīyābhyo hiṃkāraṃ kuryuḥ trikeṇa stomena uktaṃ parācībhiḥ stuvantīti evaṃ parāktvam astomayogā yajamānavācanena nātra stomayojanaṃ syāt na ca yajamānavācanam
pratihāradeśakāle pratiharttā apānyāt uktaṃ tasmāddvayaṃ prāṇena karoti prāṇiti cāpāniti ca tadapānasaṃjñakavāyurantaḥ praveśayet
uttamāṃ stotrīyāṃ prastutyaiṣetyanena hotāramīkṣet

src: yam adhvaryur bhakṣaṃ prayacchan manyeta tasya manasopahūya kas tvā kaṃ bhakṣayāmīti bhakṣayeyuḥ
tgt: yamadhvaryurbhakṣaṃ prayacchanmanyeta yadi grahaṃ yadi camasaṃ tasya manasopahūya kastvā kaṃ bhakṣayāmīti bhakṣayeyuḥ manasaiva uktaṃ grahaṃ vā gṛhītvā camasaṃ vonnīya stotramupāvarttayatīti na bhakṣaṃ stotreṇa sambadhyate'taḥ punarmanasetyāha

src: brahmodyaṃ vadantīti gāyatrīṃ nirbrūyur iti dhānañjapyaḥ
tgt: uktaṃ brahmodyaṃ vadanti brahmavarcasa eva pratitiṣṭhantīti kiṃ punarbrahmodyamiti ucyate gāyatrīṃ trirbrūyuriti dhānañjapya iti gāyatryāstrirvacanaṃ brahmodyaṃ sā ca gāyatrī paribhāṣitā taṃ sa āpyāyayedabhimṛśyāpyāyasvetyuktvāha sarve vaitayā gāyatryeti
caturhotāraṃ brahmodyamabhipretya etadbrāhmaṇam iti gautama ācāryo manyate
svāhākṛtibhiśca ṛte pūrveṇa sada upaviśya brahmodyaṃ vadeyuriti etadbrahmodyamihāpi syāditi śāṇḍilya āha

src: etasyāṃ velāyāṃ varān vṛṇīran manasā yān iccheyuḥ
tgt: etasyāṃ velāyāṃ varān vṛṇīranmanasā yo yasyepsitaḥ sa taṃ varaṃ vṛṇīte

src: uttarata udgātaudumbarīṃ gṛhṇīyāt paścāt pratihartā dakṣiṇato brahmā purastād itare sarve
tgt: uttare pradeśe'vasthita udgātā audumbarīṃ gṛhṇīyāt anvārabhet paścātpratiharttā paścime pradeśe cāvasthitaḥ pratiharttā anvārabhet dakṣiṇato brahmā anvārabhet pūrvapradeśe'vasthitā itare sarve anvārabheran

src: atha japeyur iha dhṛtir iha svadhṛtir iha rantir iha ramadhvaṃ mayi dhṛtir mayi svadhṛtir mayi ramo mayi ramadhvam iti vā
tgt: athaśabda ānantarye anvārabhyāthānantaraṃ japeyuḥ iha dhṛtirityetadādi yathāsūtritaṃ mantraṃ mayi dhṛtirityetadādi vā
ubhau vā mantrau japeyuḥ

src: vāgyatā apidhāya dvāre āsīrann ā nakṣatrapravacanāt
tgt: evaṃ japitvānantaraṃ vāgyatā vācaṃ yamayitvā apidhāya dvāre āsīran ākutaḥ kālāt ā nakṣatrapravacanāt yāvannakṣatraṃ proktamiti uktaṃ vācaṃ yacchanti dugdhānīva vai tarhi chandāṃsi yātayāmānyantagatāni tānyeva tadrasenāpyāyayantyatho'śvastanāmevābhisantanvantīti

src: prokte nakṣatre pūrvayā dvārā niṣkramya subrahmaṇyāpraṇavair vācaṃ visṛjerann iti dhānañjapyaḥ
tgt: uktam āsīran ānakṣatrapravacanāditi tato'nyena prokte nakṣatre pūrvayā dvārā sadaso niṣkramya subrahmaṇyāpraṇavaiḥ subrahmaṇyomityebhiḥ vāgvisargaṃ kuryuriti dhānañjapyaḥ ācāryo manyate
vasatīvarīpariharaṇasyānte subrahmaṇyenāhūyamānāyāḥ subrahmaṇyāyāḥ praṇavān śrutvā vācaṃ visṛjeyurityevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācāryo manyate na svayaṃ praṇavaṃ brūyuriti

varavaraṇañca vāgyamanañca te varavaraṇavāgyamane yajamāna eva kuryādahīneṣu evaśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ sarvakarttṛkamidaṃ karmopariṣṭaṃ tad yajamānaḥ kuryādahīneṣu iti sarvartvijo na kuryuḥ nanu yadā dvāvevāhīnau tāṇḍake yayordaśamamahaḥ tayośca ahīnadvādaśāhachandomavāṃśca daśarātraḥ tat kimidaṃ bahuvacanaṃ ahīneṣviti ucyate śākhāntarābhiprāyeṇa athavā pauṇḍarike catuṣṭome ca vicāritaṃ kathaṃ daśamadharmā mānasamityakarttavyā ityeke tatsvena nāmadheyenaikāha ādiśyate catuṣṭomo'gniṣṭome ityathāpi na dāśamikaṃ liṅgaṃ dṛśyate yathaitad bahiṣpavamānasyāvṛttisāmnāṃ vipracyāvanamanuṣṭubhaṃ parokṣīcikīrṣediti śāṇḍilyaḥ karttavyā ityācāryā ye'nye mānasasaṃyuktebhyaḥ saṃsthāpanīyaṃ mānasaṃ catuṣṭome'gniṣṭoma iti so'yamācārya anenaiva bahuvacanena evaṃ vidhimādarśayatīti
varavaraṇavāgyamane yajamāna eva kuryādahīneṣu itare ṛtvijaḥ varavaraṇavāgyamanābhyāṃ yadanyatkarmoktaṃ tat kṛtvā yathārthaṃ syuḥ iti karmaṇaḥ samāptiṃ darśayati

src: mahāvratasya pṛṣṭhya upākṛte yuktvā stomaṃ parimādo gāyed iti bhāṇḍitāyanaḥ
tgt: iha mahāvrataprakaraṇe trayodaśaparimādaḥ paṭhitā brāhmaṇena purastādāhavanīyamupatiṣṭhanta ityata ārabhya yāvadgārhapatyopasthānamiti tadanantaraṃ paṭhati āsandīmāruhyādgāyatīti parimādagānānantaraṃ mahāvratasya stavanaṃ darśayati teṣāṃ parimādāṃ kriyāvidhiṃ vivakṣuridaṃ sūtramārabhate mahāvratasya pṛṣṭhe upākṛte yuktvā stomaṃ parimādo gāyediti mahāvrata iti karmaṇo nāmadheyaṃ tasyeti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī pṛṣṭhamiti stotrasaṃjñā tasmin pṛṣṭhe upākṛte upākaraṇaṃ nāmādhvaryavaṃ karma upāvarttadhvamiti yuktvā stomaṃ stomayojanaṃ kṛtvā yathoktena mantreṇa parimāda iti saṃjñā parimādbhiścaranti tvak ca vā etalloma ca mahāvratasya yatparimāda iti gāyediti kriyopadeśaḥ bhāṇḍitāyana ityācāryamatasaṃkīrttanaṃ eṣa sūtrārthaḥ mahāvratasya kratoḥ hotṛpṛṣṭhe upākṛte stomayojanaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ parimādagānamiti ucyate, daśamamahaḥ niravaśeṣamuktaṃ tasmādanantaraṃ mahāvratasāmnā taṃ dvādaśāhasya dvādaśāhāni mahāvratañceti tadevamānantaryādeva prāpte mahāvratake vidhau parimādasambandhācca yāvatā mahāvratādanyatra parimādo na bhavanti tat kimidaṃ mahāvratagrahaṇaṃ mahāvratasya pṛṣṭhe iti ucyate niyamārthaṃ mahāvratagrahaṇaṃ mahāvratasyaiva prāptāvetasmin pṛṣṭha upākṛte nānyatra pṛṣṭhamātre yathā vakṣyati mahendrasya mahāvratapṛṣṭha iti

src: pratigṛhya tṛṇe ayuktveti gautamaśāṇḍilyā dhānañjapyaś ca
tgt: pratigṛhya tṛṇe upākaraṇike ayuktvā stomaṃ parimādo gāyedityevaṃ gautamaśāṇḍilyāvācāryāvāhatuḥ dhānañjapyaśca
eke ācāryyā manyante prāgeva stotropākaraṇāt parimādo gāyediti

src: dakṣiṇenāgnīdhrīyaṃ gatvottareṇāgniṃ prāṇaprabhṛtibhir upatiṣṭheraṃs tad uktaṃ brāhmaṇena
tgt: āgnīdhrīyasya dakṣiṇena gatvā iṣṭakācitasyāgneḥ uttareṇa gatvā prāṇaprabhṛtibhi ṛṣyasya sāmāntaiḥ āhavanīyādigārhapatyāntāni brāhmaṇoktāni upatiṣṭheran taduktamupasthānavidhānaṃ brāhmaṇena prāṇena purastādāhavanīmupatiṣṭhanta ityetadādi
sarvāpyetāni prāṇaprabhṛtīni sakṛtsakṛdudgātā gāyet atha kiṃ sakṛtsakṛditi ucyate, uktaṃ ayaṃ sahohā iti trirudgātā gāyediti taddarśanamapi gamyate ata āha sakṛtsakṛditi

itarau praṣṭī udgātrā saha nidhanamupeyātāṃ prāṇena purastādāhavanīyamupatiṣṭhantiti sarveṣāmupasthānamuktantatsūtrakāra udgātuḥ prāṇadīni vidhāya itarayornidhanamupetya bahuvacanasyārthavatvaṃ darśayati
madhye nidhaneṣvapi sāmasu itarāvanūpeyātānnidhanāni

yānyādyantasrubdhāni sāmāni teṣvanupadaṃ stobhaṃ kuryāt tat kimidaṃ siddhe sati punarārabhyate ucyate, eteṣāṃ satrasyarddhyādyantasrubdhaṃ padyate ayañcānupasaṃhāra āvikeṣu pādeṣu vihitaḥ tatra ca daivatāni tiṣṭhanti teṣvapi padāya padāya stobhedityata ārabhyate
yenaiva gatāstenaiva pratyāvrajya pucchamupatiṣṭheran yathoktenaiva sāmnā prāṅmukhāḥ
uktaṃ vratapakṣābhyāṃ pakṣāvupatiṣṭhanta iti tayorvratapakṣayoḥ pūrveṇa dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣamupatiṣṭheran arthādāpannamuttareṇottaramiti
uktaṃ prajāpaterhṛdayenāpi kakṣe upatiṣṭhanta iti tatra dvāvapi kakṣau katarasyopasthānamiti atrāha, uttaramapi kakṣamupatiṣṭheranniti
brāhmaṇaṃ vasiṣṭhasya nihavena cātvālamupatiṣṭhate vaiśvadevyāmṛci bhavatīti so'yamāha, viśvedevā ityetasyāmṛci vasiṣṭhasya nihavamūhediti asya hi anyatrotpattiḥ ata ūhedityuktam
cātvālamupasthāyāgnīdhrīyasyottareṇa pradeśena gatvā paścime pradeśe tiṣṭhantaḥ tasyopasthānaṃ kuryuḥ uktaṃ satrasyarddhyāgnīdhramupatiṣṭhanta iti
cātvālasyopasthānaṃ kṛtvā tasminneva deśe'vasthitāḥ pratyaṅmukhāḥ āgnīdhrīyamupatiṣṭherannityevaṃ dhānañjapyaḥ ācāryo manyate
yadi paścāttiṣṭhantaḥ yadi cātvāladeśe tasya satrasyarddheḥ uttamanidhanamātamitoḥ upeyuḥ tāvadarddhayeyuryāvannāntaḥ uktam ātamitornidhanamupayantīti
brāhmaṇaṃ ślokānuślokābhyāṃ havirddhāne upatiṣṭhanta iti havirddhānayoḥ pūrve pradeśe'vasthitāḥ pratyaṅmukhāḥ ślokānuślokayoḥ sāmnoḥ pūrveṇa ślokenetyarthaḥ havirddhānayorupasthānaṃ kuryuḥ
paścime pradeśe tayoreva sthitāḥ pratyaṅmukhāḥ anuślokenopatiṣṭheran ta eva havirddhāne

src: tata evekṣamāṇā mārjālīyaṃ yat dvandveṣu nāke suparṇam iti
tgt: tatraiva deśe'vasthitāḥ īkṣamāṇā mārjālīyaṃ yāmenopatiṣṭheran uktaṃ yāmena mārjālīyamupatiṣṭhanta iti tatra sarveṣāṃ yāmānāṃ prāptau niyamayati yaddvandveṣviti yāmānāmanekatvānniyamayati yannāke suparṇamiti yāmantat syāditi

yathā havirddhāne upasthite tenaiva prakāreṇa sada upatiṣṭheran uktamāyurnavastobhābhyāṃ sada upatiṣṭhanta iti pūrve pradeśe sadasaḥ pratyaṅmukhā avasthitāḥ tamāyuṣā sāmnopatiṣṭheran paścāditareṇa paścime pradeśe prāṅmukhā avasthitāḥ navastobhena sāmnopatiṣṭheran
uktaṃ ṛṣyasya sāmnā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭanta iti antarvederantarvedi pratyaṅmukhāstiṣṭhanta gārhapatyamupatiṣṭheran yathoktenaiva sāmnā
tasyaiva gārhapatyasya paścime pradeśe'vasthitāḥ prāṅmukhā upatiṣṭherannityevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācāryo manyate

brāhmaṇaṃ yatparokṣaṃ nidhanamupeyurhrītamukhaṃ pratimuñceran yatpratyakṣamupayanti hrītamukhamevāpajayantīti indraśabdādārabhya pratyakṣaṃ nidhanaṃ brūyuḥ lokavat pratyakṣaparokṣe āmantritaṃ pratyakṣaṃ nirddiṣṭaṃ parokṣaṃ devadattaḥ saḥ devadattaḥ indreti pratyakṣam sa indra iti parokṣam
parimādaḥ gītvā athānantaraṃ rājānaṃ sannāhayet athaśabda ānantarye rājānamiti kṣattriyaṃ sannāhayet anyat uktaṃ sannaddhāḥ kavacinaḥ pariyantīti

tasya rājñaḥ dvyavarārddhyau rathau anuyāyinau syātāṃ bhaveyātāṃ paścādyāyinau sarve nikṛṣṭau dvau yadi bahavo rathā na syuḥ nanu tasya dvyavarārddhyā rathā anuyāyinaḥ syurityevaṃ sūtraṃ karttavyamāsīt tatraivamapare varṇayanti dvyavarārddhyau manuṣyau yasmin rathe so'yaṃ dvyavarārddhyo rathaḥ dvyavarārddhyaśca dvyavarārddhyaśca dvyavarārddhyau ekasminneva ekasmin rathe bahavo manuṣyā abhipretāḥ tata āha dvyavarārddhyā iti
devayajanasya pūrve pradeśe sannahyeran rājānaṃ muktvānye anuyāyinaḥ
sannaddhāḥ santaḥ dakṣiṇena devayajanaṃ parigaccheyuḥ

src: pūrveṇa patnīśālām udgātā gatvā dakṣiṇe vedyante prāñco darbhān āstīrya teṣv enaṃ prāṅmukham upaveśayet
tgt: udgātā patnīśālāyāḥ pūrveṇa pradeśena gatvā mahāvederdakṣiṇe vedyante darbhān prāgagrān āstīrya teṣu darbheṣu enaṃ rājānaṃ prāṅmukham upaveśayet

src: athāsmai varmābhihared anyaṃ vābhiharantam anumantrayeta uttiṣṭha rājan parivarmāsyaś ca yukto ratho vitato daiva ākhaṇo viśāṃ rājā brāhmaṇa edhi gopteti
tgt: athaśabda ānantarye prāgagreṣu darbheṣūpaveśya rājānam anantaramasmai varma badhnīyāt uttiṣṭha rājannityetadādinā yathāsūtritena mantreṇa anyaṃ vābhiharantam enaṃ mantraṃ brūyāt

src: paścimena pariyāhīty uktvā tenaiva pratyāvrajyottara enaṃ vedyante 'vasthāpya brūyād hastatraṃ baghnīṣvājyam āyudhaṃ kuruṣva trīn iṣūn upakalpayasvāyasmāyān yam eva kaṃca caturtham iti
tgt: rājānaṃ paścimena devayajanaṃ pariyāhītyuktvā yenaiva gatastenaiva punarāvrajya uttare vedyante enaṃ rājānam avasthāpya brūyāt hastatraṃ badhnīṣva ujjyamāyudhaṃ kuruṣva trīniṣūnupakalpayasva anugṛhṇīṣva āyasmāyān kārṣṇāyasān yameva kañca caturthamiti yaṃ kañceṣucaturthanna niyamaḥ
iṣuṃ pratidhatsveti brūyāt

src: taṃ pratidadhānam anumantrayeta vaiṇāvatāya pratidhatsva śaṅkum āpapro 'ṣṭamo teti papradbrahmaṇo guptyai vidhṛtyai dhārayātreti
tgt: taṃ rājānaṃ pratidadhānam iṣuṃ sandadhānaṃ anumantrayeta vaiṇavatāya pratidhvatsva śaṃkumityetadādinā yathāsūtritena mantreṇa
saṃhateṣu rathamāroheti brūyāt rājānam

src: dakṣiṇena rathapathaṃ kṛtvottareṇāgnīdhrīyaṃ pūrvāpare carmaṇo vibadhnīyuḥ
tgt: dakṣiṇena pradeśena rathapathaṃ kṛtvā kasya dakṣiṇena vakṣyati pūrvāpare carmaṇī vibadhnīyuriti tayoścarmaṇordakṣiṇena uttareṇāgnīdhrīyam enaprayoge dvitīyā āgnīdhrīyasya uttare pradeśe pūrvāpare carmaṇī vibadhnīyuḥ pūrvañca aparañca pūrvāpare carmaprahārāntanaṃ te carmaṇī dve vibadhnīyuḥ

src: taṃ bruyāt pradakṣiṇaṃ devayajanaṃ parīyāt pūrvaṃ carmāgamaneṣu vidhyer ekaikenottarottary anatipātayan
tgt: taṃ rājānaṃ brūyādudgātā pradakṣiṇaṃ devayajanaṃ parīyāt pūrvaṃ carma yattadāgamaneṣu vidhyeḥ āgamanāgamaneṣu ekaikeneṣuṇā vidhyeḥ uktaṃ trīniṣūnupakalpayasveti uttarottarā vedhasya vedhasyopariṣṭāduttarottarī prathamasyopariṣṭāddvitīyaḥ dvitīyasyopariṣṭāt tṛtīya iti anatipātayan bhūmāvapātayanniṣuṃ tathā vidhyedyathā tasminneva carmaṇi saṃsaktā bhavanti
aparasmai carmaṇi itare rathinaḥ yathābhipretaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kṣipeyuḥ
evaṃ brūyād rājānaṃ tṛtīyeneṣuṇā viddhvā udaṅmukhaḥ prayāyāḥ gacchet

src: tadā caturtham iṣuṃ yāṃ diśaṃ manyethās tām asyer gā dṛṣṭvāvatiṣṭhethāḥ
tgt: tadā tasmin kāle udaṅ gacchat caturthamiṣum uktaṃ yameva kañca caturthamiti yāndiśaṃ manyethāḥ icchā bhavet tāmasyeḥ etaduktaṃ bhavati udaṅgacchan caturthabāṇaṃ yāndiśaṃ prati icchā bhavati tāṃ diśaṃ kṣipet yasmin deśe gāḥ paśyeyuḥ tasminneva deśe avatiṣṭhethā avasthānaṃ kurvīran
tatra yasmindeśe avatiṣṭheran tasmin deśe tvā viśrambhayeyuḥ varmādisannahanamapanayeyuḥ

src: paścād āgnīdhrīyasyārdham antarvedi śvabhrasya khātaṃ syād ardhaṃ bahirvedi
tgt: uktaṃ bhūmidundubhirbhavatīti sa bhūmidundubhirucyate agnīdhrīyasya paścime pradeśe vederantaḥ antarvedi arddhaṃ śvabhrasya khātaṃ syāt śvabhraḥ garttaḥ arddhaṃ bahirvedi śvabhrasya khātaṃ syāditi

sa śvabhraḥ ārṣabheṇa carmaṇā ṛṣabhasya avayavamārṣabhaṃ tena ārṣabheṇa uttaralomnā upari lomāni yasya carmaṇaḥ tadidamuttaralomnā tena ārṣabhena uttaralomnā carmaṇā abhivihitaṃ syāt sarvataḥ avanaddhaḥ syāt

src: tvaṃ vāg asi ye naḥ satre anindiṣu dīkṣāyāṃ śrānta āsi te rāddhiṃ tebhyo dundubhe rāddhim asmabhyam āvadeti parāvada dviṣantaṃ ghorāṃ vācaṃ parāvadāthāsmabhyaṃ sumitriyāṃ vācaṃ dundubhe kalyāṇīṃ kīrtim āvadeti parāvada dviṣato vādyaṃ durhārdo ye viṣūkuhothāsmabhyaṃ puṣṭiṃ rāddhiṃ śriyam āvadundubha ity enam etaiḥ pṛthag āhatya bāladhānenānyaṃ vāghnantam anumantryāpa upaspṛśya paścāt tiṣṭhanto 'gnim upatiṣṭheran namas te gāyatrāya yat te puro yat te śiro namas te rathantarāya yat te dakṣiṇato yat te dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣo namas te bṛhate yat te uttarato yat te uttaraḥ pakṣo namas te yajñāyajñīyāya yat te paścād yat te pucchaṃ namas te vāmadevyāya yat te ātmā yat te madhyam ity etaiḥ pṛthag aṅgāny anvartham
tgt: tvaṃ vāgasītyetadādibhiḥ yathāsūtritairmantraiḥ itikaraṇaprajñāpitāntaiḥ etairbhūmidundubhiṃ pṛthagāhatya bāladhānena pṛthak nānetyarthaḥ vālā asmin dhīyante iti bāladhānaṃ pucchaṃ tena bāladhānena vādayitvā anyaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vādayamānaṃ anumantrya apaḥ sṛṣṭvā paścāttiṣṭhanto'gnimupatiṣṭheran paścime pradeśe iṣṭakācitasyāgneḥ tiṣṭhantaḥ śiraādīnāmaṅgānāmātmanaścopasthānaṃ kuryuḥ namaste gāyatrāya yatte puro yatte śira ityetadādibhiryathāsūtritairmantraiḥ pṛthak nānetyarthaḥ arthamanu anvarthaṃ arthānusāreṇa namaste gāyatrāyeti śiraḥ namaste rathantarāyeti dakṣiṇaṃ pakṣaṃ namaste bṛhata ityuttaraṃ namaste yajñāyajñīyāyeti pucchaṃ namaste vāmadevyāyeti ātmānam

src: atha samastena tasmai te subhoḥ subhavo bhūyāsma nāmāsi nāma bhūyāsam āvir asyāvir mā kuru savitaḥ pramāsuvayāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ bhūtau saṃpaśyasi teṣv abhibhūyāsaṃ śriyaṃ mayi dhehīti
tgt: vyastānāmupasthānaṃ kṛtvā athānantaraṃ samastānāṃ sāmastyenaiva mantreṇopasthānaṃ kuryuḥ tasmai ta ityetadādinā mantreṇa yathāsūtritena
upasthāya vyastasamastaistato'nantaraṃ sadaḥ praviśeyuḥ

uktam upasthāya sadaḥ praviśeyuriti sāmprataṃ pṛṣṭhena stavanamuktam āsandīmāruhyodgāyatīti tasyā āsandyāḥ praveśanamucyate aparayā dvārā sadasaḥ paścimayetyarthaḥ audumbarīmāsandīmūdumbarasya vikāraḥ audumbarī āsandī saṃjñā āsyate asyāmityāsandīṃ mauñjavivānāmatihareyuḥ mauñjaṃ vivānaṃ muñjebhyo nirvṛttāṃ mauñjavivānāmatihareyuḥ praviśeyuḥ
yadyudumbaro na syāt yasya kasyacit yajñiyasya vṛkṣasyāvayavaniṣpannā syāt āsandī yajñamarhati yajñiyaḥ
yadi muñjo na syāt darbhamayaṃ vivānaṃ syāt abhāvo'nupapattiḥ
uktaṃ prādeśamātrī bhavatīti tasyā āsandyāḥ prādeśamātrāḥ pādā itararāsyaṅgāni aratnipramāṇani syuḥ aṅgulaṃ prādeśo'ratnirityetadādīni parimāṇāni siddhāni granthāntare
tāmāsandīmaudumbaryyā dakṣiṇena pradeśena hṛtvā tasyā uttarārddhe sannikarṣe sthāpayeyuḥ tasyā iti kimartham ucyate, sadohyadhikṛtam atastasyā iti bravīti tasyā audumbaryyā uttarato na sadasaḥ

src: tām uttareṇodgātā gatvā paścād upaviśya bhūmispṛśo 'syāḥ pādān kṛtvā kūrcāv adhastād upohyābhimṛśed bṛhadrathantare te pūrvau pādau śyaitanaudhase aparau vairūpavairāje anūcī śākvararaivate tiraścī ity etaiḥ pṛthag aṅgāny anvartham

src: athaitair eva devatā udasya rājaśabdaṃ cāmunā tvā chandasā rohāmīty ārohet
tgt: athaśabdo vikalpārthaḥ athāgamaparaḥ vikalpa etaireva mantrairdevatā utkṣipya padānāmanviṣya rājaśabdañca amunā tvā chandasā rohāmītyārohet prakāramupadiśyate gāyatreṇa vā chandasā rohāmi traiṣṭubhena tvā chandasā rohāmi jāgatena tvā chandasā rohāmi ānuṣṭubhena tvā chandasā rohāmi iti

src: tasyāvasbhṛthād udetya rohiṇaṇīṃ vatsacchavīṃ paridhāya dharmān kuryāt ta uktā brāhmaṇena
tgt: uktaṃ śatāśvaṃ sahasraṃ sarvavedasaṃ vā viśvajiti dakṣiṇā evaṃ viśvajiteṣṭvā tatastasya viśvajito 'vabhṛthādudetya rohiṇīṃ vatsacchavīṃ paridhāya dharmān kuryāt rohiṇīmiti varṇanirdeśaḥ vatsacchavīmiti jātasya vatsasya chatrī carma tāṃ vatsacchavīṃ paridhāya yajamāno dharmān kuryyāt te dharmā uktā brāhmaṇena paśubhirvā eṣa vyṛdhyata ityāhuryaḥ sarvaṃ dadātīti chavīṃ paridhatte paśubhireva samṛdhyata ityetadādayaḥ atha tasyeti nirdeśaḥ kimarthamiti cet ucyate abhijit viśvajitāvadhikṛtau pūrvaṃ viśvajidabhijidbhyāṃ yajamāna iti tayośca sāmānyo vidhirutaḥ tadya ete dharmā nirddiśyante te sāmānyadharmā eva gamyeran evaṃ mābhūdityata āha tasyeti apare bruvate tasya sarvavedasadakṣiṇasyeti na śatāśvasahasradakṣiṇasyeti pūrva evamityarthaḥ evamapyartham upariṣṭāt jñāpayiṣyāma iti yathā syāditi

src: praga eva prahiṇuyād iti dhānañjapyo dīkṣāprabhṛti sadyaḥ sarvaṃ kuryuḥ prathamadvitīyayoḥ śyenasya ca

src: tasya dakṣiṇā yānāni yathotsāhaṃ dadyāt tasmin janapade yāny abhidhyātatamāni syuḥ

src: vrātīnānāṃ yaudhānāṃ putrān anūcānān ṛtvijo vṛṇīta śyenasya

src: vrātyastomair yakṣyamāṇāḥ pṛthag agnīn ādhāya yajñopakaraṇāni ceṣṭvā ya eṣām adhyayane 'bhikrāntitamaḥ syād abhijanena vā tadabhāve 'pi bhogalābhena tasya gārhapate dīkṣeran bhakṣāṃś cānu bhakṣayeyuḥ
tgt: uktāḥ sādyaḥkrāḥ sāmprataṃ vrātyastomā ucyante tān vivakṣuridaṃ sūtramārabhate vrātyastomairiti vrātyānāṃ stomāḥ kiṃlakṣaṇāḥ punarvrātyā iti ucyate paṭhitā brāhmaṇena hīnā vā ete hīyante ye vrātyāṃ pravasanti na hi brahmacaryaṃ racanti na kṛṣiṃ na vaṇijyamiti tathā garagirā vā ete ye brahmādyaṃ janma mantramadantyaduruktavākyaṃ duruktamāhuradaṇḍyaṃ daṇḍena ghnantaścarantyaḥ dīkṣitā dīkṣitavācaṃ vadantīti evaṃprakārāḥ vrātyāḥ paṭhitāḥ ye cānye śākhāntareṣu paṭhyante te sarve vrātyāḥ vrātyastomairiti karaṇe tṛtīyā yakṣyamāṇa iti bhaviṣyatkālopadeśaḥ te vrātyā vrātyastomairyakṣyamāṇāḥ pṛthagagnīnādhāya pṛthaṅnānetyarthaḥ pṛthagagnyādhānāni kṛtvā yajñopakaraṇāni ceṣṭvā yajñopakaraṇāni yajñasādhanāni dravyāṇi arjayitvā ya eṣāṃ vrātyānāmadhyayane 'bhikrāntitamaḥ syāt abhikrāntā adhyayanena sarva ime abhikrāntinaḥ ayameṣāmabhikrāntitamaḥ atiśayena tamatiṣṭhinau abhijanena vā yo'tiricyate abhijanaḥ kulaṃ yaḥ kulena vādhikaḥ syāt tadabhāve 'pi bhogalābhena tayorabhāvastadabhāvaḥ tayoḥ svādhyāyābhijanātirekayorasambhave bhogalābhena ye 'tiricyate dravyavattamaḥ syāt tasya gārhapate dīkṣeran sa teṣāṃ mukhyaḥ syāt bhakṣāṃśca tasyānu sarve bhakṣayeyuḥ

src: ye ke ca vrātyāḥ saṃpādayeyus te prathamena yajeran
tgt: ete vrātyastomāścatvāraḥ paṭhitāḥ tatra prathamo 'viśeṣeṇa sarvān vrātyānadhikṛtya paṭhitaḥ anye tu dvitīyādayo viśiṣṭaviṣayā uktāḥ te yathāmnānaṃ bhavati sāmprataṃ prathamasya tāvadvidhirucyate ye kecidvrātyāḥ sampādayeyuriti nātra niyamaḥ ye kecit sampādayeyuḥ saṃkhyāṃ te prathamena vrātyastomena yajeran kiyantaṃ stomasaṃkhyayā uktaṃ trayastriṃśaddhi devā ārdhnuvanniti

src: dhanuṣkeṇāniṣuṇā vrātyāḥ prasedhamānā yanti sa jyāhnoḍaḥ
