src: bārhadgiraṃ kuryād araṇye geyaṃ hi sachandasyaṃ ca samāne cāhani dṛṣṭam
tgt: bārhadgirameva kuryyāt brahmasāma yasmādaraṇye geyaṃ tat sacchandasyañca tasminnevāhani dṛṣṭaṃ tadeva kalpavṛttenopapannam

src: pārthuraśmaṃ kurvan bārhadgirasya kuryād ṛcām asaṃcārāya
tgt: pārthuraśmaṃ brahmasāma kurvan bārhadgirasya kuryyāt ṛcāmasañcārārthaṃ yadi hi svāsu kuryyāt ṛcāṃ sañcāraḥ syāt ata eva rāyovājīyaṃ kariṣyante

src: daśamasyāhno 'naṅgam eke mānasaṃ bruvate bahiṣpatnīsaṃyājatvādastotrasthānaṃ hi
tgt: gavāmayanaprakaraṇe dādaśāhasya daśāhāni bhavantītyevamadhikṛtyāha athaitat daśamamahariti tasminnadhikaraṇe mānasampaṭhati tatrāyaṃ saṃśayaḥ kimetanmānasaṃ daśamasyāṅgam athānaṅgamiti kutaḥ punarayaṃ saṃśayaḥ aṅgamanaṅgamiti tatkāraṇamasminneva vacyate athāṅgamanaṅgamiti kiṃ punaretasyāścintāyāḥ prayojanaṃ yadyanaṅgaṃ tataḥ ko viśeṣaḥ syāditi ucyate maśakena dvādaśāhavicāreṣu athāpare daśa bhavanti yathā stomaṃ prathamamahastathā stomo'yaṃ sarvo daśarātraḥ syāt tena tejaskāmo brahmavarcasakāmo vā yajeteti evaṃ dvitīyādiṣvahaḥsu ye stomāstaiḥ pratikāmamekaikena stomena sarvāṇi daśāhāni bhavanti tadyadi tāvanmānasaṃ daśamasyāṅgaṃ tatastrivṛdādibhiḥ stomaiḥ pratikalpaṃ mānasenāpi bhavitavyam tathā dāśamikena stomena daśarātre kriyamāne mānasenāpi stomenātra bhavitavyam atha punaranaṅgaṃ tataḥ mānasikena stomena nātra bhavitavyaṃ so'yamācāryya evamarthaṃ parivivakṣuḥ punarārabhate daśamasyāhno'naṅgamiti daśamasyāhaḥ eke ācāryyāḥ mānasam anaṅgaṃ bruvate guṇapradhānamekadeśo'ṅgam avayava ityekorthaḥ na aṅgam anaṅgaṃ kasmādanaṅgaṃ bruvate bahiṣpatnīsaṃyājatvādete yasmāt patnīsaṃyājebhyo bahiretat stotrasthāne hyetat stotrāṇi sarvāṇi prāk patnīsaṃyājebhyo'pavṛjyante ūrddhvaṃ patnīsaṃyājebhyaḥ stotrānāmapravṛttiḥ tasmādanaṅgam

dvādaśāhabrāhmaṇaṃ aṣṭau madhya ukthyā agniṣṭomāvabhita iti yadi hi mānasaṃ daśamasyāṅgamabhaviṣyat agniṣṭomatvena tasyāpavarṇanaṃ nābhaviṣyat daśamasya mānasaṃ hi tattrayodaśaṃ stotraṃ tatra daśamamaharatyagniṣṭomo'bhaviṣyat

kiñcānyat asya mānasasya avayavena ekadeśena sargaṃ vadati sargaḥ sṛṣṭirityanarthāntaram iha stotrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ ātmābhyāsakriyā asya punarmānasasya avayavena ekadeśena kriyāṃ vadati manaso'pāvartayati manasā hiṅkaroti manasā prastauti manasodgāyati manasā pratiharati manasā nidhanamupayantīti evaṃ ebhiḥ kāraṇairanaṅgaṃ sadityucyate
tuśabdaḥ pakṣaṃ vyāvartayati yaduktaṃ daśamasyāhnaḥ anaṅgaṃ mānasamiti tanna aṅgameva syāt yasmādadhikṛtya daśamamahaḥ mānasamāmnātaṃ kathamanaṅgaṃ syāt

src: astotrasthānam ity ekastotrasyāpi svātantryaṃ na vidyate
tgt: na hi kadācit paśyāmaḥ ekastotrasya svatantrabhāvo vartamānaḥ tasmādastotrasthānamityāha

src: agniṣṭomāv abhita iti vādamātraṃ yathā yadukthyo yajñakrator anantarayāyety atirātrasya gavāmayane
tgt: atha yaduktamagniṣṭomāvabhita iti cāhetyatra brūmaḥ vādamātrametat yathā gavāmayane atirātrasya vādamātraṃ jyotiṣṭomo bhavati yajñamukhaṃ tadṛdhnuvanti yadukthyo yajñakratoranantarayājeti na kadācit jyotiṣṭomaḥ ukthyaḥ prāyaṇīyo bhavati gavāmayane ukthāni dṛṣṭvā vādamātraṃ pravṛttaṃ evametadvādamātraṃ agniṣṭomāvabhita iti

src: na ca sargāvayavād adhikṛtyāmnātam anaṅgaṃ syāt yathā rathantaraṃ jyotiṣṭomasya
tgt: yaduktaṃ avayavena cāsya sargaṃ vadatītyatra brūmaḥ aheturayaṃ na hi adhikṛtyāmnātaṃ sargāvayavamātrādanaṅgaṃ syādyathā rathantaraṃ jyotiṣṭomasya jyotiṣṭomamadhikṛtya āmnātaṃ rathantaraṃ sāvāgrathantaramanvapadyatetyekadeśāmnānāt na hi rathantaraṃ jyotiṣṭomasya anaṅgaṃ bhavati prajāpatirakāmayata bahu syāṃ prajāyeyeti sa tūṣṇīṃ manasā dhyāyet tasya yanmanasyāsīt tadbṛhatsamabhavatsa ādīdhīta garbho vai me'yamantarhitastaṃ vācā prajanayā iti sa vācaṃ vyasṛjata sā vāgrathantaramanvapadyateti evamete hetavaḥ prasaktāstasmādaṅgameva mānasaṃ syāt daśamasyeti

src: atirātrayoḥ ṣoḍaśiny anādiṣṭe pratiṣiddhevā kriyamāṇe yatra virāḍ upapadyeta kuryād enaṃ tatretyācāryā dvādaśāhe hi kriyate na gavāmayane tatra tathopapadyate
tgt: iha satreṣu prāyaṇīyodayanīyāvatirātrau paṭhati tatra kasmiṃścit ṣoḍaśinamādiśati kasmiṃścitpratiṣedhati yatra punarnādeśo na pratiṣedhaḥ tatra kathaṃ ṣoḍaśī karttavyo na karttavya ityetasminnarthe ācāryyaḥ parīkṣāmārabhate atirātrayoḥ prāyaṇīyodayanīyayoḥ ṣoḍaśini anādiṣṭe apratiṣiddhe kriyamāṇe'sminyatra virāṭ upapadyate kuryyādenaṃ ṣoḍaśinaṃ tatra ityācāryyā āhuḥ yasmāt dvādaśāhe kriyate na gavāmayane tatra tathopapadyate tatra tayordvādaśāhagavāmayanayoḥ kriyamāṇe cākriyamāṇe ca ṣoḍaśini virāḍupapadyate tatra daśāhe yadi ṣoḍaśi kriyate ato virāṭ sampadyate gavāmayane kriyamāṇe prāyaṇīyodayanīyayoratirātrayoḥ ṣoḍaśini virāṭ sampadyate

src: akāraṇaṃ tu sampadbahavo hy avirāṭ saṃpannāḥ kāraṇaṃ cāpūrvasya vidher na vidyate
tgt: pratipakṣe yaduktaṃ sampatkāraṇaṃ ṣoḍaśina iti tatra na kāraṇam akāraṇam animittaṃ sampat hetuḥ nimittaṃ pramāṇaṃ kāraṇamityanarthāntaraṃ bahavo hyavirāṭsampannāḥ bahavo hi yajñā na virāṭsampannāḥ kiñcānyatkāraṇamapūrvasya vidherna vidyate apūrvasya prathamautpattikasya vidheḥ kāraṇaṃ na vidyate yasmāt dvādaśāhagavāmayanayoḥ ṣoḍaśikā ṣoḍaśitvaṃ na virāṭsampadartham apūrva evāsau tayorautpattiko vidhiḥ prākṛtasya

src: yāthākāmī tv atirātrasya prakṛtau tasmād ihāpi tathaiva syāt
tgt: atirātrasya tu jyotiṣṭomasya prākṛtasya tatra yāthākāmī bhavatīti ṣoḍaśini kriyamāṇe akriyamāṇe vā yāthākāmyaṃ nāma iṣṭataḥ pravṛttiḥ jyotiṣṭomo'tirātraḥ ṣoḍaśimāniti tasmāt yeṣu satreṣu prāyaṇīyodayanīyayoratirātrayoḥ ṣoḍaśī nādiśyate nāpi pratiṣidhyate teṣu yāthākāmyaṃ syāt
yau tau vidhipratiṣedhau kvacidvidhānaṃ kvacitpratiṣedhaḥ to niyamārthau

src: pūrvasmiṃs trayodaśarātre vyūḍhāś chandomāḥ somasāmādeśād gaurīvitasya cānādeśāt
tgt: pūrvasmiṃstrayodaśarātre paṭhati atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahaḥ sarvastomo'tirātraścavāraśchandomā atirātra iti tatrāyaṃ saṃśayaḥ kiṃ chandomā vyūḍhā bhavanti na vyūḍhā iti sarvastomena vyavadhānāt ata ācāryya ārabhate pūrvasmiṃstrayodaśarātre vyūḍhāśchandomāḥ syuriti kasmāt somasānna ādeśāt gaurīvitasya cānādeśāt yadi hi samūḍhā abhaviṣyan iha somasāma nādekṣyat tasmāt samūḍheṣu chandomeṣyavasthitaṃ somasāma gaurīvitañcādekṣyat yasmāt samūḍheṣu śchandomeṣu gaurīvitaṃ nāsti na hi samūḍho'sti chandomānāṃ prakṛtau prāk gaurīvitaḥ svaraḥ tasmāt vyūḍhāśchandomā bhavanti
gavāmayananyāyena pṛṣṭhyaḥ syāt yo gavāmayananyāyaḥ saḥ vyūḍho vā samūḍho vā tṛcaklṛptabahiṣpavamāmaḥ tasmāt yatra yatrāvachinnastatra tatra tathā pravarttate
daśarātravat tu syāt na gavāmayananyāyena avyatirekāt nāyaṃ vyatirikto daśarātrāt
avyatirekāt
vyūhasamādhirhetuḥ vyūḍhāśchandomāḥ pṛṣṭhe'pi vyūḍhe kriyamāṇe samādhiḥ kṛtā bhavati

src: pratnavac cādyabahiṣpavamānaṃ pareṇa hy etad asya pratnānurūpa ityāha
tgt: pratnavaccādyabahiṣpavamānaṃ siddhaṃ yasmātpareṇa etanmātraṃ trayodaśarātram asya pratnānurūpa ityāha maśakaḥ apavṛjya trayodaśarātraṃ asya pratnānurūpa iti paṭhati dvādaśāhasya ṣoḍaśimantāvatirātrau trayodaśarātre prathamasya chandomasya kaṇvarathantarasya loke somasāma punānaḥ soma dhārayetyetatsāṃvatsarikaṃ vrataṃ satreṣu yatrātirātrātpṛṣṭhyamupayanti prathamasyāhno'sya pratnānurūpa iti
chando bhavati daśarātre
bhavatyetadbahiṣpavamāne navāhasya yuktyā iti sa ceha navāho'sti

src: saṃvatsarādeśād rātrisatreṣu tathaivābhiplavānām abhyāsa iti gautamaḥ
tgt: saṃvatsare'bhiplavasyābhyāso dṛṣṭaḥ tatra ca viśeṣo dṛṣṭaḥ arṣāsomadyumattama iti gāyatrañca ya evañcāpatyasantaniśākvaravarṇānyuttareṣviti tadabhiplavasyābhyāsaḥ rātrisatreṣvapi keṣucidbhavati tatsaṃvatsare ādeśādviśeṣasya rātrisatreṣvevābhyāsastathaiva syāt evaṃ gautama ācāryo manyate
trayastriṃśadrātre satre nivṛttimuttareṣām apatyādīnāṃ darśayatīti aparaṃ mataṃ nāsya paramaparam athavā idamanyat idamaparaṃ tasmādanyeṣu sāṃvatsariko abhyāsaḥ syāditi

src: āvṛttānāṃ pañcāhānāṃ prathamasya pañcāhasya prathamasyāhno mānavādir bṛhatī tajjāmi syāt saṃtaninā
tgt: kathaṃ nivṛttimuttareṣāṃ darśayatīti taducyate āvṛttānāṃ pañcāhānāṃ trayastriṃśadrātre prathamasya pañcāhasya prathamasyāhno mānavādirbṛhatī bhavati athaitayaiva pañcāhā āvṛttā āvṛttānāṃ pañcāhānāṃ prathamasya pañcāhasya prathamasyāhno'bhisomāsa āyava iti mānavamekasyāṃ tasyāmevānūpa iti tat yadyapatyādīnāṃ pravṛttiḥ syāt tatra tṛtīye pañcāhe santani syāt tadāvṛttasya prathamaṃ tadevaṃ santanimānavayorjāmi syāt anena kāraṇena manyāmahe apatyādīnāṃ rātrisatreṣu nivṛttirbhavati
vaikṛtatvāttu teṣu pañcāheṣu apatyādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ pañcāhāstena te ṣaḍahāsteṣu pañcāheṣviti
pañcāheṣvabhiplavaprasaṅgaṃ na kuryyāt tasmādabhiplavābhyāso rātrisatreṣu syāt sāṃvatsarikebhyo'yaṃ viśeṣaḥ

src: abhiplavapañcāhā eveti gautame 'dhikṛto hi sa satreṣu bhavatītaraś cādṛṣṭaḥ
tgt: gautama ācārya āha abhiplavapañcāhā eva bhavantīti eva śabdoavadhāraṇarthaḥ abhiplavapañcāhā eva na pṛṣṭhāstomapañcāhā iti yasmādadhikṛtaḥ satreṣu abhiplavapañcāhaḥ atirātro jyotirgaurāyuḥ pañcāha iti yaduktamanādeśe prakṛtipratyayāditi anādeśajātireṣā bhavati yadadhikāraḥ kiñcānyat itaraścādṛṣṭaḥ itaraśca pṛthyastomapañcāhaḥ adṛṣṭaḥ satreṣu kiṃ dṛṣṭārthaḥ pratīyatāmadṛṣṭārthaḥ pratīyatāmiti dṛṣṭapratyayo nyāyata iti
abhyāsaścādṛṣṭaḥ prākṛtasya tāvat pṛṣṭhyastomasyaiva kutaḥ pañcāhasyābhyāsaḥ syāditi yāvatā nidānakāro'pyāha athāpi kṛtsnāveva pṛṭhyastomau nābhiprayogaṃ labhete kuto viluptau labheyātāmiti

src: jyotirgaurāyurgaurāyuḥ pañcāhaḥ sa dvitīyaḥ sa tṛtīya iti ca parabrāhmaṇam
tgt: yadapyuktaṃ jyotirgaurāyurityanādeśāditi iva pareṣāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ jyotirāyurgaurāyuḥ sa dvitīyaḥ sa tṛtīya iti

src: eṣa pratnāvārkajambhaṃ vā pratipañcāhaṃ yathā lokabṛhadrathantarāś cet
tgt: ete pañcāhā bhavanti tata eṣa pratnā vā anurūpaḥ pratipañcāhaṃ vārkajambhaṃ vā prathame'hani

src: āñjanābhyañjanāsu gārhapatya upasatsu sarpīṃṣi phāṇeyuḥ pṛthagdevasurabhibhir yāny uktāni brāhmaṇena
tgt: āñjanābhyañjanāsu gārhapatye'gnau sarpīṃṣi gṛhītāni phāṇayeyuḥ pṛthaṅnānetyarthaḥ devasurabhibhiḥ saha devasurabhīṇi yānyuktāni brāhmaṇena gaulgulavena saugandhikena paitudāraveṇa ghṛtaṃ saha ekīkaraṇaṃ devasurabhibhiḥ

src: taiḥ sutyāsūpākaraṇavelāyāṃ savanānāṃ pūrveṇa havirdhāne āsīnā āñjīrann abhyañjīraṃ ca
tgt: taiḥ sutyāsūpākaraṇavelāyāṃ havirddhānayoḥ pūrve pradeśe āsīnāḥ satriṇaḥ āñjīran akṣīṇī gātrāṇi ca abhyañjīran uktaṃ gaulgulavena prātaḥsavane saugandhikena mādhyandine savane paitudāraveṇa tṛtīyasavana iti
gautama ācāryyo manyate bhuktvāgnīdhrīya eva tat kuryyuriti
ānupūrvyaṃ brāhmaṇenoktaṃ gaulgulavena prātaḥsavane saugandhikena mādhyandine savane paitudāraveṇa tṛtīyasavane
dhānañjapyaśāṇḍilyāvācāryyāvāhatuḥ aharaharetat kuryyuriti
sarvastoma evaitat kuryyuriti eṣa ūrddhvaṃ stomataḥ saṃsthātaḥ
eke ācāryyā bruvate pṛṣṭhya eva tatkuryuriti

src: saṃvatsarasaṃmitāsu prathamaṃ dāśarātrikaṃ prāyaṇīyaṃ syād ity eke trivṛd eva kāryam iti hyāheti
tgt: saṃvatsarasaṃmitāsu paṭhati tadāhuryaccaturviṃśamahaḥ prāyaṇīyaṃ kuryyuḥ saṃvatsaramārabhya na samāpayeyuriti trivṛdeva kāryamiti tatra kimidaṃ trivṛtā liṅgena dāśarātrikaṃ prathamamahaścodyete athavā tata adhikṛtasyaiva prāyaṇīyasya stomavikāra iti so'yametasminnarthe śāstramārabhate saṃvatsarasaṃmitāsvityādi saṃvatsarasaṃmitā iti saṃjñā tāsu saṃvatsarasaṃmitāsu prathamamahaḥ dāśarātrikaṃ prāyaṇīyaṃ syādityeke ācāryyā ūcuḥ yasmādevaṃ brāhmaṇamāha trivṛdeva kāryyamiti

src: prāyaṇīyaṃ tu codayitvā tasya stomavikāraṃ gṛhṇāti
tgt: natvevaṃ syāt prāyaṇīyaṃ caturviṃśamahaścodayitvā atirātraścaturviṃśaṃ prāyaṇīyamahariti trivṛdeva kāryyamiti tasya stomavikāraṃ gṛhṇāti
kiñcānyat dāśarātrikāṇāñcāhnāṃ avayavaprayogaḥ ekadeśasammitāsu prayogo na vidyate

src: āvṛtte 'bhiplave śārkvaravarṇaṃ syād ity ācāryaḥ sāṃvatsarikasya dravyasyānugrahāyeti
tgt: saṃvatsarasaṃmitāsu uttare pakṣasi abhiplave asmin āvṛtte śārkaravarṇaṃ syādityācāryyā manyante sāṃvatsarikasya dravyasyānugrahārthamiti pūrvasmin pakṣasi trayo'bhiplavāḥ prayuktāḥ yaṇvāpatyaṃ santaninimittam ayaṃ caturthaḥ śārkvaravarṇavān uttare pakṣasi tasmin prayujyamāne sarvasāṃvatsarikaṃ dravyamanugṛhītaṃ bhavati

src: caturthas tv abhiplavo luptas tena sahāpeyād yathā pṛṣṭhena janitram
tgt: natvevaṃ syāt yaścaturthaḥ sāṃvatsariko'bhiplavaḥ pūrvasmin pakṣasi sa iha luptaḥ tena saha śārkvaravarṇamapyupeyāt yathā pṛṣṭhyena lupyamānena janitramapi luptaṃ nanu sarva eva pṛṣṭho luptaḥ tatkimidaṃ yathā pṛṣṭhyena janitramiti ucyate pṛṣṭo daśarātre prayokṣyate janitrantu samūhāgataṃ tat luptameva

ucyate yadi śārkvaravarṇaṃ kriyate kiṃ tarhi tatra karttavyamiti bravīti santani karttavyaṃ taddhi pūrvasmin pakṣasi prayuktantadiha karttavyaṃ āvṛttisādhutvāt uttarasya pakṣasya āvṛttisādhuruttare pakṣa iti

src: yaṇvaṃ tu syād upariṣṭādhyabhiplavānāṃ lopasthānaṃ pūrvasmin pakṣasi tat purastād āvṛttānām
tgt: yaṇvantu syāt tatra na santanini upariṣṭādhyabhiplāvānāṃ lopasthānaṃ purastādbhavati tasmāt yaṇvameva syāt
uttarasmin pakṣasi āvṛttasyābhiplavasya etenoktaṃ vidhānam ekaṣaṣṭirātre

src: śatarātre 'bhiprayāyam abhiṣuṇvantv abhikrāntyai samānatrābhiṣuṇvanti pratiṣṭhityā iti sa vikalpaḥ syāt
tgt: śatarātre paṭhati abhiprayāyamabhiṣuṇvantyabhikrāntyai samānatrābhiṣuṇvanti pratiṣṭhityā iti sa vikalpaḥ syāt bhavet abhiprayāya vā syādabhiṣavaḥ abhiprayāyābhiprayāya samānatra samānatra vā samānadeśe ekasmin ubhayasyāśakyatvāt
abhiprayāyaṃ sunvantaḥ yāntaḥ sunuyuḥ yathā yena prakāreṇa sārasvateṣu śamyāprāsanena
yatra kvaca deśe nātra niyamaḥ yathā sārasvateṣu sarasvatyāstīreṇeti
ekasminvā deśe sunuyuḥ samāne ayānta eva

src: cakrīvanti sadohavirdhānāni kārayitvāhaḥsaṃsthāsu cakrāṇi viparivartayeyur ity ācāryas tadabhiprayāttadrūpam aprayāṇāṃ ca samānatrābhiṣavaḥ
tgt: śrutyarthatvāt kalpyante cakrīvanti sadohavirddhānāni kārayitvā sadaśca havirddhāne ca sadohavirddhānāni teṣāmahaḥsaṃsthāsu ahaḥsamāptiṣu cakrāṇi viparivarttayeyurityācāryyā āhuḥ tadabhiprayāttasya rūpam aprayāṇāśca samānatrābhiṣavaḥ aprayāṇāśca ekatra deśe samāne abhiṣavaḥ kṛto bhavati evamubhayoḥ śrutyorarthaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati

src: ahar ahar etat kuryur iti dhānañjapyaśāṇḍilyau
tgt: dhānañjapyaśāṇḍilyāvācāryyāvāhatuḥ yadetadabhiṣavasya vidhānamuktam etadahanyahani kuryyuriti
gautama ācāryya āha abhiplaveṣveva tat kuryurnāhanyahani iti
eke ācāryyā āhuḥ trikadrukeṣvityevaitatkuryyurnānyatreti
uktaḥ kāloyasyāḥ seyamuktakāladīkṣā kāla ukto brāhmaṇena gavāmayanasya ayane vikalpaḥ
vaiśākhajyaiṣṭhau tu vikalpete asamāsa iti kimartham āṣāḍhaśceti ucyate vakṣyati ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā dīkṣitvā saptadaśadīkṣāḥ kurvīranniti tadāṣāḍha eva syāt
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ vā āṣāḍhasya dīkṣitvā saptadaśadīkṣāḥ kurvīran
etena gavāmayanikena vidhinā sāṃvatsarikāṇāṃ satrāṇām uktaṃ vidhānam ādeśādanyatra ādeśe yathādeśam

src: pañcasu māḥsu bārhatāḥ pragāthā āpyanta ity abhīvarttastotrīyā brahmasāmabhūtasya tasya hi prakaraṇe śrūyante
tgt: uktakālādīkṣā brāhmaṇena gavāmayanasyetyetadadhikṛtaṃ tasmin gavāmayane paṭhati abhīvartto brahmasāma bhavatītyevamadhikṛtyāha pañcasu māḥsu bārhatāḥ pragāthā āpyanta iti teṣāṃ pragāthānāntu viṣayaḥ kalpyate pañcasu māḥsu bārhatāḥ pragāthāḥ samāpyante prāpyanta iti yadidaṃ vidhānante pragāthā abhīvarttastotrīyāḥ syuḥ kiṃ viṣayasyābhīvarttasya brahmasāmabhūtasya yasmāttasya prakaraṇe śrūyante

src: anyonyaḥ pragātha iti ca nānā pragāthatāṃ darśayati
tgt: samānaṃ sāma bhavatyanyonyaḥ pragātha ityetadbrāhmaṇamabhīvarttasya nānā pragāthatāṃ darśayati

kutaḥ punaste pragāthā āhartavyā iti ucyate catuḥśatamaindrā bārhatāḥ pragāthā daśatayīṣviti catvāraśca śataṃ catuḥśataṃ aindrāḥ devatayā bārhatāḥ chandasā daśatayīṣu daśāvayavāsvṛkṣu rugveda ityarthaḥ
teṣāṃ pragāthānāṃ catuḥśatasya catvāraḥ anyatra sthānāḥ caturṇāmanyatra sthānaṃ brahmasāmnaḥ bṛhadrathantarayoḥ stotrīyayoḥ kāleyastotrīyāḥ indrakratumauttarapākṣika iti

evañcānyatra sthānāṃ caturuddhṛtya śataṃ pragāthāḥ śiṣyante tasya śatasyaikaṃ pragāthaṃ prāyanīye'hani caturviṃśe kuryyāt itarānyekonaśatam abhiplaveṣu kuryyāt pañcasu māseṣu viṃśatirabhiplavāḥ teṣu ekaikasminnabhiplave pañca pañca pragāthā bhavantīti teṣāmekasmiṃścatvāra evamevaiṣāṃ pragāthānāṃ vināśaḥ
tāsveva daśatayīṣu ekonaviṃśatsātobārhatāstṛcāḥ tān āharet

src: teṣām ekaikaṃ tṛtīye tṛtīye 'hani kuryāt kṛtā hy etasmiṃ sthāna ārṣeyakalpena
tgt: teṣāṃ sātobārhatānāṃ tṛcānāṃ ekaikaṃ tṛtīye tṛtīye'hani kuryyāt abhiplaveṣu prathamadvitīyatṛtīyacaturthapañcamaṣaṣṭheṣu pragāthā na kṛtā hi satobṛhatyaḥ tṛtīye'hanyārṣeyakalpena ātvā sahasramāśatamityetāḥ

src: pañcamasya māsasyottame'bhiplave pañcame'hani satobṛhatīḥ kuryāt pragāthā prabhavāt
tgt: pañcamasya māsasya ya uttamo'bhiplavastasminneva pragātho na saṃpūryyate pañcame'hani satobṛhatīḥ kuryyāt dvau sātobṛhatau tṛcau catvāraśca pragāthāḥ evamekaviṃśatiḥ sātobṛhatyaḥ prayuktāḥ pragāthāśca sarve aṣṭau sātobārhatāstṛcāḥ avaśiṣyante

src: teṣv āpteṣu chandasī saṃyujyaitavyam iti ṣaṣṭhe māsi gāyatrīpādam ekaikam uṣṇihām upariṣṭāt kuryād iṣṭāvānupapattir hyanyathā
tgt: uktaṃ pañcasu māḥsu bārhatāḥ pragāthā āpyante teṣvāpteṣu chandasi saṃyujyaitavyantisṛṣu uṣṇihaḥ syurekā gāyatrī tāstisro bṛhatyo bhavantīti yāvat teṣu pragātheṣu āpteṣu sarveṣu chandasī saṃyujyaitavyamiti brāhmaṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsi gāyatrīpādamekaikamuṣṇahāmupariṣṭāt kuryyāt evante bārhatāstṛcā bhavanti anyathā hi viṣṭāvānopapadyante

src: sātobarhataśeṣo 'ṣṭau tān kṛtvā saṃyoga iti gautamaḥ
tgt: gautama ācāryya āha sātobārhatānāṃ tṛcānām ekaviṃśatiḥ pañcasu māseṣu prayuktāḥ anye'ṣṭau śeṣā anuprayuktāḥ tān ṣaṣṭhasya māsasya prathame'bhiplave kṛtvā dvitīyasya cārthe dvyahe tataśchandasī saṃyujyā diti
yasmāt bṛhatīkṣayādevamāmanati teṣvāpteṣu chandasī saṃyujyaitavyam

src: caturuttarair eva chandobhir etavyam iti gāyatrīṃ caturviṃśe kuryād uṣṇihaṃ prathama ābhiplavike 'nuṣṭubhaṃ dvitīye bṛhatīr itareṣu
tgt: uktaṃ tadāhuḥ saṃśara iva vā eṣa chandasāṃ yaddve chandasī saṃyujyantīni caturuttareva chandobhiretavyamiti etasmiṃścaturuttarakalpe gāyatrīṃ caturviṃśe'hani kuryyāt abhiplavike prathame'hani uṣṇihaṃ kuryyāt anuṣṭubhaṃ dvitīye'hani kuryyāt itareṣu sarveṣvahaḥsu bṛhatīṃ kuryyāt

src: uddharet tu pañcamād ahnaḥ satobṛhatīḥ prabhavanti hi pragāthāḥ
tgt: kiñca uddharetpañcamādahnaḥ satobṛhatīḥ yasmāt pragāthāḥ prabhavanti vidyanta ityarthaḥ caturviṃśāt prāyaṇīyādekaḥ ābhilavikau dvau dvitīyaprathamābhyāmahobhyām ekaḥ pañcamāt
tatra pañcame'hani ṣaṣṭhe vā paṅktīḥ kṛtvā
triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsaṃ gaccheyuḥ

tṛtīye svarasāmni jagatī karttavyā evameteṣāṃ chandasāṃ kriyā yasmādāha ekāṃ gāyatrīmekāhamupeyurekāmaṣṇihamekāhamekāmanuṣṭubhamekāhaṃ bṛhatyā pañcamāsamīyuḥ paṅktimekāhamupeyuḥ triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsamīyuḥ śvoviṣuvān bhaviteti jagatīmupeyuriti

src: nava sātobārhataśeṣo dvau ca pragāthau tān kṛtvā paṅktim upeyus teṣāṃ cottamasya sthāne tata ūrdhvaṃ triṣṭubheti gautamaḥ
tgt: gautama ācāryya āha sātobārhatā navāvasiṣṭā dvau ca pragāthau tān ṣaṣṭhasya māsasya prathame cābhiplave dvitīyasya cābhiplavasvādye pañcāhe tān kṛtvā tataḥ paṅktimupeyuriti athavā teṣāmeva bārhatānāṃ pragāthānām uttamasya sthāne paṅktiṃ kṛtvā tata ūrddhvaṃ triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsamīyuḥ yāvasiddham

src: bṛhatyā caiva triṣṭubhā caitavyam iti triṣṭubhaṃ caturviṃśe kuryd bṛhatīṃ prathama ābhiplavike
tgt: iha paṭhati tadāhuranavaklṛptāni vā etāni chandāṃsi madhyandine bṛhatyā caiva triṣṭubhā caitavyamiti cāturuttaryamapodya triṣṭupbṛhatībhyāṃ vidadhāti taducyate bṛhatyā caiva triṣṭubhā caitavyamiti triṣṭubhaṃ caturviṃśe'hani prāyaṇīye kuryyāt abhīvarttastotrīyaṃ prathame ābhiplavike'hani bṛhatīṃ kuryyāt abhīvarttasya
eṣa viparyyāsaḥ anena nyāyena eṣa viparyyāsaḥ sarvasminnayane
ya ete vidhaya uktāḥ pañcasu māḥsu bārhatāḥ pragāthā āpyanta ityārabhya etāni mahānānātvānītyucyante śrutyantare mahānānātvāni śrūyante

src: caturuttaraprayogo bṛhatītriṣṭubhāṃ ca viparyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭha eva māsi syād iti śaucivṛttiḥ saṃśara iva vā eṣa chandasām iti hi tasminn upodya vidadhāti
tgt: śaucivṛkṣirācāryya āha ya eṣa caturuttara prayogaḥ chandasāṃ chandobhiretavyamiti yaśca bṛhatītriṣṭubhośca viparyyāsaḥ bṛhatyā caiva triṣṭubhā caitavyamiti etau kalpau kriyamāṇa ṣaṣṭha eva māsi syātāmiti yasmādāha saṃśara iva vā eṣa chandasāṃ yaddve chandasī saṃyuñjantīti caturuttaraireva chandobhiretavyamiti tasmin ṣaṣṭhe upodya chandaḥsaṃyogaṃ kalpo vidadhāti ṣaṣṭhaviṣayaḥ chandaḥsaṃyogaḥ yadviṣayaścāpavādaḥ tadviṣayenaivetareṇa vidhinā bhavitavyam

src: sarvatraivety ācāryāś caturuttarāṇi hy anupūrvaṃ prayuñjāno bṛhatīṃ madhya āmanati triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsam iti cāha
tgt: ācāryyā āhuḥ sarvasminnevāyane pūrvasminnetau kalpau syātāmiti yasmāccaturuttarāṇi chandāṃsi anupūrvaṃ prayuñjānaḥ gāyatryuṣṇiganuṣṭubhau vidhāya triṣvahaḥsu bṛhatīṃ madhya āmanati yāvatpañcamāsāḥ samāptā iti kiñcānyat triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsamiti cāha brāhmaṇaṃ kṛtsnaṃ saṃyogaṃ darśayati
yasmāt bṛhatya eva na santi kena vyatyāsaḥ kariṣyati

src: sā prāyād bṛhatīgrahaṇam iti śaucivṛkṣis triṣṭubheti yathā bhūyaso vādo 'kṣīṇāś ca bṛhatyaḥ
tgt: śaucivṛkṣirācāryya āha syādeva ṣaṣṭhe māsi bṛhatītriṣṭubhorviparyyāsaḥ yattāvaducyate caturuttarāṇi anupūrvaṃ prayuñjāno bṛhatīṃ madhya āmanatīti sā prāyyādbṛhatīgrahaṇaṃ na hyatra bṛhatyaḥ kṛtāḥ atra yaduktaṃ triṣṭubhā ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsamiti cāha ayaṃ bhūyasovādaḥ bhūyastvaṃ gṛhītvā pravṛttaḥ prayogo hi vādānānniyāmako bhavati atha yaduktaṃ bṛhatīkṣayācca bṛhatyā vyatyāsonopapadyate iti akṣīṇāśca bṛhatyaḥ naca bṛhatyaḥ, kṣīṇāḥ satyo bṛhatyaḥ kathaṃ santītyucyate

src: sātobārhataśeṣo hy aṣṭau bṛhadrathantarakāleyastotrīyāś ca tais triṣṭubho vyatyasyet
tgt: ya ekonatriṃśatsātobārhatāstṛcāsteṣāmekaviṃśatipragāthaiḥ sahopayuktāḥ aṣṭau śiṣyante tairaṣṭabhiḥ bṛhadrathantarakāleyastotrīyaiśca taiḥ taistriṣṭubhaiḥ ṣaṣṭhe māsi triṣṭubhovyatyasyet ekādaśasu rāthantareṣvahaḥsu ekādaśabṛhatyaḥ daśasu bārhateṣu daśa triṣṭubhaḥ triṣvabhiplaveṣu ca svarasāmasu ca

src: taraṇir it siṣāsatīti kāleyaṃ syād yad ahastasya stotrīye 'bhīvartaḥ
tgt: yasminnahani kāleyastotrīye'bhīvarttaḥ syāt tasminnahani taraṇiritsiṣāmatīti kāleyaṃ syāt asañcārāddhetoḥ

src: svarasāmnor vānyatarasmin rathantarastotrīyaṃ kuryāt kṛtā hi tatrānyā rathantarasyaivaṃ vyācakṣata ācāryāḥ
tgt: athavā svaramānnoḥ prathamatṛtīyayoranyatarasminnekasmin rathantare stotrīyaṃ brahmasāmni kuyāt yasmāttatra pṛṣṭhagatasya rathantarasya anyā eva ṛcaḥ kṛtā evamācāryyā vyācakṣate

src: viṃśatiśataṃ tv api pragāthā na dhīyate tebhya eva prayuñjīta saṃrodho hi catuḥśate
tgt: viṃśatiśca śatañca viṃśatiśataṃ viṃśatiśatantvapi pragāthā na dhīyate apare tuśabdo hetvarthaḥ yasmāt tatra sa eva prayujyate catuḥśate saṃrodhaḥ svasya pakṣa eva
tatra tasmin kalpe tathaiva satobṛhatīḥ kuryyāt yathā catuḥśate tṛtīye'hani
yathā satobṛhatyaḥ pañcame māsi asyābhiplavasya pañcame'hani kṛtāḥ tā uddharet prabhavanti hi pragāthāḥ hiśabdo hetvarthaḥ yasmāt prabhavanti pragāthāḥ

src: śaucivṛkṣeḥ punarviparyāso 'nyāyenākṛtakriyā hi vidhānaṃ kṛtāḥ punar bṛhadrathantarakāleyastotrīyāḥ
tgt: yaḥ punarayaṃ śaucivṛkṣeḥ bṛhatītriṣṭubhorviparyyāsaḥ ṣaṣṭhe māsi ayamanyāyena kṛtaḥ kathamanyāyaḥ yasmādakṛtakriyā hi ya āstutaṃ kurvato yathādugdhāmupasīdedevantaditi aprayuktapratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ punarbṛhadrathantarakāleyastotrīyāḥ teṣāṃ kṛtānāṃ satāṃ sveṣu sthāneṣu kṛtāḥ punarbrahmasāmni prayogaḥ

src: viṃśatiśatasya tu śeṣo vidyate teṣāṃ saptabhiḥ sātobārhataiś caturbhir vyatyasyet
tgt: viṃśatiśatasya pragāthānāṃ śeṣo vidyate teṣāṃ saptabhiḥ pragāthaiḥ ye ca nava sātobārhatāstacaḥ teṣāṃ caturbhiḥ ṣaṣṭhe māsi triṣṭubho'vyatyasyet

src: trayastriṃśatprabhṛtīn saha caturviṃśeṣu kuryād uttame ca svarasāmnīty ācāryā abhīvartaprakaraṇe hi śrūyante so 'trāpyabhīvarta iti
tgt: anantaraṃ paṭhati trayastriṃśatā pragāthairetavyaṃ trayastriṃśaddevatāsveva pratitiṣṭhantoyanti caturviṃśatyaitavyaṃ dvādaśabhiretayaṃ ṣaḍbhiretavyaṃ caturbhiretavyaṃ tribhiretavyaṃ dvābhyāmetavyamiti trayastriṃśatprabhṛtayaḥ kalpāḥ śrūyante tān cayastriṃśatprabhṛtīn pragāthān saha caturviṃśeṣvabhiplaveṣu kuryyāt uttame ca svarasāmni ityevamācāryyā āhuḥ yasmādete trayastriṃśatpragāthādayaḥ kalpāḥ abhīvarttaprakaraṇe śrūyante so'trāpyabhīvartta iti caturviṃśe svarasāmasu ca uttamaṃ svarasāmānaṃ udgṛhṇāti tatra tu satobṛhatītvanna bhavati satobṛhatī uddharatīha

src: antareṇa tv etāv ārṣeyakalpena kṛtaṃ ṣaṭpragātham ihāpi tathaiva syāt
tgt: natvevaṃ syāt antareṇa caturviṃśasvarasāmnoḥ ārṣeyakalpena maśakena kṛtaṃ ṣaṭpragātham ayane ihāpi tathaiva syāt

src: teṣāṃ yatra samaprayoge tṛtīye tṛtīye'hani satobṛhatya upapadyeran kuryād enās tatra
tgt: teṣāṃ pragāthānāṃ yatra samaprayoge kriyamāṇe ye tṛtīye'hani satobṛhatya upapadyeran kuryyādenāstatra

src: anupapadyamānāsu pragāthā eva syur anācāro hi ṣaḍahe 'nyatra tṛtīyād ahnaḥ satobṛhatīnām
tgt: anupapadyamānāsu samaprayogeṇa pragāthā eva syuḥ tṛtīyeṣvahaḥsu yathā anācāraḥ ṣaḍahe'nyatra tṛtīyādahnaḥ satobṛhatīnām ayaṃ hi samaprayogaḥ ṣaṭpragāthe evopapadyate

src: sa yathaiva purastād abhīvarttastotrīyaṃ kuryāt tathopariṣṭād indrakratau brahmasāmāni nidhanavanty evaṃ hy ārṣeyakalpena kṛtam
tgt: sa yenaiva kalpena pūrvasmin pakṣasi abhīvarttastotrīyaṃ kuryyāt ādikalpādārabhya yāvaddhi pragātha iti tathaitasmin pakṣasi indrakratau pragāthe brahmasāmāni nidhanavanti evaṃ kalpayet yasmādevamārṣeyakalpena kṛtaṃ pūrvasmin pakṣasi ṣaṭpragātheṣu abhīvarttaḥ kṛtaḥ uttarasmin indrakratau ṣaṭ sāmāni kṛtāni

src: atirātracaturviṃśābhyāṃ saha ṣaṣṭho māsaḥ pūrvasmin pakṣasi vratātirātrābhyāṃ prathama uttarasmin
tgt: pūrvasmin pakṣasi atirātracaturviṃśe paṭhitvā pañcāyanamāsān paṭhati tataḥ ṣaṣṭhe māsi vrataṃ paṭhati uttarasmin pakṣasi prathamaṃ vrataṃ paṭhitvā caturayanamāsān paṭhati tato daśarātramiśraṃ māsaṃ paṭhati tatra vratātirātramadhikaṃ paṭhati tat ṣaṣṭhasaptamayormāsayoḥ pūraṇaṃ dadāti atirātracaturviṃśābhyāṃ saha pūrvasmin pakṣasi ṣaṣṭhomāsaḥ sampūrṇo bhavati uttarasmin pakṣasi prathamovratātirātrābhyām

src: yad etāni sāmāni na cyavanta iti gaurīvitasyottarayor nihavaśyāvāśve syātāṃ sarvatra gavāmayane 'nārabhya hy acyavanaṃ vidadhātīty eke
tgt: uktaṃ ye vai vācamannamādayantyannādā bhavantīti ye vitarṣayanti rūkṣā bhavanti gaurīvitaṃ śyāvāśvannihava etāni vai sāmāni vāco'nnameteṣāṃ vāgannaṃ yadetāni sāmāni na cyavante vācameva tadannamādayanti tena sarve'nnādā bhavanti tadyadetāni sāmāni na cyavanta iti gaurīvitasyottarayostotrīyayornihavaśyāvāśve syātāṃ sarvasmin gavāmayane hi yasmādanārabhya eteṣāṃ sthānam acyavanañca vidadhāti evameke ācāryyā manyante

src: anvavetya vidhistvārṣeyakalpena kṛto gaurīvitaśyāvāśvayornihavasya ca brāhmaṇena tathā satyacyavanaṃ syāt
tgt: anvavetyānvagatya gaurīvitaśyāvāśvayoḥ ārṣeyakalpena vidhiḥ kṛtaḥ anugamanamanvavāyaḥ nihavasya ca anvavetya vidhiḥ kṛto brāhmaṇena tathā sati kalpe teṣām acyavanaṃ syāt

src: sarve sahartvijo mahāvratena stuvīrann ity udgātṛvikāra eva syād aśrutibhūtā hy anye
tgt: mahāvrataprakaraṇe sarve mahartvijo mahāvratena stuvīrannityevamadhikṛtyādhvaryuḥ śirasodgāyediti parisaṃkhyānaṃ karoti tatra kiṃ sarvaśabdasya niravaśeṣavācitvāt sarveṣāṃ stavanaṃ atha parisaṃkhyānādadhvaryvādayo ye parisaṃkhyātāsteṣāmiti etasmin saṃśaya ācāryya ārabhate sarve mahartvijo mahāvratena stuvīranniti tadetadbrāhmaṇam ayamudgātṛvikāra eva syāt yenodgātā vikriyate adhvaryumaitrāvaruṇabrāhmaṇāchaṃsigṛhapatibhista eva syuḥ aśrutibhūtā hyanye na śrutibhūtā aśrutibhūtāḥ anya ṛtvijaḥ na śrutibhūtāḥ ucyante nanviyaṃ śrutiḥ sarve mahartvija iti atrāha
yo'yaṃ sarvaśabdaḥ ayanteṣvevāvāpyate etaddhi brāhmaṇam adhvaryvādīn manasi kṛtvā sarvaśabdaṃ prayuṇkte tena tasyādhikṛteṣu sarvaśabdo'rthavān yathā sarva odanabhutaḥ sarvairbrāhmaṇairbhuktamiti / 2

src: saha stuvīrann iti karmasamavāyāt paurvāparyacodanād anupūrvaṃ stavanaṃ syāt
tgt: saha stuvīranniti yadetat tadetasmin karmaṇi samavāyāt paurvāparyyacodanādanupūrvaṃ stavanaṃ syāt yattu stavanaṃ tadeva ānupūrvyeṇa syāt pūrvāparabhāvaḥ paurvāparyyam

src: tisṛbhir udgātātmana udgīyeti cātmanā jaghanyastavanaṃ darśayati
tgt: tisṛbhirudgātātmana udgīyeti caitadādi brāhmaṇam ātmanā jaghanyastavanaṃ darśayati evaṃ caitatsarvaṃ bhavati yathānupūryeṇa stavanamiti

src: nānādeśastavanaṃ chandogānām eva syād udgātaiva sarveṇodgāyed iti hy uktvā tasya deśān vidadhāti havirdhāne śirasā stutvā saṃrabdhāḥ pratyañca eyus te dakṣiṇena dhiṣṇān parītya paścān maitrāvaruṇasya dhiṣṇyasyopaviśyeti ca ye śirasā stuvate teṣām evetaraiḥ stavanaṃ darśayati
tgt: yadetannānādeśastavanañcoditaṃ havirddhāne śirasā stutvā ityetadādinā tacchandogānāmeva syāt netareṣāṃ yasmāt atho khalvāhuḥ kathamadhvaryyurbahvṛcaḥ sāma gāyedityudgātaiva sarveṇodgāyediti hyuktvā tasya deśānvidadhāti tasya sthānāni vidadhāti udgātuḥ kiñcānyat havirddhāne śirasā stutvā saṃrabdhāḥ pratyañca eyuste dakṣiṇena dhiṣṇyān parītya paścāt maitrāvaruṇasya dhiṣṇyasyopaviśyeti caiṣa samānakarttṛka ādeśaḥ ye śirasi stuvate teṣāmevetaraiḥ stavanaṃ darśayati

src: ilāndam agniṣṭomasāma kāryam ity agne tava śravo vaya ity etāsāṃ pūrvasu tisṛṣu syāt
tgt: ilāndamagniṣṭomasāma kāryyamiti brāhmaṇaṃ tadilāndamagniṣṭomasāma kriyamāṇam agne tava śravo vaya ityetāsāṃ ṣaṇṇāmṛcāṃ pūrvāsu tisṛṣu ṛkṣu syāt

src: daśākṣareṣv ārcikāny anugānāny evaṃ tṛce bhavati yathānyāni sāmāni
tgt: tāsāntisṛṇāmṛcāṃ daśākṣareṣu ārcikānyanugānāni syuḥ daśākṣarāṇi daśākṣare daśākṣare ekaikamārkṣikamanugānaṃ syāt evaṃ kriyamāṇantṛce bhavati yathānyāni sāmāni

src: ṣaḍṛce sarvasminn ity ācāryaḥ ardharceṣv anugānāny evam asaṃrodhataro gītānām
tgt: ṣaḍṛce sarvasmin kāryyamityevamācāryyā manyanta evaṃ kriyamāṇe asaṃrodhataraḥ parvaṇāṃ kṛto bhavati ayamatisaṃrodhaḥ pūrvasmiṃstu kalpe saṃrodhaḥ tatastvakriyā

src: dvādaśarca iti śāṇḍilyas tatrāparāv āgneyau tṛcāv āhared ā te agne 'gniṃ taṃ manya ity evam ṛkṣv anugānāni
tgt: śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha dvādaśarcaḥ syāt tatra tasmin bahvṛcāvuttarau aparāvāgneyau tṛcāvāharedāte agne'gniṃ taṃ manya iti evaṃ kriyamāṇe ṛgutpannānyanugānāni sarvāṇi kṛtāni bhavanti

src: caturtham evānugānaṃ tṛce syād iti vārṣagaṇyo 'tra hi nidhanavādaṃ vadati vratam iti bhavati svar iti bhavati śakuna iti bhavatīti bhaktayaś ca kalpyante nānāsāmavac caināny eko 'dhīyate 'dhīyate
tgt: vārṣagaṇya ācāryya āha caturthamevānugānantṛce syāt yasmādatra hi nidhanavādaṃ vadati vratamiti bhavati svariti bhavati śakuna iti bhavatīti eṣa nidhanavādaḥ bhaktayaśca sarvāḥ prastāvādayaḥ asminneva kalpyante eke ca chandogā etāni pañcāpyanugānāni nānāsāmavadevādhīyate

src: chandomadaśāhayor daśamasya trayastriṃśam agniṣṭomasāma syād ity eke trikaṃ sārparājñaṃ daśamapradeśāt
tgt: gavāmayane yatkiñcitsandigdhaṃ tadvicāritam anantaramādityānāmayanamaṅgirasāmayanañca tayoḥ sāmānyaṃ vicāryate ādityānāmayane aharvyūhaṃ vidhāya paṭhati chandomadaśāho'ṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ prathamamahariti evaṃ daśasvahaḥsu aṣṭācatvāriṃśādibhiḥ stomaiḥ prakṛtān stomān pratyāmanati daśame'hani caturviṃśastomamāmanati evamevāṅgirasāmayane ca caturviṃśādīṃstomān paṭhati punardaśame caturviṃśamevāmanati maśakena prāyaṇīyādṛksāmadravyaṃ kalpayitvā chandomadaśāhayorekatra daśame'hani paṭhati maśakaḥ atha yadeva chandomavato daśarātrasya mahāvratāntimamahastadatra daśarātramiti aparatra paṭhati atha yadeva pūrvasya chandomadaśāhasya daśamamahastadatra daśamamiti tatrāyaṃ saṃśayaḥ kiṃ maśakena daśamapradeśāt trikatrayastriṃśo mānasāgniṣṭomasāmnoḥ stomo karttavyo atha pratyakṣavidhānāt sarvatraiva caturviṃśa iti etasmin saṃśaye ayamācāryya ārabhate chandomadaśāhayordaśamasya trayastriṃśamagniṣṭomasāma syādityeke trikaṃ sārparājñaṃ daśamapradeśāditi chandomadaśāhayorubhayorapi daśamasyāhnaḥ trayastriṃśamagniṣṭomasāma syādityeke ācāryyā manyante trikañca sārparājñam ete ubhe mānasāgniṣṭomasāmano trikatrayastriṃśastomayoḥ syātāṃ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ daśamapradeśāt yasmāt daśame ubhayorapyetayoḥ prākṛtena daśamenāhnā pradeśaṃ karoti anyonyaṃ syāt yadyevaṃ tadidaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caturviṃśamiti asya kṛtsnasaṃyogasthānarthakyaṃ prāpnoti ucyate

tuśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣanivṛtyarthaḥ yaduktaṃ trayastriṃśamagniṣṭomasāma syāt trikaṃ sārparājñamiti tanna ṛksāmamātraṃ pradiśyate daśamastomastu caturviṃśastomaṃ prathamamaharadhikṛtya aṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ prathamamaharadhikṛtya sarveṣāmahnāṃ kṛtsnādhikāraḥ
yaduktaṃ bhūyasovādacaturviṃśamiti evaṃ na syāt kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yasmāt pratyakṣavikāro balīyān yathā bhūyasovādāt caturviṃśamiti pratyakṣeṇa śabdena vikaroti trikatrayastriṃśe

src: brāhmaṇa vihite ca stome kalpapradeśaḥ ṛksāmnāṃ bhavati
tgt: yaduktaṃ maśakena pradeśāditi brāhmaṇavihitena stomena kalpapradeśena ṛksāmnāṃ bhavati maśako hi brāhmaṇaṃ upaklṛptasya stomasya vaśena pradeśasyeṣṭena hi brāhmaṇavihitaṃ stomaṃ maśakasya vikalpayituṃ īśitam

src: triṃśinaḥ sutyā māsān sarvatra saṃcakṣīran kauṇḍapāyine ca hāviryajñikāṃs tāpaścite ca daikṣopasadān
tgt: sarvasatreṣu triṃśinaḥ sutyā māsān sarvatra sañcakṣīran kauṇḍapāyine ca hāviryajñikān māsān kauṇḍapāyine cāgnihotrādayo vihitāḥ śunāsīryyāḥ māsamagnihotraṃ juhvatītyata ārabhya tāṃśca hāviryajñikān māsān kauṇḍapāyine triṃśinaḥ sañcakṣīran tāpaścite paṭhati saṃvatsaraṃ dīkṣitā bhavanti saṃvatsaramupasadbhiścaranti saṃvatsaraṃ prastuto bhavati tāṃśca daikṣopasadānmāsāṃstāpaścite triṃśinaḥ sarvān sañcacīran sautyāstu sarvaśabdenaiva siddhāḥ

src: dṛtivātavator ayane dvāv ekonau māsau sunuyus trivṛtāv iti gautamaḥ
tgt: dṛtivātavatorayane atirātrastrivṛtā māsamityadhikṛtya pārṣṭikaiḥ yajñastomairekena stomena kriyāvidhānaṃ pūrvasmin pakṣasi tadanantaramuttarasmiṃstaireva pratilomaiḥ tatra gautama ācāryya āha dvau māsau prathamottamau trivṛtau ekonau sunuyuratirātrābhyāntayoḥ pūraṇamiti
dhānañjapya ācāryya āha trayastriṃśau māsau ṣaṣṭhasaptamau ekonau sunuyuriti gavāmayane hitau ekonau dṛṣṭāviti

src: ubhau vā triṃśinau syātāṃ yathaitad brāhmaṇam
tgt: athavā ubhāveva triṃśinau syātāṃ prathamottamau vā ṣaṣṭhamaptamau vā yathaitadbrāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ samadhikāvevātirātrau paṭhati

src: tathā saty aṣṭamyāṃ dīkṣitvā pañcadaśadīkṣāḥ kurvīran
tgt: tathā sati kalpe aṣṭamyāṃ dīkṣitvā pañcadaśadīkṣāḥ kurvīran

src: pañcadaśānāṃ daśamasyāṣṭādaṃṣṭrāntāny ukthāni syur ity ācāryaḥ ṣoḍaśyapāyāddhi nivṛttaṃ nārmedham iti
tgt: maśakaḥ paṭhati vidhṛtibhiḥ klṛptaṃ dṛtivātavatorayanamātriṇavebhyaḥ trivṛdbhyaḥ uddharatyukthāni pañcadaśebhyaḥ ṣoḍaśinamiti ṣoḍaśina uddhāraṃ paṭhati tatra ca vidhṛtīnāṃ daśame'hani pañcadaśānāṃ nārmedhamukthāneva paṭhati yadi ṣoḍaśinamuddharati tatrāyaṃ saṃśayaḥ kiṃ nārmedhasya tatra ṣoḍaśī nimittam atha vacanaṃ kāraṇamiti tadiha ācāryyairvicāryate pañcadaśastomānāmahnāṃ daśamasyāhnaḥ āṣṭādaṃṣṭrānyukthāni syurityevamācāryyā manyante kasmāt ṣoḍaśyapāyāt nārmedhasya hi tatra ṣoḍaśī nimittaṃ sacet ṣoḍaśī tasmādevamapi syāt avayavānāṃ nivṛttiḥ syāt

src: avacanāt tu nivṛttir na syād yathānyeṣāṃ sāmnām
tgt: tuśabdaḥ pakṣavinivṛtyarthaḥ yathā anyāni sāmāni nivṛttāni bhavanti tatpradeśādevameva nārmedhamapi syāt na hi vacanamasti yena nārmedhaṃ nivarttata iti yaccoktaṃ ṣoḍaśino nivṛttaṃ na tatra nārmedhamityevaṃ vacanam

src: vacanaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ nārmedhasya na ṣoḍaśī
tgt: vacanañca tatra kāraṇaṃ nārmedhasya na ṣoḍaśī nimittaṃ bhavati
dṛśyate caitadevamābhīkṣṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ prayujyamānam aṣoḍaśikeṣu yajñeṣu yathā gūrdaḥ traikakubhañca nārmedhamityutthānānītyetadādivat

tasyāyanavicārā varttiṣyante pṛṣṭhyenaikaiko māso varttetetyevaṃ śrutiḥ trivṛtāmāsamityevamādi atra pṛṣṭhyena ṣaḍahastomena trivṛdādi stomavikṛtena ekaiko māso vartteta evameke ācāryyā manyante liṅgāt yasmāt pārṣṭikāḥ stomāścodyante
śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha pṛṣṭhyastomena trivṛdādistomavikṛtena krameṇa ekaikomāso varttate
śaucivṛkṣirācāryya āha abhiplavapṛṣṭhyābhyāṃ trivṛdādistomavikṛtābhyām ekaikomāso vartteteti saṃvatsaraprakṛtitvāt
śāṇḍilyāyanadhānañjapyāvācāryyāvāhatuḥ pṛṣṭhyāhnaikaikena trivṛdādiḥ ekaiko māsaḥ vartteteti yasmāt tena liṅgena tasya tasya hi stomacodanā

src: jyotiṣṭomeneti lāmakāyanas tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhac ca vyatyāsam
tgt: lāmakāyana ācāryya āha jyotiṣṭomena trivṛdādistomavikṛtena ekaikomāso vartteta yasmāt sarveṣāmahnāmasau prakṛtiḥ ayantu viśeṣaḥ tasya rathantarapṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhacca pṛṣṭhānugrahārthaṃ tatprakṛtīni hi sarvāṇi
kṣairakalambhiḥ ācāryya āha yathaivārṣeyakalpenoktamayanaṃ tathaiva syāditi paraṃ naḥ pramāṇaṃ maśaka iti evamete sarve kalpāḥ pramāṇam

vicāritaṃ dṛtivātavatorayanaṃ sāmprataṃ kauṇḍapāyinaṃ vicāryyate tatra paṭhati māsaṃ dīkṣitā bhavanti māsaṃ soma krīṇanti teṣāṃ dvādaśopasada upasadbhiścaritvā somamupanahya māsamagnihotraṃ juhvati māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajante māsaṃ vaiśvadevena māsaṃ varuṇapraghāsairmāsaṃ śākamedhairmāsaṃ śunāśīryeṇa trivṛtā māsaṃ pañcadaśena māsaṃ saptadaśena māsamekaviṃśena māsantriṇavena māsamaṣṭādaśatrayastriṃśānyahāni dvādaśānyahāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvratañcātirātrañceti tatra upasadbhiścaritvā somamupanahya vidhāya prāyaṇīyamatirātrāgnihotrādīn haviryyajñānupadiśati trivṛnmāsādīṃścānyān māsān tatrāyaṃ saṃśayaḥ kiṃ satranyāyena prāyaṇīyo'tirātreṣu athāśravaṇān mābhūditi etasmin saṃśaye ācāryyaiḥ svaṃ svaṃ mataṃ parigṛhyāyamartho vicāryyate paurṇamāsīprabhṛtayo dīkṣāḥ kauṇḍapāyinasyeti paurṇamāsārambhāḥ paurṇamāsīprabhṛtayaḥ dīkṣāḥ prabhṛtiśabdaḥ ādyarthaḥ kauṇḍapāyinasyeti sambandhalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī

src: tasyopasadanta upavasathakarma kṛtvātirātram upeyur iti śāṇḍilya evaṃ hi gṛhyate vṛttiḥ
tgt: kauṇḍapāyinasya upasadanta upavasathakarma kṛtvātirātramupeyuriti śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yasmādevaṃ vṛttirgṛhyate sarvasatrāṇam

src: tata ūrdhvaṃ prātarāhutyupakramāḥ sāyamāhutisaṃsthā ekānnatriṃśatam ahāny agnihotraṃ juhuyuḥ
tgt: tatastasmādatirātrādūrddhvaṃ prātarāhutyupakramāḥ prātarāhutyārambhaṇāḥ sāyamāhutisaṃsthāḥ sāyamāhutyapavargāḥ ekānnatriṃśatamahānyagnihotraṃ juhuyuḥ evaṃ śāṇḍilyo manyate

src: māsam eveti gautamaḥ sutyānāṃ tu purastād upavasathakarma syād atirātraś caivaṃ ca gṛhyate vṛttir avyavāyaś ca haviryajñaiḥ sutyānām
tgt: gautama ācārya āha māsamevāgnihotraṃ juhuyuḥ māso hi śrutaḥ tasya kutaḥ khaṇḍanamṛte vacanāt kintu sutyānāntu purastādagnihotrādīn śunāsīryyāntān haviryajñān upariṣṭātkrameṇa samāpya tataḥ sutyānāntu purastādupavasathakarma syādatirātraścaivañca gṛhyate vṛttiḥ sarvakarmasu sutyānāṃ purastādupavasathakarma bhavati kiñcānyat avyavāyaśca haviryajñairevaṃ kriyamāṇe sutyānāṃ bhavati

src: aśravaṇād atirātro na syād iti dhānañjapyaḥ pratyantāddhyanyeṣu codayan neha vidadhāti
tgt: dhānañjapya ācāryya āha aśravaṇādatirātro na syāditi yadi atirātro dṛṣṭo'bhaviṣyat aśrauṣat yena punasteṣu satreṣu pratimatrañcodayan yāvadanta iti neha vidadhāti tasmādakalpo na śrutamatirātraṃ kalpayitum
upasadanta eva upavasthakarma bhavet na sutyānantaram

src: aṣṭādaśabhyo vordhvaṃ śaunāsīryebhyo rājānaṃ krīṇīyur evam anantaraṃ sutyābhyo bhavatīti
tgt: athavā'nekadīkṣāṇāmanantaraṃ somakrayo na syāt śaunāsīryyānyahānyaṣṭādaśa kṛtvā tataḥ somaṃ rājānaṃ krīṇīyuḥ evaṃ tat rājakrayādi karma anantaraṃ sutyābhyo bhavatīti

src: dīkṣopasadāṃ vyavāyo nyāya iti śāṇḍilyāyanas te māsi somaṃ krīṇantīti vānantaraṃ dīkṣābhyaḥ krayaṃ darśayati
tgt: śāṇḍilyāyana ācāryya āha dīkṣopasadāṃ vyavāyaḥ anyāya iti kiñcānyat te māsi somaṃ krīṇantīti caitat brāhmaṇamanantaraṃ dīkṣābhyaḥ krayaṃ darśayati
upavasathakarmaivānantaraṃ sutyābhyaḥ syādatirātro na syāt

src: āgnīdhrīyād aṅgārān mārjalīyaṃ hṛtvā pṛthak sthālīpākān śrapayitvā pitṛyajñān kurvīran
tgt: darśe pitṛyajñā bhavanti teṣāṃ vidhirucyate āgnīdhrīyādaṅgārān mārjālīyaṃ hrtvā pṛthaṅnānā sthālīpākāñchrapayitvā pitṛyajñān kurvīran
tatastasmānmārjālīyāt dakṣiṇe pradeśe atipraṇayeyuḥ paitṛyajñikāyāṃ pitṛmedheṣu

src: āhavanīyād dakṣiṇato varuṇapraghāseṣu tasmin kuryur yad dakṣiṇāhavanīye kṛtyam upavasthakarma cet kṛtaṃ syāt
tgt: kṛta upavasathānantaraṃ āhavanīyapraṇayanaṃ bhavati varuṇapraghāseṣu yo dvitīyo'gniḥ praṇīyate dakṣiṇatastamāhavanīyasya dakṣiṇe pradeśe praṇayeyuḥ tasmin kuryyuryyat karma dakṣiṇāhavanīye kṛtyaṃ tadupavasathakarmapūrvakaṃ syāt
atha punarupavasathakarma naiva kṛtaṃ syāt tathā satyanantaraṃ prakṛtaṃ tata iha āgnīdhrīyādaṅgārādityetadādi yathā prakṛtyeva syāt

src: agnihotramāse dīkṣitānnasyādhvaryur juhuyād anvārabdhā itare syuḥ
tgt: agnihotramāse prakṛtānāṃ satriṇāṃ agnihotrācchiṣṭena vṛttirna kalpate tadeva darśayati teṣāmannaṃ kriyata iti dīkṣitārthamannaṃ tasya dīkṣitānnasyādhvaryurjuhuyāt uktannāhutasyāśnīyuriti itare'dhvaryyumanvārabheran juhvānam

iṣṭyayaneṣu havīṃṣvevopāvadyeyuḥ nātra dīkṣitānnamagnihotramāsavat syāt tatkimidamārabhyate yathā uktamevāgnihotramāse dīkṣitānnasyeti tat kathamiṣṭyayaneṣu na syāt ucyate anyārthamevaitadityādiśyate havīṃṣyeveṣṭyayaneṣūpāvadyeyuriti haviṣāmāvṛttiparimāṇamuktam iha tu tathā upāvadyeyuḥ yathā iṣṭīnāṃ haviḥśeṣeṇa yajamānavṛttiḥ syāt

src: agnihotropasthānaṃ viṣṇukramāḥ samiṣṭayajūṃṣīti na kriyerann avabhṛthanyaṅgaś ceti śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: somamupanahya māsamagnihotraṃ juhvati ityuktaṃ tasmin karmaṇi yat prāptaṃ karma tatra kiñcidvacanena nivartyate agnihotraṃ tāvadupasthānamiṣṭiṣu viṣṇukramāḥ samiṣṭayajūṃṣi avabhṛthanyaṅgaśceti etāni na kriyeran ityevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācāryyo manyate eteṣāṃ prāptapratiṣedhaḥ

src: samidhas tv ādadhyur yās tatra purastād uktāḥ
tgt: samidhastvādadhyuryyā asminnavabhṛthanyaṅgeṣu purastāduktāḥ avabhṛthanyaṅgaṃ prāpyābhyukṣaṇaprabhṛti sautyaṃ karma samāpayeyurityetasmin prakaraṇe tatra hi samidādhānāntaṃ bhavati
dhānañjapya ācāryya āha agnihotropasthānādi sarvaṃ kriyeteti

src: māsaṃ darśapūrṇamāsābhyām ity āmāvāsyena pūrvapakṣam itaraṃ paurṇamāsena
tgt: māsandarśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajerannityuktaṃ tatrāmāvāsyena haviṣā pūrvapakṣaṃ yajeran itaramaparapakṣaṃ paurṇamāsena yajeran

src: āmāvāsye pitṛyajñaḥ sakṛd bhūtvā na syād iti gautamaḥ
tgt: āmāvāsye karmaṇi pitṛyajñaḥ sakṛdbhūtvā prathame itareṣu na syādityevaṃ gautama ācāryyo manyate sati daśāṅgatve kāle'pi na syāt pitṛyajñaḥ amāvasyāyām

src: na sakṛc ca na syāditi śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha asakṛdapi na syāt pitṛyajñaḥ nāṅgametaddarśasyeti
dhānañjapya ācārya āha yāvatkṛtva amāvasyā tāvatkṛtvaḥ pitṛyajñaḥ syāt darśāṅgaṃ hi sa iti

src: māsaṃ sākamedhair iti gṛhamedhīyeneṣṭvā tadaiva śaṣaṃ saṃsthāpayeyur evaṃ triṃśatkṛtva upetā bhavantīti
tgt: māsaṃ sākamedhairyyajeranniti brāhmaṇaṃ tatra gṛhamedhīyeneṣṭvā pūrvedyuḥ karma saṃsthāpayeyuḥ evaṃ kriyamāṇena sākamedhīyaṃ karma triṃśatkṛtva upetaṃ bhavatīti

src: dvyahāpavargas tv eṣāṃ prakṛtau pañcadaśakṛtva evābhyasyeyuḥ sa māsaḥ
tgt: tuśabdo hetvarthaḥ eṣāṃ śākamedhānāṃ prakṛte dvyahenāpavargo dṛṣṭaḥ ihāpi dvyahāpavargatāmeva kalpayitvā pañcadaśakṛtvo'bhyasyeyuḥ samāso bhavati evaṃ māsaśabdasyārthavattvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati

agnihotraṃ daśahotā darśapūrṇamāsaṃ caturhotā cāturmāsyāni pañcahotā saumyādhvare sadā hoteti brāhmaṇaṃ tatra agnihotraṃ daśahoteti daśahotāraṃ nāmādhvaryyavaḥ agnihotrasyopasthānamadhīyate tadabhipretyaitadbrāhmaṇam
uttarairvacanairyaduktaṃ tatra ṛtvijo'bhipretāḥ darśapaurṇamāsayoścatvāro hotāraḥ cāturmāsye tu pañca
adhvare some vaṣaṭkāriṇaḥ saptatāmanabhipretyaitadbrāhmaṇaṃ saumyo'dhvaraḥ saptahoteti
te sarve kuṇḍapāyino'tsarukaiścamasairbhakṣayantīti atsarukairadaṇḍacamasaiḥ kuṇḍapratirūpaiḥ kuṇḍasadṛśairbhakṣayeyuḥ
yo hotā so'dhvaryuḥ sapotetyetadādi samāsaḥ saṅkṣepa ekībhāvaḥ

src: svād āsanād upasaṃcāraṃ brahmetare hotre kuryāt
tgt: svasmādāsanādupasañcāre'pi sañcāryya itare hotre maitrāvaruṇīyapratikartre kuryāt etat jñāpitaṃ bhavati brahmatvenāsau dīkṣitaḥ itare hotre karoti

tathā udgātā ca svasmādāsanādupasañcāramitare hotre neṣṭrīyācchāvākīye kuryyāt tathā prastotā itare hotre grāvastut brāhmaṇāchaṃsīye svasmādāsanādupasañcāraṃ kuryyāt tathāgnidhrīyeṇāsau dīkṣitaḥ itare unnetre pratiprasthātre kuryyāt

src: gṛhapatir gṛhapatiḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇya ity asamāsaṃ tayor darśayati
tgt: gṛhapatirgṛhapatiḥ subrahmaṇyaḥ subrahmaṇya ityanayā vīpsayā brāhmaṇamasamāsantayordarśayati vijñāpayati

uktaṃ kauṇḍapāyināmayanam anantaraṃ tāpaścitasya brāhmaṇaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ dīkṣitā bhavanti saṃvatsaramupasadbhiścaranti saṃvatsaraṃ prasṛtā bhavatīti tasya dīkṣākāla ucyate etenoktastāpaścitasya dīkṣādiriti etena kauṇḍapāyinena uktovyākhyātastāpaścitasya dīkṣādiḥ paurṇamāsīprabhṛtayo dīkṣā iti
vakṣyanta iti vākyaśeṣaḥ ayanasya vikalpitaṃ maśakena gavāmayanena klṛptaṃ tāpaścitāmayanaṃ jyotiṣṭomena vā viklṛpteneti tasya vikalpa ucyate

src: jyotiṣṭomo 'tirātraḥ ṣoḍaśimān aharahaḥ syād iti dhānañjapyaḥ
tgt: jyotiṣṭomo'tirātraḥ ṣoḍaśimānahanyahani syāt saṃvatsaramiti śeṣaḥ

src: catvāro jyotiṣṭomā abhijid eṣa pañcāhaḥ ṣaṭsu māseṣv abhyasyeta mahāvrataṃ viṣuvān athaita eva māsā āvṛttā viśvajit tv abhijitsthāne tatpuruṣasya nārāyaṇasyāyanam
tgt: catvāro jyotiṣṭomāḥ jyotiṣṭomaścaturabhyastaḥ abhijideṣa pañcāhaḥ ṣaṭsu māseṣvabhyasyeta mahāvrataṃ viṣuvān syāt athaita eva māsā āvṛttāḥ syuḥ ayantu viśeṣaḥ viśvajittvabhijitaḥ sthāne syāt tatpuruṣasya nārāyaṇasyāyanam

src: abhijid aharahas tad agner jyotiṣṭomo vā rathantarapṛṣṭhaḥ
tgt: tenābhijidvikalpena rathantarapṛṣṭhamiti niyamārtham
bṛhatpṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaramaharahaḥ syāttadindrasyāyanam
vyatyāsaṃ jyotiṣṭome saṃvatsaraṃ bṛhadrathantare pṛṣṭhe syātāṃ tadindrāgnyorayanam
ubhayasāmā jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ syāt tadbrahmaprājāpatyorayanaṃ syāt
vairūpapṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ syāt mahāvrataṃ vā saṃvatsaramaharahaḥ syāt tadvāyorayanam
vairājaṣpṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ syāt viśvajidvā tadādityasyāyanam
śarkvarīpṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ svāt tadapāmayanam
revatīpṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ syāt tadgavāmayanaṃ syāt
vāmadevyaṣpṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ syāt tatprajāpaterayanam
svarapṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ syāt etadviśveṣāṃ devānāmayanam
divākīrttyapṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ syāt tatsūryyasyāyanam
mahāvratapṛṣṭho jyotiṣṭomaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ syāt etanmahendrāyanam ete vicārāstāpaścitasya

src: jyotiṣṭomena trīṇy uttarāṇi tasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhac ca vyatyāsam
tgt: tasya tāpaścitasya yāni trīṇyuttarāṇi dvādaśasaṃvatsaraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṃvatsaraṃ śatasaṃvatsaramiti etāni jyotiṣṭomena abhyastāni bhavanti tasya jyotiṣṭomasya rathantaraṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ bṛhacca vyatyāsaṃ vyatyasya vyatyasya vyātyāsam
kṣairakalambhirācāryya āha eteṣāmayanavidhānaṃ yathaivārṣeyakalpenoktaṃ tathaiva syāditi iti vātavatorayane tat klṛptaṃ prajāpaterdvādaśasaṃvatsaraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśatsaṃvatsaraṃ śatasaṃvatsaramiti

src: agniṣṭomās trivṛta ukthyāḥ para iti tatrāvacanād atirātrā na syur viṣuvantaś ceti śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: iha jyotiṣṭomena trīṇyuttarāṇīti prakṛtaṃ teṣu sarveṣu saṃvatsaracodanā na ca prāyaṇīyodayanīyāvādiṣṭau nāpi viṣuvān tatrāyaṃ śaṃsayaḥ kiṃ saṃvatsaranyāyaṃ gṛhītvā prāyaṇīyodayanīyātirātravanto bhavanti athāgrahaṇānna bhavantīti etasmin saṃśaye'yamācāryya ārabhate agniṣṭomāstrivṛta ityetadādi sūtraṃ maśaka eteṣu ye trivṛdādistomāḥ saṃvatsarān agniṣṭomasaṃsthān kalpayati yān pañcadaśān tānukthyasaṃsthān so'yamācāryya etadarthaṃ gṛhītvā tu parīkṣitumārabhate agniṣṭomāstrivṛta ukthyāḥ para ityetasmin kalpe avacanādatirātrā na syuḥ viṣuvantaśceti evaṃ śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha
dhānañjapya ācārya āha itaroyo vakṣyate satranyāyaḥ sa bhaveta iha kaḥ punarityucyate

src: atirātrāv abhitaḥ syātāṃ madhye viṣuvān bṛhatpṛṣṭho rathantaramadhyandinaḥ pañcadaśaḥ saptadaśaḥ
tgt: prāyaṇīyodayanīyāvatirātrau syātām ādyantayoḥ satrasya syātāṃ madhye viṣuvān syāt bṛhatpṛṣṭho rathantaramadhyandinaḥ pañcadaśasaptadaśau stomau stotreṣu vyatyāsena syātām ekatrika iva
trivṛdādivargeṣu ādyantayoḥ prāyaṇīyodayanīyāvatirātrau madhye viṣuvān
vargāṇamuttame vā saṃvatsare etat syāt uttamasyottamasya saṃvatsarasyādyantayoḥ prāyaṇīyodayanīyāvatirātrau madhye viṣuvān
pṛthaksaṃvatsareṣu ekekasmin saṃvatsara ādyantayoḥ prāyaṇīyodayanīyāvatirātrau madhye viṣuvān
teṣāṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ yathāstomaṃ viṣuvantaḥ syuḥ yo'yaṃ sastomaḥ saṃvatsarastasmin sastome viṣuvān syāt

src: rathantarapṛṣṭho bṛhadbrahmasāmā trivṛtāṃ syād bṛhatpṛṣṭho rathantaramadhyandinaḥ pareṣu
tgt: trivṛtāṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ rathantarapṛṣṭho bṛhadbrahmasāmā viṣuvān syāt bṛhatpṛṣṭho rathantaramadhyandinaḥ pareṣu pañcadaśādiṣu saṃvatsareṣu viṣuvān syāt

src: yajanīye 'hani prasavaḥ syāt pūrvapakṣe yady aviṣuvatkāḥ samārdhamāsātivartiṣu
tgt: yajanīye'hani pratipadi prasavo bhavet prathamaḥ plavaḥ prasavaḥ yadyaviṣuvatkāḥ syuḥ tataḥ pūrvapakṣe syāt samārddhamāsātivarttinaśca yadi bhaveyuḥ
yadi viṣamārddhamāsātivarttinaḥ aviṣuvatkāśca tato aparapakṣe prasavaḥ syāt

src: sahasrasāvye sahātirātrābhyāṃ sahasram ahānīty ācāryāḥ sahasrasāvyam iti hyāheti
tgt: sahasrasāvye paṭhati atirātraḥ sahasramahānītyatirātra iti tatra saṃśayaḥ kiṃ sahātirātrābhyāṃ sahasramahāni syuḥ uta vinātirātrābhyāmiti kutaḥ saṃśaya utpanna iti cet pratyakṣāyāṃ śrutau atirātraḥ sahasramahānītyatirātra iti ucyate samākhyātaḥ sahasrasāvya iti sahasramasmin sāvyā sahasrasāvyam ata ācārya prārabhate sahasrasāvye satre sahātirātrābhyāṃ sahasramahāni syuriti yasmādāha sahasrasāvyamiti

src: antareṇeti śaucivṛkṣiḥ sahasram ahānīty antareṇātirātrāv āha
tgt: śaucivṛkṣirācāryya āha antareṇātirātrau anyāni sahasramahāni syuriti yasmādantareṇatirātrāvāha sahasramahānīni atirātraḥ sahasramahānyatirātra iti atha yaduktaṃ samākhyātaḥ saṃśaya utpanna iti na hi pratyakṣāyāṃ śrutau samākhyā grāhyā prathamaṃ hi viniyogakāraṇaṃ śrutiḥ durbalā samākhyā

src: tasyāyanavikalpas trikadrukāś catuḥṣaṣṭhaṃ śatam abhiplavānāṃ daśarātro vratam iti daśarātro vratam iti
tgt: tasya sahasrasāvyasyāyana ucyate atirātrau tāvatpratyakṣaśiṣṭau anyadatra sahasramayanaṃ yaccoditaṃ tat maśakena vikalpitaṃ jyotiṣṭomenāviklṛptena klṛptam agneḥ sahasrasāvyaṃ gaurīvitasya svareṇa vā tatrāyaṃ vikalpa ucyate pratirātrau tāvat pratyakṣaśiṣṭau anyattrikadrukāścatuḥṣaṣṭhaṃ śatamabhiplavānāṃ daśarātro vratamiti etadahaḥ sahasraṃ trikadrukā jyotirgaurāyuriti catuḥṣaṣṭhyadhikaṃ śataṃ abhiplavānāṃ daśarātrovratamiti

src: dakṣiṇe tīre sarasvatyā vinaśanasya dīkṣeran sārasvatāya ṣaṣṭyāṃ pakṣasyeti gautamaḥ
tgt: sahasrasāvyamuktam anantaraṃ sārasvatānyucyante tatra brāhmaṇaṃ sarasvatyā vinaśane dīkṣeta iti yasmin deśe sarasvatyantarbhavati tadvinaśanamityucyate tasya vinaśanasya dakṣiṇe kūle tīre sārasvatāya tādarthye caturthī ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tithau pakṣasya paribhāṣitam udagayanapūrvapakṣapuṇyāhamiti gautama ācāryya āha

src: amāvāsyāyām atirātraḥ syād evaṃ svasthānam āmāvāsyaṃ prayujyate
tgt: uktaṃ yadaharatirātro bhavati tadaharvatsānapākurvanti saṃsthite'tirātre sānāyyena yajanta iti tadvatsāpākaraṇena sānnāyyayogena ca atirātrasyaiva kālo jñāpyate vatsāpākaraṇaṃ hi amāvāsyāyāṃ bhavati tadanantare'hani sānnāyyena yāgaḥ so'yaṃ gautama ācāryya āha amāvāsyāyāmatirātraḥ syādevaṃ svasthānamāmāvāsyaṃ prayujyata iti āmāvāsyasya hi pūrvapakṣādisthānam uktañca saṃsthite'tirātre sānnāyyena yajanta iti tadyadyamāvāsyāyāmatirātro bhavati tatastasya svasthānaṃ pūrvapakṣādau bhavati / 2 / saptamyāṃ vā dīkṣitvāmāvāsyāyā yajanīye 'hany atirātraḥ syād iti dhānañjapyaḥ / 10.15.3 / <10.15.3 dhānañjapya ācāryya evamāha

vakṣyati hi teṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāṅgoṣṭomastomo bhavatīti yajanīye'hani syādityācāryyā iti tathaivāyuḥ pradekṣyate evantāvat āyuṣo yajanīye'hani kriyopadekṣyate tadyadyatirātro'pi yajanīye'hani kriyate tataḥ goāyurbhyāṃ samādhiḥ kṛto bhavati etadarthaṃ atirātro'pi yajanīya evāhani syāt iti kiñcānyat
yaduktamamāvāsyāyāmatirātra kriyamāṇe pūrvapakṣādau svasthānamāmāvāsyaṃ prayujyate itarathā hi kriyamāṇe na svasthānamāmāvāsyaṃ prayujyate kiṃ kāraṇam
kṛtsno hi pūrvapakṣa āmāvāsyasthānaṃ tadā darśitaṃ granthāntare

src: purā rātreḥ sāyaṃ dohaṃ dohayeran saṃsthite 'tirātre prātardohaṃ tena sānnāyyena yajeran
tgt: prāgrātrerārambhāt sāyandohaṃ dohayeran saṃsthite samāpte'tirātre prātardohaṃ dohayeran uktaṃ saṃsthite'tirātre sānnāyyena yajanta iti

src: sānnāyyeneṣṭvādhvaryuḥ śamyāṃ parāsyatīty āhavanīyanyantena tiṣṭhan prāṅmukho nityam iṣṭisaṃsthāsu prāsyet tad uktaṃ brāhmaṇena
tgt: uktaṃ sānnāyyeneṣṭvā'dhvaryuḥ śamyāṃ parāsyatīti tacchamyāprāśanaṃ kutra bhavatītyāha āhavanīyasamīpe tiṣṭhanniti kriyāpadeśaḥ na āsīnaḥ tiṣṭhan prāṅmukhaḥ nityamahanyahani iṣṭisaṃsthāsu iṣṭisamāptiṣu prāsyet prakṣipet śamyāṃ taduktaṃ brāhmaṇena sā yatra nipatati tadgārhapatyastataḥ ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ prakramān prakrāmati tadāhavanīyamiti nityagrahaṇam amāvāsyānantaraṃ prāśanaṃ prakṛtaṃ tatsarvamakṛtam iṣṭisaṃsthāsu ca tat syāditi nityagrahaṇam

src: cakrīvattā ca tathāpi patnīśālā sthācchāmitraṃ ca
tgt: patnīśālāpi tathaiva cakrīvati svāt patnīśālā prāgvaṃśā śāmitramapi cakrīvadeva syāt śāmitramuktalakṣaṇam

src: tāni yathādeśaṃ varteran samaś ced bhūmibhāgaḥ syāt
tgt: tāni sadaādīni yathādeśaṃ vartteran yo yasya deśo yathādeśaṃ svasvadeśena gaccheyuryadi samobhūmibhāgaḥ syāt
yadi viṣamo bhūmibhāgaḥ syāt ānupūryeṇa vartteran ānupūrvyamadhvaryyave siddhaṃ yathā vyavāyanam

src: vedeḥ pāṃśūn hareyus tathottaraveder dhiṣṇyebhyaś ca
tgt: vedyādīnānnayanamaśakyaṃ tatra teṣāmavayavā nīyante vederityapādānalakṣaṇā pañcamī tasyāḥ pāṃśūn grahītvā nayeyuḥ yathā vedestathottaravedeḥ pāṃśūn hareyuḥ dhiṣṇyebhyaśca pāṃśūn hareyuḥ
tān pāṃśūn niviśya upaviśya yathāyatanaṃ yadyasyāyatanaṃ tasminnivapeyuḥ
ulūkhalabudhnoyūpa iti brāhmaṇaṃ tatkathamulūkhalabudhna ityucyate pṛthubudhnaḥ syāt pṛthu vistāre vistīrṇabudhaḥ syāt

src: prakṛṣya iti taṃ pūrvaṃ karṣeyur evānudyacchantaḥ
tgt: yapaḥ prakṛṣya iti brāhmaṇaṃ yūpasthānaṃ sarveṣāṃ pūrvaṃ karṣeyuḥ anudyachantaḥ anutkṣipantaḥ evaśabdaḥ kriyate karṣeyureva nainamutkṣipeyuḥ yathā granthāntare dṛṣṭaḥ prakṛṣya ityavasthāne prakṛṣyata ākṛtiko hyatyanta iti ākṛtiko bhavatu mā vābhūt prakṛṣṭavya eva prakṛṣya iti brāhmaṇam

src: upopta evety anikhātas tiṣṭheta pāṃśubhiḥ paryuptaḥ
tgt: upopta eveti brāhmaṇaṃ na nikhātastiṣṭhet upopta eveti pāṃśubhiḥ paryyuptaḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ

src: noparavān khanantīty adhiṣavaṇaphalakayor adhastād uparavānām aśvabhrās teṣāṃ pratiṣedha ālikheyur evainān na khaneyuḥ
tgt: noparavān khanantīti brāhmaṇaṃ te uparavāḥ kasmin deśe iti ucyate somasyādhiṣavaṇārthau yau phalakau tayoradhastādbhūmau uparavānāmaśvabhrā vidyante śvabhraḥ khātaḥ teṣāmatra pratiṣedhaḥ ālekhanamātramevaiṣāṃ kuryuḥ na khaneyuḥ ālikheyurenānityevameva vaktavye evaśabdaḥ kimarthaṃ kriyate na khaneyuriti ucyate anyatrāpi yatrārthataḥ khāto na syāt tatra lekhanamātrameva syāt yathā sādyaḥkreṣu vaiśvadeve cātvālapāṃśubhiḥ prayojanaṃ nāsti tatrāpyālekhanamātraṃ syāditi

src: teṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ goṣṭomaḥ stomo bhavatīti yajanīye 'hani syād ity ācāryaḥ saṃsthite goṣṭome paurṇamāsam iti hi saṃsthānāntād vidadhāti
tgt: uktaṃ te tamāpūryamāṇamāmāvāsyena yanti teṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ goṣṭomaḥ stomo bhavatyuktho bṛhatsāmā saṃsthite goṣṭome paurṇamāsaṃ nirvapanta iti goṣṭomasaṃsthānantaraṃ paurṇamāsasya kriyāmādiśati paurṇamāsasya cāparapakṣādiḥ sthānaṃ tatkiṃ paurṇamāsakālavaśena yajanīye'hani goṣṭomo'stu atha pratyakṣatvāt paurṇamāsyāṃ goṣṭomaṃ kṛtvā tatkālānantaraṃ paurṇamāsaṃ nirūpyatāmiti ato'rthamācāryyaḥ parīkṣitumārabhate teṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ goṣṭomaḥ stomo bhavatīti sa goṣṭomo yajanīye'hani syāt ityevamācāryyā manyante kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yasmāt saṃsthānantaraṃ paurṇamāmasya kriyāṃ vidhatte yastvayaṃ paurṇamāsīśabdasteṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāmiti ayaṃ paurṇamāsīsannikṛṣṭe kāle

src: te tam āpūryamāṇaṃ te tam apakṣīyamāṇam iti ca kṛtsnavatpakṣābhidhānam
tgt: kiñcānyat yadidante tamāpūryyamāṇamāmāvāsyena yanti tetamapakṣīyamāṇaṃ paurṇamāsena yantītyetadabhidhānaṃ kṛtvā pakṣāvadhikṛtya kālādhvanoratyantasaṃyoge dvitīyeti yadi hyayaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ goṣṭomaṃ kuryyādamāvāsyāyāñcāyuṣṭomam āmāvāsyāpaurṇamāsābhyāṃ kṛtsnayoḥ pakṣayorvyāptirna syāt

src: parvaṇi tv eva syāt teṣāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ teṣām amāvāsyāyām iti hi pratyakṣeṇa vidadhāti
tgt: tuśabdaḥ pūrvapakṣanivṛttyarthaḥ yaduktaṃ yajanīye'hani syāditi tanna parvaṇyeva syāt evaśabdo'vadhāraṇārthaḥ teṣāṃ paurṇamāsyānteṣāmamāvāsyāyāmeveti yasmāt pratyakṣeṇa vidadhāti yadidaṃ yajanīye'hanītyācāryyāṇāṃ vacanaṃ kalpanāmātramidam ayantvādyaḥ pratyakṣaśeṣaḥ kalpanāmātreṇa śakyaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vacanaṃ bādhituṃ kalpanāvacanayorvacanasya balīyastvāt vacanaṃ hi śrutiḥ

saṃsthite goṣṭome paurṇamāsamiti yaduktannāntarānyatkarma pravarttata ityetaduktaṃ bhavati sve sve kāla eva goṣṭomaḥ sve sve kāla eva paurṇamāsaḥ syāt vakṣyatyetenāyurvyākhyāta iti tatrā'pyeṣa eva vidhiḥ syāt

src: te tam āpūryamāṇaṃ te tam apakṣīyamāṇam iti ca yathā bhūyaso vādaḥ
tgt: atha yaduktante tamāpūryyamāṇante tamapakṣīyamāṇamiti ca kṛtsnavatpakṣābhidhānamiti ayaṃ yathā bhūyasovādaḥ gṛhyatām asambhavāt kṛtsnabhāvasya

src: saṃsthite goṣṭome tad ahar eva paurṇamāsena haviṣeṣṭvodyuñjīrann iti
tgt: parvaṇi goṣṭomaṃ kṛtvā tasminnevāhani paurṇamāsena haviṣeṣṭvā udyuñjīranniti udyogaṃ kuryyuriti tadahareva pratiṣṭheranniti evaṃ saṃsthānantaraṃ paurṇamāsaṃ prayuktaṃ bhavatīti

src: ayajamānās tatraiva tāṃ rātriṃ vaseyur iti gautamaḥ
tgt: gautama ācāryya āha parvaṇi goṣṭomeneṣṭvā ayajamānāḥ paurṇamāsena tasminneva deśe tāṃ rātriṃ vaseyuriti

src: udyuñjīrann eveti śāṇḍilyaḥ śvobhūte tu yajeran
tgt: śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha iṣṭvā paurṇamāsyāṃ goṣṭomena pratitiṣṭheranneva śvo bhūte tu paurṇamāsena yajeran evaṃ paurṇamāsaṃ sve sthāne kṛtaṃ bhavati
etena gavā āyurvyākhyātaḥ yajanīye'hani syāt parvaṇi syādityetadādinā

src: tatra dhānañjapyenāmāvāsyāyāṃ sāyandohaṃ dohayeran purā prātaranuvākāt prātardoham
tgt: tatra tasmin karmaṇi dhānañjapyena vidhānenātirātre kriyamāṇe amāvāsyāyāṃ yajanīye'hanyatirātraḥ syāditi tatra tasminnamāvāsyāyāṃ sāyandohaṃ dohayeran pūrvamatirātrasya prātaranuvākāt prātardohaṃ tataḥ saṃsthite'tirātre sānnāyyena yajeran

src: aticiram evaṃ dugdhaṃ sānnāyyaṃ tiṣṭhed iti śāṇḍilyāyana itarayor evānyatarat kuryur iti
tgt: śāṇḍilyāyana ācāryya āha evaṃ kriyamāṇe yadyamāvāsyāyāṃ sānnāyyaṃ kriyate dvitīyāyāñca yāgaḥ aticiraṃ sānnāyyaṃ dugdhamavatiṣṭhediti tasmāditarayoreva goāyuṣoryajanīye'hani parvaṇi cetyetayorvidhānayoranyatarat kuryyuriti atirātrastvamāvāsyāyāmeva syāditi
iṣṭyayaneṣu kauṇḍapāyine satre bhojanamuktaṃ haviṣyam iṣṭyayaneṣūpāpadyeyuriti darśapūrṇamāsadharmāśca kauṇḍapāyina evoktāḥ amāvāsyena pūrvapakṣamitaraṃ paurṇamāsenetyādayaḥ
pramāṇaṃ evaṃ parvasu kauṇḍapāyine hi triṃśino māsāvihitāḥ iha candrapramāṇā eveti

src: dṛṣadvatyā apyaye 'ponaptrīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvaperan yadi sodakā syāt
tgt: uktaṃ dṛṣadvatyā apyaye'ponaptrīyaṃ carunnirūpyāthātiyantīti taccaruṇā iṣṭiścodyate dṛṣadvatyā nadyā apyayaḥ sarasvatyāsaṅgama ekībhāvastasminnapyaye'ponaptrīyāmiṣṭiṃ nirvaperan aponaptā devatā asyā ityaponaptrīyā nirvapatyālabhate yajatayaḥ pradhānaśabdāstatra pravarttakāḥ nirvapatiśabdeneṣṭiścodyate yadi tasmin deśe sodakā syāddṛṣadvatī
dhānañjapya ācāryya āha anudakāyāmapi nirvaperan śrutisāmarthyāt

src: śate goṣv ṛṣabham apyṛjantīti vatsatarī śate garbhiṇīṣu
tgt: śate goṣvityādi brāhmaṇaṃ śate goṣvṛṣabhaṃ miśrayanti tāsāṃ vayaḥ ucyate vatsatarī śate garbhiṇīṣu vatsabhāvāduttīrṇā vatsataryyaḥ ayametāsāṃ vatsatvaṃ bahugotvaṃ vatsokṣāśvarṣabhebhyaśca tanutva iti ṭarac prathamagarbhāsvāsvityetaduktaṃ bhavati

src: tā yatra gavyam abhayaṃ syāt tatra rakṣeyuḥ
tgt: tā gāvo yasmin deśe gavyaṃ tṛṇodakamabhayaṃ syāt gobhyohitaṃ gavyam abhayaṃ yatra bhayaṃ na syāt vyāghracaurādibhya etasmin deśe etā rakṣeyuḥ gopāḥ

ye tāsāṅgavāṃ puṅgavā utpadyeraṃstairbhuñjīran satriṇaḥ yatkiñcidannādyam upārjayitavyaṃ syāt taiḥ puṅgavaistadarjayeran te tatra nimittabhūtāḥ, apare brūvate ye tatra puṅgavāsteṣāṃ mātṝrdugdhvā tena kṣīreṇa bhuñjīran dadhnāvā yāḥ striyastāsāṃ mātaro na dogdhavyāḥ evaṃ varddhamānā kṣipraṃ sahasraṃ sampadyate eṣa evamukhyārthaḥ, apare brūvate ālabhyāste puṅgavā iti taiśca puṅgavairbhuñjīran sarpiṣā ca

src: tāsu sahasraṃ sampannāsu pūrvapakṣe gām atirātraṃ kṛtvā dattvetā uttiṣṭheyuḥ
tgt: uktaṃ yadā sahasraṃ sampadyate'thotthānaṃ yadā sarvajyāniñjīyante athotthānaṃ yadā gṛhapatirmriyate athotthānaṃ yadā plakṣaṃ prāśravaṇamāgacchantyathotthānamiti etānyevotthānanimittānyuktāni tatredantāvat prathamamutthānaṃ tāsu goṣu sahasraṃ saṃkhyātaḥ sampannāsu māsasya yaḥ pūrvapakṣastasmin gāmatirātrasaṃsthānaṃ kṛtvā datvā enāgāḥ uttiṣṭheyuḥ yasmai deyāstadupariṣṭādvakṣyate

src: yadā sarvajyāniṃ jīyanta iti tāsām evādhikāraḥ prakaraṇabhūtatvāt tatra viśvajidatirātraḥ
tgt: tadyadā sarvajyānimiti kiṃ satriṇo yathā sarvajyāniñjīyante athānya ityatrāha tāsāmevādhikāraḥ prakaraṇabhūtatvāt tasmin hi prakaraṇe tasminnutthāne viśvajidatirātraḥ syāt
mṛte gṛhapatau āyuḥ syāt atirātra iti prakṛtam

src: prādurbhāvāntād etayor āpador uttiṣṭheyur apy aparapakṣe
tgt: etayorāpadoḥ sarvajyānigṛhapatimaraṇayoḥ prādurbhāvasamakālamevottiṣṭheyuḥ na pūrvapakṣamādriyeran aparapakṣe'pyuttiṣṭheyuḥ

src: na sakṛc cana sarasvatyām avabhṛtham abhyaveyur devayajanabhūtā hy eṣāṃ bhavati
tgt: sakṛdapi sarasvatyāmavabhṛthannābhyaveyuḥ
avidyamāne'nyatrodake sarasvatyā evoddhāraṃ kuryyāt pārśvatastu tasyā eva na dūre

src: yadā plakṣaṃ prāsravaṇam āgacchanty athotthānam iti tathā prāsyeyur yathenaṃ pūrvapakṣa āgaccheyur iti gautamaḥ
tgt: prasravaṇe bhavaṃ prāsravaṇaṃ yadi tāvaddare sthāt plakṣaḥ sannikṛṣṭaśca pūrvapakṣaḥ tadā tena krameṇa prāsyeryuryathā pūrvapakṣe āgaccheyuriti gautama ācāryya āha

src: yadenātkiṃcid utthānam āgacched iti dhānañjapyaḥ prāyaṇīyam evātirātram upetyottiṣṭheyur iti
tgt: dhānañjapya ācāryya āha caturṇāmutthānānāṃ yadenāt satriṇaḥ kiñcidutthānamāgacchet prāyaṇīyamevātirātraṃ jyotiṣṭomaṃ kṛtvottiṣṭheyuḥ ādyantasamādhyarthaṃ naiva gavādīn kuryyāditi

src: plakṣaṃ prāsravaṇam āgamya purastād atirātrasyāgnaye kāmāyeṣṭiḥ syād iti śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: uktaṃ plakṣaṃ prāsravaṇamāgacchantīti tat plakṣaṃ prāsravaṇamāgamyāgnaye kāmāyeṣṭiḥ purastādatirātrasya syādityevaṃ śāṇḍilya ācāryo manyate
dhānajapya ācāryya āha iṣṭiḥ upariṣṭādatirātrasya syāditi tato'pyāhāvabhṛtham

src: tasyām aśvāṃ ca puruṣīṃ ca dhenuke yajñopakaraṇaśeṣāṃścābhirūpāyānyasmai dadyuḥ
tgt: tasyāmaśvāñca puruṣīñca dhenuke datteti tasyāmiṣṭau aśvāñca puruṣīñca dhenuke yajñopakaraṇaśeṣabhūtāṃśca abhirūpāya vidyādiguṇayuktāyānyasmai brāhmaṇāya datvā uttiṣṭheyuḥ

src: svāmino hi sarve satreṣu teṣāṃ pratigrahaṃ na vidyate
tgt: kasmādanyasmai dadyuḥ yasmāt satreṣu sarve svāminasteṣāṃ pratigrahaṃ na vidyate vidhānaṃ kimarthamiti cet anyasmai dadyuriti ucyate anyā api yāḥ kāścidaṅgadakṣiṇā naimittinyaḥ karttṛsaṃyuktāḥ satreṣvāgaccheyuḥ tā apyanyasmā eva dadyuḥ
avabhṛtha ukto brāhmaṇena kārapacavaṃ prati yamunāvabhṛthamabhyavayantīti

etat satraṃ sārasvatam apṛṣṭaśamanīyam atha kasmādayamaprāptapratiṣedhaḥ kriyate yadā naiva kaścit pṛṣṭhasamanīyaḥ satreṣvabhihitaḥ athāpi iha pratiṣedhe'nyatra prāptiṃ darśayati śrutyantaradṛṣṭatvāt tasmādudavasānīyajyotiṣṭomena agniṣṭomena rathantarapṛṣṭhena sahasradakṣiṇena pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena ca yajeteti

etenaiva uttare sārasvate vyākhyāte tayoḥ pūrvasmin paṭhati atirātrastrivṛtpañcadaśamityādi paratra trirātro jyotirgorāyustryaha ityādi darśapaurṇamāsikānāṃ haviṣāmebhistrivṛtpañcadaśatrikadrukaiḥ pratyāhuranyatsarvametenaiva vyākhyātamuttarayoḥ dakṣiṇe tīre sarasvatyā vinaśanasya dīkṣeran sārasvatāyetyārabhya

src: tatrāgnaye kāmāyeṣṭir aponaptrīyā ca sruvahomau syātām
tgt: taddevatyau

src: iṣṭir evāgnaye kāmāyopariṣṭāc ced atirātrasyeti śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: prathame agnaye kāmāyeṣṭiḥ purastādatirātrasya upariṣṭādvai vibhāṣitaṃ tatra śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha yadyupariṣṭādatirātrasya syādiṣṭirevāgnaye kāmāya syānna sruvahomāviti
uktaṅgoāyuṣī indrakukṣī viśvajidabhijitāvindrakukṣī iti tāvindrakukṣī parvaṇoḥ syātāṃ tayorhi pūrvasmiṃsthāne dṛṣṭau indrakukṣī iti saṃjñā indrakukṣī kāle tu vadati tata indrakukṣīti coktam

src: pūrvasyāgniṣṭomau trivṛtau rāthantarabārhate pūrvapakṣa ukthye pañcadaśe rāthantarabārhate aparapakṣa iti gautamaḥ
tgt: ye adhikṛte tayoḥ sāmānyo vidhiruktaḥ sāmprataṃ pūrvasmiṃstāvadviśeṣa ucyate uttarayoḥ sārasvatayoḥ pūrvasya trivṛtī ahanī rāthantarabārhate agniṣṭomasaṃsthe syātāṃ pūrvapakṣe ukthasaṃsthe pañcadaśe rāthantarabārhate aparapakṣe iti gautama ācāryya āha
te ahanī na pakṣayoḥ sañcārayet tayoḥ pakṣavyatyāsaṃprayoge

src: sarvatra tv eva trivṛtpañcadaśe vyatyāsaṃ syātām
tgt: sarvatra tveva pūrvapakṣe aparapakṣe ca trivṛtpañcadaśe eva vyatyāsaṃ svātām

src: tayor yasminn anupete parvāgacchet tenottaraṃ pakṣam upakrameta
tgt: tayostrivṛtpañcadaśayoryasmin anupete asaṃskṛte parvāgacchet cāndramasameva tenottaraṃ pakṣamārabheta uktaṃ hi candrapramāṇādeva parvasu syuriti
etenoktaṃ vidhānamuttarasya sārasvatasya trikadrukeṣu yasmin na saṃskṛte parvāgacchet tenottaraṃ pakṣamupakrameteti
anantaraṃ dārṣadvratataure paṭhati tayoḥ sāmānyato vidhānamucyate dārṣadvratañca taurañca tayorvratāni vakṣyanta iti vākyaśeṣaḥ vratāni niyamāḥ

src: tiṣṭhed divāsīta naktaṃ havirucchiṣṭabhojī syād adhaḥsaṃveśy amāṃsāśy alavaṇāśī na striyam upeyād yathā prakṛtyāhitāgnivṛttiṃ vartayet
tgt: tiṣṭheddivāsīta naktaṃ na saṃviśet ṣṭhāgatinivṛttau naktaṃ rātrāvāsīta upaviśeta nāpi saṃviśet havirucchiṣṭabhojī syāt adhaḥsaṃveśī adhaḥsaṃviśet na kṣamāyāṃ bhūmāvityarthaḥ amāṃsāśyalavaṇāśī na māṃsamaśnīyāt na lavaṇamiti kutaḥ punaḥ saṃśaya ucyate na punaḥ pravṛttiruparisaṃveśanasya māṃsalavaṇabhojanasya ca yenāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate yāvatā uktaṃ tiṣṭheddivāsīta naktaṃ havirucchiṣṭabhojī syāditi tadidamanarthakaṃ tasmāt na vaktavyam ucyamāne vā prayojanaṃ vaktavyam ucyate ārabdhavyameva uktaṃ hi saṃvatsaraṃ brāhmaṇasya gā rakṣet saṃvatsaraṃ vyarṇenaitandhave'gnimindhīta saṃvatsare parīṇahyagnīnādadhīteti tadgopālāgnīndhanayoretanna sambhavati gāḥ pālayataḥ sthānāsanaṃ sambhavati agnīndhane prāgagnyādhānāddhaviṣo'bhāvāddhavirucchiṣṭabhojitvaṃ na sambhavati etasmāt kāraṇādārabdhavyamidamanena niyamo yathā sambhavati striyannopeyāt maithunadharmeṇeti kuto vā pravṛttiḥ tatrāha vakṣyatyayaṃ yathā prakṛtyāhitāgnivṛttiṃ varttayediti tasyāṃ vṛttāvetat prakṛtamṛtāvupeyāditi tat pratiṣidhyate yathāprakṛti āhitāgneryyā prakṛtavṛttiḥ tāṃ varttayet agnihotradarśapūrṇamāsānāṃ karmaṇāmanuṣṭhānaṃ kuryyāt dārṣadvratataurayoḥ sāmānyāni vratānyuktāni sāmprataṃ dārṣadvratataurayoryovidhiḥ sa ucyate

src: dārṣadvrate saṃvatsaraṃ brāhmaṇasya gā rakṣed itv ṛtvija ācāryasya vā
tgt: dārṣadvrate paṭhati saṃvatsaraṃ brāhmaṇasya gā rakṣediti tadyoyasya brāhmaṇasya ṛtvik syāt ācāryyo vā tasya gā rakṣet na yasya kasyacidbrāhmaṇasya ṛtvigācāryyāvuktalakṣaṇau etau hi ṛtvigācāryyau sthānināvavicālinau

src: naitandhavānā mārmāḥ sarasvatyāṃ teṣām eko vyarṇas tasmin saṃvatsaram agnim indhīta yaikāgneḥ paricaryā tayā
tgt: uktaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ vyarṇe naitandhave'gnimindhīteti naitandhavānā mārmāḥ sarasvatyāṃ mārmā hradāḥ teṣāmeko vyarṇaḥ arṇa ityudakanāma vigatodakaḥ tasmin vyarṇe hrade saṃvatsaramagnimindhīta ñiindhī dīptau kena nyāyena yā ekāgneḥ paricaryoktā

src: agnihotram eva juhvat purastāc ced āhitāgniḥ
tgt: yadi purastādāhitāgniḥ syāt tatastasmin vyarṇe naitandhave mārme agnihotrameva juhvatsaṃvatsaramevāsīta tadeva syādagnīndhanam

src: saṃvatsarād ūrdhvaṃ parīṇaṃ nāma sthalī kurukṣetre tasyām agnīn ādhāya yathākālam anvārambhaṇīyayeṣṭvā prasṛjyeteti śāṇḍilyaḥ
tgt: uktaṃ saṃvatsare parīṇahyagnīnādadhīteti saṃvatsaramagnimindhitvā tasmādūrddhvaṃ parīṇhyagnīnādadhīta parīṇahīti deśaśrutiḥ parīṇaṃ nāma sthalī kurukṣetre bhūmerunnatapradeśaḥ tasyāṃ sthalyāmagnīnādhāya yathākālamanvārambhaṇīyo yaḥ kālaḥ tasminneva etayeṣṭvā prasṛjyeteti śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha
dhānañjapya ācāryya āha agnyādhānaṃ kṛtvā tasminneva deśe yathākālamanvārambhaṇīyayeṣṭvā darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ yajeteti

src: sāyaṃ prātarāhutī eva hutvā purastāc ced āhitāgniḥ
tgt: atha yadi purastādāhitāgniḥ sāyaṃ prātarāhutī eva hutvā prasṛjyeteti
brāhmaṇaṃ sadakṣiṇena tīreṇa dṛṣadvatyā āgneyenāṣṭākapālena śamyā parāsīyāditi tatsarasvatīdṛṣadvatyoḥ sambhedaṃ saṅgamaṃ prāpyāgneyena puroḍāśenāṣṭākapālena yaṣṭumupakrameta upakrama ārambhaḥ
tatra tasmin karmaṇi aṣṭākapālena yāgena śamyāprāsanaṃ śamyāprakṣepaḥ yena prakāreṇa sārasvateṣu āhavanīyanyantenetyādinā
na tviha prakramāt prakrāmet yathā sārasvateṣu tatra hi saumikañcaityāhavanīyam iha punaraiṣṭikaṃ tasmādiha prakramāt na prakrāmet
iha kāmamiṣṭitaḥ anekamiṣṭimekaikenāknā saṃsthāpayet kuryyāt viprakṛtya
dṛṣadvatyā dakṣiṇena kūlena iyādgacchet śamyāprāsaiḥ

src: tasyāḥ prabhavyamarmaṃ prāpyaitayeṣṭyeṣṭvā triplakṣāvaharaṇaṃ prati yamunām avabhṛtham abhyaveyāt
tgt: uktaṃ triplakṣān prati yamunāmavabhṛthamabhyavaitīti tadeva manuṣyebhyastiro bhavatīti tasyā dṛṣadvatyāḥ prabhavyamarmaṃ prāpya yasmādasau prabhavati prāyāt taṃ prāpyaitayeṣṭvā āgneyenāṣṭākapālena triplakṣāvaharaṇaṃ deśaṃ prati yamunāmavabhṛthamabhyaveyāt triplakṣān pratīti brāhmaṇaṃ te plakṣā na jñāyante kasmin kāle avahṛtā iti āgamena tvavicchinnena pāramparyeṇādau vijñāyante tasmāt sūtrakāra evaṃ kalpayati

src: yatra kvaca tato dūre yamunā syāt tatraitayeṣṭyeṣṭvā svayaṃ sāma gāyann avabhṛtham abhyaveyād agāyan vā
tgt: yadi tasmāddeśādyamunā dūre syāt tasmin kasmiṃściddeśe etayeṣṭyeṣṭvā svayaṃ sāma gāyannavabhthamabhyaveyādityarthādavagamyate svayamiti ucyate etaddhi avabhṛthasāma ṛtvikkartṛkaṃ tadanena liṅgenādriyetāpi ṛtviggānārtham evamādita ārabhya svayamiti athavā svayaṃ sāma gāyatīti asaṃpreṣito gāyet agāyanvā abhyaveyādavabhṛtham

src: pravrajiṣyato 'yanam idaṃ manya iti dhānañjapyas tad eva manuṣyebhyas tirobhavatīti
tgt: idaṃ dārṣadvratamayanaṃ pravrajiṣyata evaṃ manya iti dhānajapyastadeva manuṣyebhyastiro bhavatīti eṣa tirobhāvastasya yannityamaraṇye vasanmanuṣyairdṛśyate
evamiva hi tadbrāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
atha kriyāphalamidamucyate anena karmaṇā svargaṃ lokamākramate tato manuṣyebhyastirobhūto bhavati na manuṣyairupalabhyate

athavā vyāvarttata evāsau manuṣyebhyaḥ nāsau manuṣyaistulyo bhavati śreyān bhavati kiṃ punarmanuṣyebhyaḥ śreyaḥ brahmaprāptiḥ brahma prāpnotītyanena karmaṇā apavṛjyata ityarthaḥ ayamātyantikastirobhāvaḥ

athavā tirobhāva udakāntarddhānāt yadāsau avabhṛthamabhyavaityapsu nimajjati tadāsāvantarhito bhavati na dṛśyate tasmādudakāntarddhānāt tirobhavati yathā sarajasa iti dṛṣṭānta upādīyate yathā sarajaso'hani manuṣyalokādevainamantardadhātīti kuśapuṭairupayantīti

iha brāhmaṇamāgneyo'ṣṭākapāla aindra ekādaśakapālo vaiśvadevacarurityetadādyanukramyāha etena vai turo devamuniḥ sarvāmṛddhimārddhnot sarvāmṛddhimṛdhnoti ya etadupaitīti āgneyo'ṣṭākapāla ityādipradhānatvaṃ coditaṃ nāpyabhyāsaścodito nāpi kālaniyamaḥ kṛtaḥ so'yamācāryyo liṅgaṃ gṛhītvā etena vai turodevamuniḥ sa sarvāmṛddhimārdhnot sarvāmṛddhimṛdhnoti ya etadupaiti sāṃvatsarikaṃ satrāyaṇamupaitīti saṃvatsaramaharahastaureṇa yajeteti saṃvatsaramiti kālaniyamaḥ aharaharityabhyāsaścodyate taureṇeti karaṇalakṣaṇā tṛtīyā yajeteti kriyopadeśaḥ ayaṃ sūtrārthaḥ yadetadaiṣṭikaṃ vidhānaṃ vakṣyati anenāharahaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ yajeteti

src: ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caitrīpakṣasya pañcamyāmiti gautamo vratopāyanīyam odanam aśitvā keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayitvāhataṃ vasanaṃ paridhāya parisamuhyāgnīn paristīryya praṇītāḥ praṇīya mekhalām ābadhya daṇḍaṃ pāṇau kṛtvā paścād gārhapatyasyopaviśya svayaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ pratiṣajeta tūṣṇīm
tgt: ṣaṣṭhyāṃ tithau caitrīpakṣasya citrābhiryuktā paurṇamāsī caitrī yadetat karma vakṣyate etat ṣaṣṭyāṃ caitrīpakṣasyārabhya kuryyāt pañcamyāmiti gautama ācāryya āha pañcamyāṃ caitrīpakṣasya vratopāyanīyamodanamaśitvā odanaṃ bhuktvā vratamupaiti yena taṃ vratopāyanīyamodanamaupavasantikaṃ haviṣyamantraṃ bhuktvā keśān śmaśrūṇi ca vāpayitvā ahataṃ vasanaṃ paridhāya tāntukamanirṇiktamaprāvṛtapūrvaṃ tadvasanaṃ paridhāya parisamuhyāgnī paristīryya tretāgnīnāṃ paristaraṇamādhvaryyave siddhaṃ praṇītāḥ praṇīya praṇītāsaṃjñā mantrasaṃskṛtā āpaḥ mekhalāmābadhya mehanasya khalasya mālā mekhalā adharottarakāyavibhāgārthā raśanetyarthaḥ muñjādīnāṃ dravyāṇaṃ ekena nirvṛttā daṇḍaṃ pāṇau kṛtvā pālāśādīnāṃ yajñīyānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāmekasyāvayavabhūtaṃ gārhapatyasya paścime pradeśe upaviśya svayaṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ pratiṣajeta tūṣṇīṃ kṛṣṇamṛgasya carma kṛṣṇājinaṃ tat svayaṃ skandhe pratiṣajeta adattamadhvaryuṇā etadādhvaryyavaṃ tadvacanāt svayaṃ bhavatīti adīkṣitaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ pratimuñceta iti tūṣṇīmiti mantreṇādhastādgrahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tasya pratiṣedhaḥ
kintu paścādgārhapatyasyopaviśyeti yaduktaṃ tasyāyaṃ vikalpaḥ

src: tasya tisra iṣṭayaḥ pūrvāhna ekā pṛthak ca madhyandināparāhṇayoḥ
tgt: tasya tisra iṣṭayaḥ stomasaṃsthā vikṛtaṃ gavāmayanaṃ sarpasatraṃ syādityeke ācāryyā brūvate

src: satāsu pṛthag anupūrvaṃ havīṃṣi yāny uktāni brāhmaṇena
tgt: aṣṭākapālaḥ ekādaśakapālaścaruḥ brāhmaṇoktametat sarvaṃ vakṣyamāṇaviśeṣavidhānārtham

src: ekā vaiva syāt tasyāṃ tāni sarvāṇi syuḥ
tgt: kālatrayavihitahaviḥṣvekaiveṣṭiḥ na tisraḥ

src: saṃvatsarād ūrdhvam avabhṛtham abhyaveyāt tatra sāmagānaṃ yathā pūrvasmin
tgt: svayaṃ gāyena vā gāyediti

src: ubhayos tv avabhṛthād udetya yat purastād iṣṭyayanaṃ teneṣṭvā somena yajeta
tgt: prakṛtatvādubhayordārṣadvratataurayoravabhṛthottarakālamāgneyādibhiriṣṭvā somenāgniṣṭomena prayogaḥ

src: yāvanti vā havīṃṣi purastāt tāvadbhir vā paśubhis taddevatyaiḥ
tgt: taddevatyaiḥ paśubhiḥ sāmarthyāt mantravarṇavikāraḥ
sarvo daśadaśīti stomo vikṛtaḥ agniṣṭomameva iti saṃsthāvikāraḥ śeṣaṃ samānaṃ gavāmayanena abhigarāpagarayoḥ kṛtatvāt

src: pratyakṣavihitaṃ tv ārṣeyakalpena tatrānumānaṃ na vidyate
tgt: pratyakṣavihitametadārṣeyakalpena sarpasatraṃ tatra tasminnanumānaṃ na vidyate paraṃ naḥ pramāṇamārṣeyakalpe tena cedaṃ pratyakṣamuktasaṃśayaṃ vihitaṃ na ca śakyaṃ pratyakṣavihitamanumānena pratyākhyātuṃ vikalpayituṃ vā tadyathārṣeyakalpena kṛtaṃ tathaiva syāt kintu
abhigarāpagarāveva sarpasatrasyottame'hani bhavetāṃ taddhi vratasthānīyamupottamamahaḥ
paṭhati gavāmayanaṃ prathamaḥ saṃvatsaro'thādityānāmathāṅgirasāmiti tasya trisaṃvatsarasya paurṇamāsyāṃ prasavaḥ syāt tathopapādayeran yathā paurṇamāsyāṃ prasavo bhavati
yāvatya iṣṭayaḥ syustāvatīḥ kuryuriti
śāṇḍilya ācāryya āha ṣaṣṭi dīkṣāḥ syuriti

src: prathamottamau saṃvatsarau vyatihared ity eke 'bhiplavastomapṛṣṭhyadeśarohārtha iti
tgt: eke ācāryyā bruvate asmiṃstrisaṃvatsare prathamottamau saṃvatsarau vyatiharediti prathamottamayoḥ saṃvatsarayorvyatihāraḥ kathaṃ kuryyāditi gavāmayanam iti kimartham abhiplavastomapṛṣṭhyadeśarohaṇārtham evaṃ trivṛtstomā abhiplavāḥ prathame saṃvatsare bhavanti trivṛtpañcadaśastomā dvitīye cātuṣṭomyena tṛtīye abhiplavastomānāmeṣa rohaḥ pṛṣṭhyadeśasya ye pṛṣṭhyaḥ abhiplavānāṃ purastāt madhya upariṣṭādbhavati
yathaivāmnātāḥ saṃvatsarāstathaiva tānupeyuḥ ke hi pramāṇamāśritya pratyakṣaśrutiṃ pratyāmananti tasmādyathāmnāyamevopeyuḥ

uktaṃ trisaṃvatsaraṃ sahasrasaṃvatsare paṭhati ekaṃ prajāpateḥ anyadviśvasṛjāntayoḥ stotravidhirukto maśakena karmavidhiḥ sarvaḥ paribhāṣāsiddhaḥ kevalaṃ prasavakāla ucyate amāvāsyāprasave sahasrasaṃvatsare amāvāsyāyāṃ prasavo yayoste ime amāvāsyāprasave tadā dīkṣeran yathā amāvāsyāyāṃ prasavaḥ sampadyate ṣaṣṭhyāṃ pūrvapakṣasya dīkṣitānāṃ tṛtīyāyāmaparapakṣasya kramaḥ evamamāvāsyāyāṃ prasavaḥ sampadyate
